21.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
The Lord is the emperor of the emperors, the truth and the beautiful
He, the great, is nonchalant and his mystery cannot be understood
His court is also anxiety free.
The feats of His powers are unfathomable and impervious.
His praise is true and the story of His eulogisation is undescribable.
I accept the true Guru wondrous and offer my life (for His truth).
Grandeur of the Primeval Lord
Millions of Brahmas, Visnus and Mahegas adore the Lord.
Narad, Saran and Sesanag eulogise Him.
The gams, gandharvas and Gana et al. play instruments (for Him).

21.g: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਸਾਂਗ ਬਣਾਇਦੇ।
21.t: chhia dharasan kar ves saa(n)g banaidhe|
21.e: The six philosophies also propound different garbs (for reaching Him).
The gurus sermonize the disciples and the disciples act accordingly.

21.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਦੇ ॥੨॥
21.t: aadh purakh aadhes paar na paidhe ||2||
21.e: Salute to the primeval Lord who is unfathomable.
Grandeur of the Primeval Lord
The pirs and paigambars (messengers of Lord) worship Him.
The shaikhs and many other worshippers remain in His shelter.

21.g: ਗਉਸ ਕੁਤਬ ਕਈ ਲੋਇ ਦਰ ਬਖਸੰਦਗੀ।
21.t: gaus kutab kiee loi dhar bakhasa(n)dhagee|
21.e: The gaues and qutabs (spiritualists of Islam) of many places beg for His grace at His door.
Dervishs in their trance stand at His gate to receive (alms from Him)

21.g: ਵਲੀ ਉਲਹ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੋਇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪਸੰਦਗੀ।
21.t: valee uleh sun soi karan pasa(n)dhagee|
21.e: Listening to the praises of that Lord many walls also love Him.
A rare person of high fortune reaches His court.
People know not the works of  creator
People go on explaining disconnected rumours
But none of the Hindus and Muslims has identified the truth.
Only an humble person is accepted respectfully in the court of the Lord.

21.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ਨ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ।
21.t: vedh kateb kuraan na akhar jaaniaa|
21.e: The Vedas, katebas and the 'Qur'an (i.e. all the scriptures of world) also know not even a single word about Him.
The whole world is wonder-struck to see his wondrous deeds.
I am sacrifice unto that creator who Himself is the basic grandeur of His creation.

21.g: ੫ : ਰਸਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੵਾਰੇ ਮਹਲ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਹਨ
21.t: 5 : rasaa(n) dhe payeaare mahal to(n) dhoor han
21.e: Pleasure seekers are away from His abode

21.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਿਧਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh lakh roop saroop anoop sidhaavahee|
21.e: Millions of beauteous persons come to and go from this world
Millions of beauteous persons come to and go from this world and perform variegated activities.

21.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: raag naadh visamaadh gun nidh gaavahee|
21.e: The rags (melodies) and nods (sounds) also being wonder-struck eulogise that ocean of attributes (the Lord).

21.g: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਲਖ ਸੁਆਦ ਚਖਿ ਚਖਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: ras kas lakh suaadh chakh chakhaavahee|
21.e: Millions taste and make others taste the edibles and inedibles.
Crores of people manage to make others enjoy the fragrance and varied smells.

21.g: ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਮਹਲ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੫॥
21.t: gair mahal sulataan mahal na paavahee ||5||
21.e: But those who consider the Lord of this (body) mansion as an alien, they all cannot attain His mansion.
Duality and unity

21.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਵਈ।
21.t: siv sakatee dhaa mel dhubidhaa hoviee|
21.e: The confluence of Siva and the Sakti is the root cause of this creation full of duality.

21.g: ਤ੍ਰੈਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵਈ।
21.t: traigun maiaa khel bhar bhar dhoviee|
21.e: The maya with her three gunas (qualities – rajas, tamas and salty) plays her games and sometimes fills the man (with hopes and desires) and at another time empties him totally frustrating his plans.
Maya deludes people through the cyclic garlands of dharma, arth, cam and mokc (four supposed ideals of life) offered by her to man.
But man, the sum total of five elements, perishes ultimately.

21.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਰੋਵਈ।
21.t: chhia rut baareh maeh has has roviee|
21.e: The jiv (creature), laughs, weeps and wails during all the six seasons and twelve months of his life

21.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ॥੬॥
21.t: ridh sidh nav nidh needh na soviee ||6||
21.e: And imbued with the pleasures of the miraculous powers (given him by the Lord) never attains peace and equipoise.

21.g: ੭ : ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਫੋਕਟ ਹੈ
21.t: 7 : bhaau bhagat to(n) binaa(n) fokaT hai
21.e: Everything futile without loving devotion

21.g: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਖ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ।
21.t: sahas siaanap lakh ka(n)m na aavahee|
21.e: Millions of skills make no avail.

21.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: giaan dhiaan unamaan a(n)t na paavahee|
21.e: Myriads of knowledges, concentrations and inferences are unable to know the mysteries of Lord.

21.g: ਲਖ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਲਖ ਭਾਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧੵਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh saseear lakh bhaan ahinis dhayeaavahee|
21.e: Millions of moons and suns adore Him day and night.
And millions of people remain imbued with humility.

21.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਗਰਬ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਲਜ ਲਜਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh lakh garab gumaan laj lajaavahee|
21.e: Millions are worshipping the Lord according to their own religious traditions.

21.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦੀਨ ਈਮਾਨ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh lakh dheen ieemaan taaRee laavahee|
21.e: Millions are worshipping the Lord according to their own religious traditions.
Only through loving devotion one can merge in the Lord, the absolute truth.
With loving devotion, all is futile
Millions of spiritualists and emperors confuse the public.

21.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਰਾਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: jog bhog lakh raeh sa(n)g chalaavahee|
21.e: Millions adopt yoga and bhog (enjoyment) simultaneously

21.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: dheen dhunee asagaeh haath na paavahee|
21.e: But they cannot fathom the divine who is beyond all the religions and the world.
Myriads of servants serve him

21.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: a(n)t na sifat salaeh aakh sunaavahee|
21.e: But their praises and eulogies cannot know his extent.
All standing at His court adore that anxiety-free Lord.
With loving devotion, all is futile
Many masters and leaders come and go.
Many majestic courts exist and their stores are so full of wealth
That continuous counting goes on there (to avoid any deficiency).
Many becoming helping hand to many families are sticking to their words and protect their reputation.
Many, controlled by greed, infatuation and ego, go on swindling and cheating.
Many are there who talking and discoursing sweetly wander in all the ten directions.
Millions are old people who are still swinging their mind in the hopes and desires.

21.g: ੧੦ : ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਛੁੱਟ ਹੋਰ ਪਰਚੇ
21.t: 10 : bhaau bhagat to(n) chhu'T hor parache
21.e: Without loving devotion all else is is futile

21.g: ਲਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਦੇਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh dhaate dhaataar ma(n)g ma(n)g dhevahee|
21.e: Millions are the generous persons who beg and bestow upon others.
Millions are incarnations (of gods) who having born have performed many acts
Many boatmen have rowed but none could know the extent and end of the world ocean.
The thinkers also could know nothing about His mystery.
The thinkers also could know nothing about His mystery.
Millions are eating and feeding others and
Millions are there who are serving the transcendental Lord and also in the courts of worldly kings.

21.g: ੧੧ : ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਛੁੱਟ ਹੋਰ ਪਰਚੇ
21.t: 11 : bhaau bhagat to(n) chhu'T hor parache
21.e: Nothing without loving devotion
The valiant soldiers show their powers

21.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਰਤੇ ਲਖ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: sun sun surate lakh aakh sunaavahee|
21.e: Millions of the listeners explain His praises.
Researchers also run in all the ten directions.

21.g: ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵੈ ਲਖ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਪਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: chir jeevai lakh hoi na oRak paavahee|
21.e: Millions of long-lived ones have happened but none could know the mystery of that Lord

21.g: ਖਰੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: khare siaane hoi na man samajhaavahee|
21.e: Even being clever, people do not make their minds understand (the futility of rituals and other allied hypocrisies)
And ultimately get punished at the court of the Lord.

21.g: ੧੨ : ਖੁਦੀ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਸਬਰ ਦੇ ਸੁਖ
21.t: 12 : khudhee dhe dhu'kh sabar dhe sukh
21.e: Sufferings of ego and delights of contentment
Physicians prepare myriads of prescriptions.
Millions of people full of wisdom adopt many a resolution.
Many enemies unwittingly go on increasing their enmity.

21.g: ਲੜਿ ਲੜਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਮੁਹੀਮ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: laR laR karan muheem aap ganaavahee|
21.e: They march for fightings and thus show their ego

21.g: ਹੋਇ ਜਦੀਦ ਕਦੀਮ ਨ ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: hoi jadheedh kadheem na khudhee miTaavahee|
21.e: From youth, though, they step in old age yet their egotism is not effaced.
Only the contented and the humble lose their sense of egocentricity.
Negation of self conceit is the salvation

21.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh lakh peer mureedh mel milaavahee|
21.e: Lacs of spiritualists and their disciples assemble.
Myriads of beggers ave pilgrimages at the martyries.

21.g: ਲਖ ਰੋਜੇ ਲਖ ਈਦ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਕਰਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: lakh roje lakh ieedh nivaaj karaavahee|
21.e: Millions of people observe fasts (roza) and offer namaz (prayer) of id.

21.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਫਤ ਸੁਨੀਦ ਮਨ ਪਰਚਾਵਹੀ।
21.t: kar kar gufat suneedh man parachaavahee|
21.e: Many entice their minds by being busy in questioning and answering.
Many are engaged in preparing the key of evotion for opening the lock of mind's temple.

21.g: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਹੀ ॥੧੩॥
21.t: dhar dharaves raseedh na aap janaavahee ||13||
21.e: But those Who by becoming dervish at the door of Lord have become acceptable, never show their individuality.
Ugly are the people indulged in delusion
Tall palaces are erected and carpets are spread therein,
To get counted amongst, the high-ups.

21.g: ਕਰਿ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ।
21.t: kar gaR koT hajaar raaj kamaavane|
21.e: Constructing thousands of forts people rule over them
And millions of officers sing panegyrics in the honour of their rulers.
Such people full of their self-esteems go on transmigrating from
And to this world and look uglier in the true court of the Lord.
Hypocrisy does not avail there
Millions of bathings at pilgrimage centres on auspicious occasions;
Serving at the places of gods and goddesses;

21.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਲਖ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਧਾਵਣਾ।
21.t: jap tap sa(n)jam lakh saadh sadhaavanaa|
21.e: Observance of austerities and millions of praxis by being meditative and full of continence
Offerings through yajn and horns etc;

21.g: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਲਖ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ।
21.t: varat nem lakh dhaan karam kamaavanaa|
21.e: Fasts, dos and donots and millions of charities (for the sake of show business)
Have absolutely no meaning in that true court of the Lord.
Man of the Lord's court is the highest
Millions of leather bags (boats) go on floating on water

21.g: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੀਆ।
21.t: oRak oRak bhaal sudh na laha(n)dheeaa|
21.e: But even searching the vast ocean they do not find possible to know the ends of the ocean.

21.g: ਅਨਲ ਮਨਲ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਆਲ ਉਮਗਿ ਉਡੰਦੀਆਂ।
21.t: anal manal kar khiaal umag udda(n)dheeaa(n)|
21.e: The lines of anil birds fly high to know about the sky but their jumps and

21.g: ਉਛਲਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਛਾਲ ਨ ਉਭਿ ਚੜ੍ਹੰਦੀਆ।
21.t: auchhal karan uchhaal na ubh chaRha(n)dheeaa|
21.e: Upward flights do not take them to the highest borders of sky.
Millions of skies and nether worlds (and their inhabitants) are beggars before Him and
Before the servants of God's court are nothing more than a particle of dust.
Creation of the wondrous Lord Vahiguru

21.g: ਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ।
21.t: trrai gun maiaa khel kar dhekhaaliaa|
21.e: The Lord has produced this world as the play of the three dimensional maya.
He has accomplished the feat of (the creation of) four life mines (egg, foetus, sweat, vegetation) and four speeches (pars, pasyanti, madhyama and vaikhar).
Creating from the five elements he bound them all in a divine law.

21.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲਿਆ।
21.t: chhia rut baareh maeh siraj samhaaliaa|
21.e: He created and sustained the six seasons and the twelve months.
For day and night He lit the sun and the moon as lamps.
With one vibrational throb he expanded the whole creation and delighted it through his graceful glance.
He is detached
With one word (sound) the Lord creates the universe and destroyes it.

21.g: ਤਿਦੂੰ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ।
21.t: tidhoo(n) lakh dhareeaau na oRak jaapadhaa|
21.e: From that very Lord myriads of life streams have emerged and there is no end to them.

21.g: ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਸਮਾਉ ਨ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ।
21.t: lakh brahama(n)dd samaau na lahar viaapadhaa|
21.e: Millions of universes subsume in Him but He is uninfluenced by any of them.

21.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਉ ਲਖ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ।
21.t: kar kar vekhai chaau lakh parataapadhaa|
21.e: He sees His own activities with great enthusiasm and makes many a man glorious

21.g: ਕਉਣ ਕਰੈ ਅਰਥਾਉ ਵਰ ਨ ਸਰਾਪ ਦਾ।
21.t: kaun karai arathaau var na saraap dhaa|
21.e: Who can decode the mystery and meaning of the principle of His boons and curses?

21.g: ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਪੁੰਨ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
21.t: lahai na pachhotaau pu(n)n na paap dhaa ||18||
21.e: He accepts not only the (mental) repentance of sins and virtues (and accepts the good deeds).

21.g: ੧੯ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਤੇ ਕਾਦਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਹੈ
21.t: 19 : kudharat te kaadhar bea(n)t asagaeh hai
21.e: The creator and His creation are infinite

21.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ।
21.t: kudharat agam athaahu a(n)t na paieeaai|
21.e: Creation, the power of the Lord is unrpproachable and unfathomable.
Nobody can know its extent. That creator is without any anxiety;how could He be persuaded and amused.
How the majesty of His court could be described.

21.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਸੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ।
21.t: koi na dhasai raahu kit bidh jaieeaai|
21.e: None is there to tell the way and means leading to Him.

21.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ।
21.t: kevadd sifat salaeh kiau kar dhiaaieeaai|
21.e: This is also incomprehensible that how infinite are his eulogies and how should He be concentrated upon.

21.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
21.t: abigat gat asagaahu na alakh lakhaieeaai ||19||
21.e: The dynamics of the Lord is unmanifest, deep and unfathomable; it cannot be known.
Only grace of the lord desired
The primeval Lord is said to be the supreme wonder.

21.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸਾਖੀਐ।
21.t: aadh aneel anaadh sabadh na saakheeaai|
21.e: The words also fail to tell about the beginning of that beginningless.

21.g: ਵਰਤੈ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨ ਗਲੀ ਗਾਖੀਐ।
21.t: varatai aadh jugaadh na galee gaakheeaai|
21.e: He operates in the time and even before the time primordial and mere discussions cannot explain Him.
He, the protector and lover of the devotees is undeceivable known by the name of the equipoise.
The desire of the consciousness is to remain merged in His unstruck melody heard in the trance.
He, being full of all dimensions, is the wonder of the wonders.
Now the only desire remains that the grace of the perfect Guru be with me (so that I may realise the Lord).

22.e: Vaar 22
One Oankar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
The formless Lord who is without any anchor and is imperceptible, has not made himself fully known to anyone.
From unembodiment He assumed the form by himself and becoming Oankar
He created infinite wondrous forms.
In the form of the true name (ndm) and becoming the creator, He came to be known as the protector of His own reputation.
Through three dimensional maya He nourishes one and all.
He is the creator of the cosmos and prescribes its destiny.

22.g: ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ।
22.t: sabhasai dhe aadhaar na tol tulaiaa|
22.e: He is the basis of all, the incomparable One.

22.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਹੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
22.t: likhiaa thit na vaar na maahu janaiaa|
22.e: None has ever disclosed the date, the day and month (of creation).

22.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
22.t: vedh kateb veechaar na aakh sunaiaa ||1||
22.e: Even the Vedas and other scriptures could not fully explain His thoughts.
Divine Power
Who without any props, and uncontrolled by habit has created behavioural patterns?
How the swan reaches the heights of sky?
Wondrous is the mystery of wings which made the swan to soar at such heights.

22.g: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਸਮਾਣਿ ਨ ਟਲ ਟਲਾਇਆ।
22.t: dhraoo chaRiaa asamaan na Tal Talaiaa|
22.e: How did Dhruv in the form of immovable star mount the sky?
It is a mystery how a humble eschewing ego acquires honour in life.
Only the gurmukh who has meditated upon Lord is accepted in His court.
Divine Power

22.g: ਓੜਕੁ ਓੜਕੁ ਭਾਲਿ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
22.t: oRak oRak bhaal na oRak paiaa|
22.e: In order to know Him, people put in extreme efforts but could not know His extant.

22.g: ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਗਏ ਸਿ ਫੇਰ ਨ ਆਇਆ॥
22.t: oRak bhaalan ge s fer na aaiaa||
22.e: Those who went out to know His bounds could never return.
To know Him, myriads of people have remained wandering in illusions.

22.g: ਆਦੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
22.t: aadh vaddaa visamaadh na a(n)t sunaiaa|
22.e: That primeval Lord is the grand wonder whose mystery cannot be understood by mere listening.
His waves, shades etc are limitless.

22.g: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
22.t: eik kavaau pasaau na alakh lakhaiaa|
22.e: The imperceptible Lord who has created all through His single vibration cannot be perceived.
I am sacrifice unto that creator, whose maya is this creation.
The Guru has made me understand that God alone knows about His own self (none else can know Him).
The Creation
The true Creator as the Truth is pervading one and all.

22.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਪਉਣ ਉਪਾਇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਛਾਇਆ।
22.t: sachahu paun upai ghaT ghaT chhaiaa|
22.e: Out of Truth He created air and (in the form of vital air) is residing in all
From air was created water which always remains humble i.e. it. always moves down wards.
Earth as a raft is made to float on water.
From water emerged fire which spread throughout the whole vegetation.
By virtue of this very fire (heat) the trees became. full of fruits
In this way, air, water and fire were integrated under the order of that primaeval Lord
And thus was this game of creation arranged.
Creation
Flow great is the'truth that it is liked by that true One (God).
How vast is the air that moves in all the four directions.
Fragrance is placed in sandal which makes other trees also fragrant.

22.g: ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਵਾਂਸੁ ਜਲਾਇਆ।
22.t: kheh kheh va(n)s gavai vaa(n)s jalaiaa|
22.e: Bamboos burn by their own friction and destroy their own abode.
The forms of the bodies have become visible y the association of Siva and Sakti.
One distinguishes between the cuckoo and the crow by listening to their voice.
He created the four life-mines and endowed them worthy speech and judiciously gifted breaths.
He made the A's accept the five gross varieties of the (subtle) unstuck Word and thus on the beat of drum He pronounced His supremacy over all.
Qualities of a sadhu
Music, melody, dialogue and knowledge make man a conscious being.
By disciplining the nine gates of the body one is called a sadhu.

22.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
22.t: veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh nij ghar aaiaa|
22.e: Transcending the worldy illusions he stabilizes within his self.
Prior to this, he was running after various practices of hath yoga,
Such as the rechak, purak, kumbhak, tratak, nyolrand bhujarig asan.
He practised different processes of breathing like ire', pirigala and susumna.
He perfected their khechari and chachari postures.
Through such mysterious sport he establishes himself in the equipoise.
Yoga

22.g: ਤ੍ਰੈਸਤੁ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
22.t: traisat a(n)gul lai man pavan milaiaa|
22.e: The breath going ten fingers out the mind is associated with the vital air the practice is completed.
The imperceptible soham (I am He) is ualised in equipoise.
In this state of equipoise, the rare drink of ever-wing cascade is quaffed.

22.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਨਾਦ ਵਜਾਇਆ।
22.t: anahadh dhun liv lai naadh vajaiaa|
22.e: Getting absorbed in the unstruck melody a mysterious sound is heard.
Through silent prayer, one merges in the Suny (Lord)
And in that perfect mental tranquillity egoism is done away with.

22.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ।
22.t: gurmukh piram chakhai nij ghar chhaiaa|
22.e: The gurmukhs drink from the cup of love and establish themselves in their own real self.
Meeting the Guru, the Sikh achieves the perfect completeness.
The Guru and the Sikh
As the lamp is lit from the flame of another lamp;
As sandal's fragrance makes the whole vegetation fragrant
As the water mixing with water acquires the status of trivevi(the confluence of three rivers - Gatiga; Yamuna and Sarasvati);
As air after meeting the vital air becomes unstruck melody;
As a diamond being perforated by another diamond gets stringed into a necklace;
A stone by becoming the philosopher's stone performs its feat and

22.g: ਅਨਲ ਪੰਖ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲਿਆ।
22.t: anal pa(n)kh put hoi pitaa samhaaliaa|
22.e: As an anil bird getting birth in the sky promotes the work of its father;
Likewise the Guru making the Sikh meet the Lord establishes him in the equipoise.
Praises of the Lord
How great is His one vibration which has created the whole expanse of the world!
How big is His weighing hook that it has sustained the whole creation!
Creating crores of universes He has spread around His power of speech.

22.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਅਧਰ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
22.t: lakh lakh dharat agaas adhar dharaiaa|
22.e: Lakhs of earths and skies He kept hanging without support.
Million types of airs, waters and fires He created.
He created the game of eighty four lakhs of species.

22.g: ਜੋਨਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
22.t: jon jon jeea ja(n)t a(n)t na paiaa|
22.e: No end is known of the creatures of even one species.

22.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੯॥
22.t: sir sir lekh likhai alekh dhiaaiaa ||9||
22.e: He has engraved writ on the forehead of all so that they all meditate upon the Lord who is beyond writ.
The way of Gurmukhs
The true Guru has recited (to the disciples) the true name.

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
22.t: gur moorat sach thaau dhiaan dharaiaa|
22.e: Gurmurati,the word of the Guru is the real object to meditate upon.
The holy congregation is such a refuge where the truth adorns the place.
In the court of the true justice, the order of the Lord prevails.
The village (abode) of the Gurmukhs is the truth which has been habitated with the Word (Sabad).
The ego is decimated there and the (pleasure giving) shade of humility is obtained there.
Through the wisdom of Guru (Gurmati) the unbearable truth is instilled into the heart.

22.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
22.t: tis balihaarai jaau su bhaanaa bhaiaa ||10||
22.e: I am sacrifice unto him who loves the Will of the Lord.
Gurmukh, the supreme stage
Gurmukhs accept the will of that Lord as truth and they love His will.
Bowing at the feet of the true Guru, they shed their sense of ego.
As disciples, they please the Guru and the heart of the Gum becomes happy.

22.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਣਾ।
22.t: gurmukh sahaj subhai na alakh lakhaavanaa|
22.e: The gurmukh realises the imperceptible Lord spontaneously.

22.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਿਲ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ।
22.t: gursikh til na tamai kaar kamaavanaa|
22.e: The Sikh of Guru has no greed at all and he earns his livelihood by the labour of his hands.
Merging his consciousness into the word he obeys the commands of the Lord.

22.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲੰਘਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ।
22.t: veeh ikeeh la(n)ghai nij ghar jaavanaa|
22.e: Crossing beyond the worldly illusions he abides in his own real self.

22.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
22.t: gurmukh sukh fal pai sahaj samaavanaa ||11||
22.e: This way, the gurmukhs having attained the pleasure fruit absorb themselves in equipoise.
Guru Angad Dev

22.g: ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ।
22.t: eik guroo ik sikh gurmukh jaaniaa|
22.e: Gurmukhs knew very well about the one Guru (Nanak) and one disciple (Guru Angad).

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ।
22.t: gur chelaa gur sikh sach samaaniaa|
22.e: By becoming the true Sikh of the Guru, this disciple virtually merged himself into the latter.

22.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ।
22.t: so satigur so sikh sabadh vakhaaniaa|
22.e: The true Guru and the disciple were identical (in spirit) and their Word was also one.
This is the wonder of the past and the future that they (both) loved the truth.
They were beyond all accounts and were honour of the humble ones.

22.g: ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਿਖੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ।
22.t: samasar a(n)mirat vikh na aavan jaaniaa|
22.e: For them, the nectar and poison were the same and they had got liberated from the cycle of transmigration
Recorded as the model of special virtues, they are known as the extremely honourable ones.

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਹੈਰਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
22.t: gur sikhahu gur sikh hoi hairaaniaa ||12||
22.e: The wonderful fact is that the sikh of the Guru became the Guru.

22.g: ੧੩ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਨ ਤੇ ਧੂੜ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ
22.t: 13 : gurmukhaa(n) dhe la'chhan te dhooR dhaa prataap
22.e: Virtues of the gurmukhs and the glory of the dust
Gurmukhs drink the unbearable Cup of love filled to the brims and being in the presence of the all;
Pervading Lord they perceive the imperceptible.
The one who resides in all hearts is dwelling in their hearts.
The love creeper of their's has become full of fruits as the seedling of grape turns out to be fruitful vine.
Becoming sandal, they provide coolness to one and all.

22.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦ ਕਪੂਰ ਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਾ।
22.t: cha(n)dhan cha(n)dh kapoor na mel milaavanaa|
22.e: Their cool is like the coolness of sandal, moon, and camphor.
Associating the sun (rajas) with the moon (sattv) they assuage its heat.

22.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ।
22.t: charan kaval dhee dhoor masatak laavanaa|
22.e: They put on their forehead the dust of the lotus feet
And come to know the creator as the root cause of all the causes.
When flame (of knowledge) flashes in their heart, the unstruck melody starts ringing.

22.g: ੧੪ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਣ ਤੇ ਧੂੜ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ
22.t: 14 : gurmukhaa(n) dhe la'chhan te dhooR dhaa prataap
22.e: Virtues of the gurmukhs and the glory of the dust
The power of the one vibration of the Lord transcends all limits.
The wonder and power of Oankft is indescribable.
It is with His support that millions of rivers carrying life water go on flowing.
In His creation, the gurmukhs are known as invaluable diamonds and rubies
And they remain steadfast in gurmati and are accepted with honour in the court of the Lord.
The path of the gurmukhs is straight and clear and they reflect the truth.
Myriad poets desire to know the mystery of His Word.

22.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਜ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀਐ।
22.t: charan kaval raj ghol a(n)mirat vaaneeaai|
22.e: The gurmukhs have quaffed the dust of the feet of Gum like amrit.
This tale is also ineffable.
Waheguru, the wondrous Lord is ineffable

22.g: ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ।
22.t: kaadhar no kurabaan keem na jaaneeaai|
22.e: I am sacrifice unto that creator whose value cannot be estimated.
How could anybody tell how old is He?
What could I tell about the powers of theLord who enhances the honour of the humble ones.

22.g: ਲਖ ਜਿਮੀ ਅਸਮਾਣ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਣੀਐ।
22.t: lakh jimee asamaan til na tulaaneeaai|
22.e: Myriads of earths and skies are not equal to an iota of His.
Millions of universes are wonderstruck to see His power.
He is king of the kings and His ordinance is obvious.
Millions of oceans subsume in His one drop.
Explanations and elaborations pertaining to Him are incomplete (and fake) because His story is ineffable.
Conduct of the gurmukhs
Gurmukhs know well how to move according to the command, hukam of the Lord.
Gurmukh has ordained that community (panth), who moves in the will of Lord.
Becoming contented and true to faith they gratefully thank the Lord.
Gurmukhs perceive His wondrous sport.
They behave innocently like children and eulogize the primaeval Lord.
They merge their consciousness in the holy congregation and truth do they love.
Identifying the word they get liberated and
Loosing their sense of ego they perceive their inner selves.
Glory of the true Guru
The dynamism of the Guru is unmanifest and unfathomable.

22.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਣੀਐ।
22.t: gahir ga(n)bheer athaeh haath na aaneeaai|
22.e: It is so deep and sublime that its extent cannot be known.
As from each drop become many tumultuous rivulets,
Likewise the ever-growing glory of gurmukhs becomes ineffable.
His shores near and far cannot be known and He is adorned in infinite ways.
The comings and goings cease after entering the court of the Lord i.e. one becomes liberated from the bondage of  transmigration.
The true Guru is totally carefree yet He is the power of the powerless ones.
Blessed is the true Guru, seeing whom all feel wonderstruck
Holy congregation is the abode of truth
Holy congregation is the abode of truth where gurmukhs go to reside.
Gurmukhs adore the grand and powerful true name (of the Lord).
There skillfully they enhance their inner flame (of knowledge).

22.g: ਸੋਧਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ।
22.t: sodh ddiThaa brahama(n)dd lavai na laieeaai|
22.e: Having seen the whole universe I have found that none reaches His grandeur.

22.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ।
22.t: tis naahee jam dda(n)dd saran samaieeaai|
22.e: He who has come to the shelter of the holy congregation has no longer the fear of death.

22.g: ਘੋਰ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਖੰਡੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ।
22.t: ghor paap kar kha(n)dd narak na paieeaai|
22.e: Even the horrible sins are decimated and one escapes going to the hell.
As the rice comes out of husk, similarly whosoever goes to the holy congregation gets liberated.
There, homogenous truth prevails and falsehood remains far behind.
Conduct of the gursikhs
Bravo to the Sikhs of Gum who have refined their lives.
The right living of the Sikhs of the Guru is that they love the Guru.
Gurumukhs remember the name of the Lord with every breath and every morsel.
Epudiating pride they remain detached amidst maya.
Gurmukhs consider hemselves as the servant of the servants and service only is their true conduct.
Pondering upon the Word, they remain neutral towards hopes.

22.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਮਨ ਹਠ ਮਾਰਿਆ।
22.t: gurmukh sahaj nivaas man haTh maariaa|
22.e: Eschewing stubbornness of mind, gurmukhs reside in equipoise.
Enlightened  of gurmukhs salvages many a fallen one.
Conduct of the gurmukhs
Those gurmukhs are acclaimed who have found the true Guru.
Practising the Word, they have emancipated their whole families.
Gurmukhs have the Will of God and they work according to the truth.
Eschewing ego, they obtain the door of liberation.
The gurmukhs have made the mind understand the principle of altruism.
The base of gurmukhs is truth and they (finally) get absorbd into truth.
Gurmukhs are not scared of public opinion
And this way they visualise that imperceptible Lord.
Nature of the gurmukhs
Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of gurmukh all the eight metals transform into gold i.e. all the people become pure.

22.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਣਾ।
22.t: asaT dhaat ik dhaat paaras parasanaa|
22.e: Like the fragrance of sandal they permeate all the trees i.e. they adopt one and all as their own.
They are like Ganges in which all the rivers and rivulets merge and become full of vitality.
Gurmukhs re the swans of Manasamvar who are not perturbed by other cravings.

22.g: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਰਸਣਾ।
22.t: maan sarovar ha(n)s na tirasanaa tarasanaa|
22.e: The Sikhs of the Guru are the paramharisas, the swans of the highest order
So do not mix up with ordinary ones and their sight is not easily available.
Craving reposed in the shelter of Guru, even the so called untouchables become honourable.
The company of the holy, forms the regime of Truth everlasing.

23.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
23.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
23.e: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

23.g: ੧ : ਮੰਗਲਾਚਰਨ ਗੁਰੂ
23.t: 1 : ma(n)galaacharan guroo
23.e: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

23.g: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
23.t: sat roop gur dharasano pooran braham acharaj dhikhaiaa|
23.e: The glimpse of the Guru (Nanak Dev) is in the form of truth which has brought me face to face with the perfect and wondrous

23.g: ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
23.t: satinaam karataa purakh paarabraham paramesar dhiaaiaa|
23.e: Bestowing upon the people the mantra of true Name and the creator Lord, he has made the people remember the transcendent B

23.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
23.t: satigur sabadh giaan sach anahadh dhun visamaadh sunaiaa|
23.e: The knowledge of truth is the Word of the Guru, through which the wonder inspiring unstruck melody is heard.

23.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ।
23.t: gurmukh pa(n)th chalaion naam dhaan isanaan dhiraRaiaa|
23.e: Initiating the gurmukh-panth, (Sikhism, the highway for gurmukhs) the Guru inspired one and all to be steadfastly absorbed

23.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
23.t: gur sikh dhe gur sikh kar saadhasa(n)gat sachukha(n)dd vasaiaa|
23.e: Educating the people and making them his disciples, the Gum has founded holy congregation, the abode of truth.

23.g: ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
23.t: sach raas raharaas dhe satigur sikh dhe pairee paiaa|
23.e: Handing over the capital of truth to the people, the Guru made them bow at the (lotus) feet (of the Lord).

23.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
23.t: charan kaval prataap janaiaa ||1||
23.e: He made people understand the glory of the feet (of the Lord).

23.g: ੨ : ਤੀਰਥ ਸਾਧੂ
23.t: 2 : teerath saadhoo
23.e: Pilgrimage centres and sadhus

23.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਨ੍ਹਾਤੈ ਪਾਪ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
23.t: teerath nhaatai paap jaan patit udhaaran naau dharaiaa|
23.e: Since the sins are obliterated at the pilgrimage centres, people have ven them the Name of uplifters of the fallen ones.

23.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਹੋਨ ਸਕਾਰਥੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
23.t: teerath hon sakaarathe saadh janaa(n) dhaa dharasan paiaa|
23.e: But pilgrimage centres ecome meaningful only by the sight of the sadhus there.

23.g: ਸਾਧ ਹੋਏ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਿਕੈ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
23.t: saadh hoe man saadhikai charan kaval gur chit vasaiaa|
23.e: Sadhus are they, ho having disciplined the mind have put it in the lotus feet of the Guru. ory of sadhu is unfathomable and

23.g: ਉਪਮਾ ਸਾਧ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕੋਟ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਸਾਧੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
23.t: aupamaa saadh agaadh bodh koT madhe ko saadh sunaiaa|
23.e: One out of crores may be d to be a (true) sadhu.

23.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਗਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਥਾਇ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।

23.e: However sadhus in the form of the Sikhs of Guru anak) are innumerable because the dharamscias, holy centres, flourish erywh

23.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਵਣੇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਪੁਜਾਇਆ।
23.t: pairee pai pair dhovane charanodhak lai pair pujaiaa|
23.e: People bowing at the feet of the Sikhs of the Guru take wash ectar of their feet and worship the same.

23.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
23.t: gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakhaiaa ||2||
23.e: Gurmukh has had the glimpse the imperceptible Lord and pleasure fruit there of.

23.t: 3 : dhooRee
23.e: Dust

23.g: ਪੰਜਿ ਤਤ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਕਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
23.t: pa(n)j tat utapat kar gurmukh dharatee aap gavaiaa|
23.e: Cultivating the virtues of all the five elements in their hearts, the gurmukhs like earth have lost the sense of ego.

23.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ।
23.t: charan kaval saranaagatee sabh nidhaan sabhe fal paiaa|
23.e: They have come to the shelter of the Guru's feet and from that store - house they get all sorts of benefits.

23.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂੜਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
23.t: lok vedh gur giaan vich saadhoo dhooR jagat taraiaa|
23.e: From convention and the knowledge given by the Guru also the same (conclusion) emerges that the dust of the (feet of) sadh

23.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਾਇਕੈ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
23.t: patit puneet karaikai paavan purakh pavitr karaiaa|
23.e: The fallen ones are made meritorious and the meritorious ones are further transformed into sacred ones.

23.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਮਿਤ ਸੇਖ ਸਹਸ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
23.t: charanodhak mahimaa amit sekh sahas mukh a(n)t na paiaa|

23.g: ਧੂੜੀ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
23.t: dhooRee lekh miTaiaa charanodhak man vasigat aaiaa|
23.e: Eulogizing the Lord by its many a mouth could not know it. The dust of sadhu's feet has erased all debts and because of that feet-wash nectar, the mind has also come under control.

23.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
23.t: pairee pai jag charanee laiaa ||3||
23.e: Gurmukh first himself bowed at the feet and then he made the whole world fall at his feet.

23.g: ੪ : ਗੰਗਾ ਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
23.t: 4 : ga(n)gaa dhe dhirashaTaa(n)t to(n) upadhesh
23.e: Teachings from the example of Ganges

23.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ।
23.t: charanodhak hoi surasaree taj baiku(n)Th dharat vich aaiee|
23.e: Ganges, the wash of the Lords' feet, left heavens and came down to arth.

23.g: ਨਉ ਸੈ ਨਦੀ ਨੜਿੰਨਵੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
23.t: nau sai nadhee naRi(n)navai aThasaTh teerath a(n)g samaiee|
23.e: Nine hundred ninety nine rivers and sixty eight pilgrimage centres erged in it.

23.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਲੈ ਸੀਸ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈ।
23.t: tih loiee paravaan hai mahaadhev lai sees chaRhaiee|
23.e: In all the three worlds, it is accepted as authentic and Mahadev ,iva) has borne it on his head.

23.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
23.t: dhevee dhev sarevadhe jai jai kaar vaddee vaddiaaiee|
23.e: Gods and goddesses all worship it and hail s greatness.

23.g: ਸਣੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਾਥਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
23.t: san ga(n)gaa baiku(n)Th lakh lakh baiku(n)Th naath liv laiee|
23.e: Myriads of heavens and the master of heavens including the ranges, absorbed in meditation declare,

23.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
23.t: saadhoo dhooR dhula(n)bh hai saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee|
23.e: That the dust of the feet of sadhu is rare and is obtainable only by coming under the shelter of the true Guru.

23.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦਲ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
23.t: charan kaval dhal keem na paiee ||4||
23.e: Value of even the one petal of the lotus feet is beyond assessment.

23.g: ੫ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ
23.t: 5 : gurmukhaa(n) dhe sukh fal dhee vaddiaaiee
23.e: Grandeur of the pleasure -fruit of gurmukhs

23.g: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਲਖ ਕਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
23.t: charan saran jis lakhamee lakh kalaa hoi lakhee na jaiee|
23.e: Lakhs of invisible powers adorn the shelter of the feet of goddess of wealth (Laksmi);

23.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਈ।

23.e: All the four vamas, six philosophies, celebates, suttees and nine maths have been made to bow by her.

23.g: ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਅ ਚੌਦਹ ਭਵਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਈ।
23.t: ti(n)n loa chauadheh bhavan jal thal maheeal chhal kar chhaiee|
23.e: Deceptively she is pervading all the three worlds, fourteen abodes, land, sea and the nether worlds.

23.g: ਕਵਲਾਸਣੁ ਕਵਲਾਪਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਈ।
23.t: kavalaasan kavalaapatee saadhasa(n)gat saranaagat aaiee|
23.e: That goddess Kamala (Laksmi) alongwith her husband (Visnu) seeks the shelter of holy congregation

23.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi aap gavai na aap ganaiee|
23.e: Wherein the gurmukhs bowing at the feet of holy persons have lost their ego and still have kept themselves unnoticed.

23.t: gurmukh sukh fal vaddee vaddiaaiee ||5||
23.e: The grandeur of the pleasure-fruit of the gurmukhs is very great.

23.e: Assuming the form of Vaman (short statured brahmin) and remaining unsuccessful in beguiling king Bali

23.e: In two steps He measured all the three worlds and in a half step He measured the body of king Bali.

23.e: Accepting the kingdom of netherworld better than heavens Bali started ruling it.

23.e: They also contemplate the feet of the Guru in the company of holy ones.

23.e: Parsu Ram remained devoid of the delight of the lotus feet

23.e: A king named Sahasrbahu came to Jamadagni rishi as a guest.

23.e: Seeing wish-ful-filling cow with the rishi he became greedy and killed Jamdagni.

23.g: ਪਿਟਦੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਪਰਸਰਾਮ ਧਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ।

23.e: Hearing the wails of Renuka, his mother, Parana Ram came running to her.

23.e: Becoming full of anger he cleared this earth of the kshatriyas twenty-one time i.e. he killed all the kashatriyas.

23.e: Only those who fell at the feet of Parasu Rim were saved; none else could raise arms against him.

23.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਆ ਚਿਰੰਜੀਵ ਹੁਇ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
23.t: haumai maar na sakeeaa chira(n)jeev hui aap janaiaa|

23.e: He always made show of his ego and could never receive the pollen of the lotus feet (of Lord).

23.t: 8 : raam cha(n)dhr to(n) dhooRee dhaa upadhesh
23.e: From Ramchandr teachings of dust of feet

23.e: In their exultations they were planning as to what should be the name of their son yet to be born.

23.g: ਘਰਿ ਅਸਾੜੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਉ ਕਿ ਧਰੀਐ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੇ।
23.t: ghar asaaRai put hoi naau k dhareeaai baalak baale|
23.e: They thought that the name should be Ram Chandr because just reciting the name of Ram

23.t: raam cha(n)dh naau lai(n)dhiaa(n) ti(n)n hatiaa te hoi niraale|
23.e: They would get rid of three killings (embroy and its parents murder).

23.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਪਰਵਾਣ ਜਗਿ ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਧਰਮ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ।

23.e: The Ram Rai (kingdom of Ram) in which truth, contentement and dharma were protected,

23.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਬਸਿਸਟੁ ਬਹਾਲੇ।
23.t: maiaa vich udhaas hoi sunai puraan basisaT bahaale|
23.e: Was acknowledged throughout the world. Rim remained detached from maya and sitting near Vasisth listened to the tales of th

23.g: ਰਾਮਾਇਣੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਾ ਤਰੀ ਪਗ ਛੁਹਿ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ।
23.t: raamain varataiaa silaa taree pag chhuh tatakaale|
23.e: Through the Rtimayatt people came to know that the stone (Ahalya) was restored to life by the touch of the feet of Rim.

23.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥੮॥
23.t: saadhasa(n)gat pag dhooR nihaale ||8||
23.e: That Ram also fell happy to attain the dust of the congregations of the sadhus (and went to forest to wash the feet of anch

23.g: ੯ : ਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ ਚੰਦਾਵਤਾਰ
23.t: 9 : kirashan cha(n)dhaavataar
23.e: Krsnachandravatar

23.g: ਕਿਸਨ ਲੈ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਮਹਮਾ ਦਸਮ ਸਕੰਧੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
23.t: kisan lai avataar jag mahamaa dhasam saka(n)dh vakhaanai|
23.e: The tenth chapter of the Bhagavat defines the glory of incarnation of Krsna in the world.

23.g: ਲੀਲਾ ਚਲਤ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ।
23.t: leelaa chalat acharaj kar jog bhog ras raleeaa maanai|
23.e: He performed many wonderful acts of bhog (merriment) and yoga (renunciation).

23.g: ਮਹਾ ਭਾਰਥੁ ਕਰਵਾਇਓਨੁ ਕੈਰੋ ਪਾਂਡੋ ਕਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
23.t: mahaa bhaarath karavaion kairo paa(n)ddo kar hairaanai|
23.e: Making Kauravs (sons of Dhrttrastr) and Pandays to fight against each other he further made them wonder struck.

23.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਿਤਿ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
23.t: ei(n)dhraadhik brahamaadhikaa mahimaa mit mirajaadh na jaanai|
23.e: Indr and Brahma et al. donot know the limits of his grandeur.

23.g: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਟਹਲਾ ਵੰਡਿ ਕੈ ਜਗਿ ਰਾਜਸੂ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੈ।

23.e: When Raisfiy was arranged by Yudhisthar, all were alloted their duties.

23.g: ਮੰਗ ਲਈ ਹਰਿ ਟਹਲ ਏਹ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਮਾਣੈ।
23.t: ma(n)g liee har Tahal eh pair dhoi charanodhak maanai|
23.e: Krsna himself tookover the duty of washing of the feet of all so that through this service

23.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥੯॥
23.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sin(j)aanai ||9||
23.e: He could realise the importance of the service of the holy congregation and the Word of the Guru.

23.g: ੧੦ : ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੁਲਭ ਚਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਰਲੱਭ
23.t: 10 : avataar sulabh charan gur dhurala'bh
23.e: Invocation of Lord is easily available but the feet of Guru are rare ,

23.g: ਮਛ ਰੂਪ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਾਰਥੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਉਧਾਰੇ।
23.t: machh roop avataar dhar purakhaarath kar vedh udhaare|
23.e: It is said that in the form of (great) fish Vista' incarnated himself and by his valour salvaged the Vedas.

23.g: ਕਛੁ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਇ ਅਵਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਥਿ ਜਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਸਾਰੇ।
23.t: kachh roop hui avatare saagar math jag ratan pasaare|
23.e: Then in the form of tortoise he churned the ocean and brought jewels out of it.

23.g: ਤੀਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਹ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ।
23.t: teejaa kar bairaeh roop dharat udhaaree dhait sa(n)ghaare|
23.e: In the form of third incarnation Virah, he decimated demons and liberated the earth.

23.g: ਚਉਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਸੁਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਉਬਾਰੇ।
23.t: chauthaa kar narasi(n)gh roop asur maar prahilaadh ubaare|
23.e: In fourth incarnation he assumed the form of man-lion andeicilling demon (Hiranyakasipu) saved Prahalid.

23.g: ਇਕਸੈ ਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਲਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ।
23.t: eikasai hee brahama(n)dd vich dhas avataar le aha(n)kaare|
23.e: Incarnating ten times in this one world Vismi also became egotist.

23.g: ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਲੂੰਅ ਲੂੰਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੰਜਾਰੇ।
23.t: kar brahama(n)dd karoR jin loo(n)a loo(n)a a(n)dhar sa(n)jaare|
23.e: But, the Lord Oankar who has subsumed crores of worlds

23.g: ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਇਵੇਹਿਆ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਸਵਾਰੇ।
23.t: lakh karoR ivehiaa oa(n)kaar akaar savaare|
23.e: In His each trichome has managed myriads of such individuals.

23.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
23.t: charan kamal gur agam apaare ||10||
23.e: Nevertheless, the lotus feet of Guru are unapproachable and beyond all limits.

23.g: ੧੧ : ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ
23.t: 11 : charan gur sabh to(n) sreshaT
23.e: Feet of Guru are the best ones

23.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਭ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ।
23.t: saasatr vedh puraan sabh sun sun aakhan aakh sunaavah|
23.e: Having listened to the Shastras, Vedas and Puranas people further recite and listen to them.

23.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਲਖ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ।
23.t: raag naadh sa(n)geet lakh anahadh dhun sun sun gun gaavah|
23.e: Millions of people listen to the rag-nod (musical measures)and the unstrucke melody and sing the same.

23.g: ਸੇਖ ਨਾਗ ਲਖ ਲੋਮਸਾ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਿਵਲਾਵਹਿ।
23.t: sekh naag lakh lomasaa abigat gat a(n)dhar livalaavah|
23.e: SesanEg and millions of Lomas rishis concentrate to know the dynamism of that unmanifest Lord.

23.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ।
23.t: brahame bisan mahes lakh giaan dhiaan til a(n)t na paavah|
23.e: Millions of Brahma, Visnus and Sivas who concentrate upon and talk of Him, are still ignorant about even an iota of His mys

23.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਪੁਜਾਵਹਿ।
23.t: dhevee dhev sarevadhe alakh abhev na sev pujaavah|
23.e: Gods and goddesses adore that Lord but their service does not take them to His mystery.

23.g: ਗੋਰਖ ਨਾਥ ਮਛੰਦ੍ਰ ਲਖ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧਿ ਨੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ।
23.t: gorakh naath machha(n)dhr lakh saadhik sidh net kar dhiaavah|
23.e: Millions of Machhendr näths (Matsyendranath), Gorakhnaths and the siddhs (the ascetics of high orders) concentrate upon Him through their yogic practices (of dhautr and neti etc).

23.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
23.t: charan kamal gur agam alaaveh ||11||
23.e: They all declare the feet of Guru as unapproachable

23.g: ੧੨ : ਊਚ ਆਦਰ ਯੋਗ ਨਹੀਂ
23.t: 12 : uooch aadhar yog nahee(n)
23.e: The higher one is alone is not respectable

23.g: ਮਥੈ ਤਿਵੜੀ ਬਾਮਣੈ ਸਉਹੇ ਆਏ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਫੇਰੀ।
23.t: mathai tivaRee baamanai sauhe aae masalat feree|
23.e: If going out doors one comes across a brahmin (who is proud of his high caste in India), the traditional people consider it

23.g: ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਵਲ ਦੇ ਪਗ ਵਲਾਏ ਡੇਰੀ।
23.t: sir uchaa aha(n)kaar kar val dhe pag valaae dderee|
23.e: The head being proud of its high place is tied with turban.

23.g: ਅਖੀਂ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ।
23.t: akhee(n) mool na poojeean kar kar vekhan meree teree|
23.e: Eyes are also not adored because they see with the sense of duality.

23.g: ਨਕੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਜਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਮਰੋੜੀ ਮਣੀ ਘਨੇਰੀ।
23.t: nak na koiee poojadhaa khai maroRee manee ghaneree|
23.e: Nose is also not worshipped because on seeing a low person the nose is turned up to show disdain.

23.g: ਉਚੇ ਕੰਨ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਭਲੇਰੀ।
23.t: auche ka(n)n na poojeean usatat ni(n)dhaa bhalee bhaleree|
23.e: Though placed higher, the ears are also not worshipped because they listen to the eulogy as well as slander.

23.g: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੀਭ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁ ਚਖੀ ਦੰਦ ਘੇਰੀ।
23.t: bolahu jeebh na poojeeaai ras kas bahu chakhee dha(n)dh gheree|
23.e: Tongue is also not worshipped because it is also surrounded by teeth and tastes both edibles and inedibles.

23.g: ਨੀਵੇ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜ ਹਥ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
23.t: neeve charan pooj hath keree ||12||
23.e: Only because of being the lowest, the feet are touched with hands in worshipful reverence.

23.g: ੧੩ : ਬੱਕਰੀ ਦੇ ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
23.t: 13 : ba'karee dhe ala(n)kaar to(n) upadhesh
23.e: Lesson from Goat

23.g: ਹਸਤਿ ਅਖਾਜੁ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਹੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਖਾਈ।
23.t: hasat akhaaj gumaan kar seeh sataanaa koi na khaiee|
23.e: The proud elephant is inedible and none eats the mighty lion.

23.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਬਕਰੀ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ।
23.t: hoi nimaanee bakaree dheen dhunee vaddiaaiee paiee|
23.e: Goat is humble and hence it is respected everywhere.

23.g: ਮਰਣੈ ਪਰਣੈ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਗਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਾਈ।
23.t: maranai paranai ma(n)neeaai jag bhog paravaan karaiee|
23.e: On occasions of death, joy, marriage, yajna, etc only its meat dis accepted.

23.g: ਮਾਸੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਨੋ ਆਂਦਹੁ ਤਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਵਜਾਈ।
23.t: maas pavitr girahasat no aa(n)dhahu taar veechaar vajaiee|
23.e: Among the householders its meat is acknowledged as sacred and with its gut stringed instruments are made.

23.g: ਚਮੜੇ ਦੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਤੀਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਲਿਵਲਾਈ।
23.t: chamaRe dheeaa kar juteeaa saadhoo charan saran livalaiee|
23.e: From its leather the shoes are made to be used by the saints merged in their meditation upon the Lord.

23.g: ਤੂਰ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਮੜੀਦੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
23.t: toor pakhaavaj maReedhe keeratan saadhasa(n)gat sukhadhaiee|
23.e: Drums are mounted by its skin and then in the holy congregation the delight-giving kirtan, eulogy of the Lord, is sung.

23.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
23.t: saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee ||13||
23.e: In fact, going to the holy congregation is the same as going to the shelter of the true Guru.

23.g: ੧੪ : ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ
23.t: 14 : maanas dhehee
23.e: Human body

23.g: ਸਭ ਸਰੀਰ ਅਕਾਰਥੇ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ।
23.t: sabh sareer akaarathe at apavitr su maanas dhehee|
23.e: All the bodies are useful but the human body is the most useless and defiled one.

23.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਹੁਇ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਕਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਇਵੇਹੀ।
23.t: bahu bi(n)jan misaTaan paan hui mal mootr kasootr ivehee|
23.e: In its company many a delicious food, sweet etc change into urine and faeces.

23.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਵਿਗੜਦੇ ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਕੁਸੰਗ ਸਨੇਹੀ।
23.t: paaT paTa(n)bar vigaRadhe paan kapoor kusa(n)g sanehee|
23.e: In its evil company silken robes, betel, comphor etc. also get spoiled.

23.g: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੁਰੇਹੀ।
23.t: choaa cha(n)dhan aragajaa hui dhuraga(n)dh suga(n)dh hurehee|
23.e: Sandal scent, and joss sticks etc also get converted into fowl smell.

23.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਂਵਦੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਖਹਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ।
23.t: raaje raaj kamaa(n)vadhe paatisaeh kheh mue sabhe hee|
23.e: Kings rule gheir kingdoms and die of their fights with one another.

23.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹ ਇਵੇਹੀ।
23.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur saran vin nihafal maanas dheh ivehee|
23.e: Withoug going to the holy congregation and to the shelter of Guru, this human body is also fruitless.

23.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ਜੇਹੀ ॥੧੪॥
23.t: charan saran masakeenee jehee ||14||
23.e: Only that body is meaningful which has come to the Guru's fold in humility

23.g: ੧੫ : ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ
23.t: 15 : bhagataa(n) dhe naam
23.e: Names of the devotees--bhagats

23.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ।
23.t: gurmukh sukh fal paiaa saadhasa(n)gat gursaranee aae|
23.e: Those gurmukhs who have gone into the shelter of the holy congretation have attained the pleasure fruit.

23.g: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਏ।
23.t: dhraoo prahilaadh vakhaaneean a(n)bareek bal bhagat sabaae|
23.e: These devotees are Dhruv, Prahalad, Ambaris, Bali, Janak, Jaidev, Valmilci et al.

23.g: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜਗਿ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਤਰਾਏ।
23.t: sanakaadhik jaidheau jag baalameek satisa(n)g taraae|
23.e: They have gone across through the holy congregation. Bent, Trilochan, Namdev, Dhanna,

23.g: ਬੇਣੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਧੰਨਾ ਸਧਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾਏ।
23.t: ben tilochan naamadheau dha(n)naa sadhanaa bhagat sadhaae|
23.e: Sadhana have also been called saints. Kabir is accepted as bhagat, the devotee, and Ravidas,

23.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਜਨ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ।
23.t: bhagat kabeer vakhaaneeaai jan ravidhaas bidhar gur bhaae|
23.e: Vidur et al. have also been loved by the Lord. Whether born in high or the low caste,

23.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ।
23.t: jaat ajaat sanaat vich gurmukh charan kaval chit laae|
23.e: The gurmukh who has adopted the lotus feet in his heart,

23.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਏ ॥੧੫॥
23.t: haumai maaree pragaTee aae ||15||
23.e: Decimating his ego has come to be known (as devotee).

23.g: ੧੬ : ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਫਕੜ
23.t: 16 : hi(n)dhoo musalamaanaa(n) dhee fakaR
23.e: Fruitilty of Hindus and muslims

23.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਦਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
23.t: lok vedh sun aakhadhaa sun sun giaanee giaan vakhaanai|
23.e: The so - called knowledgeable persons having listened to the Vedas as their knowledge about the world on the basis of hears

23.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਲੋਕ ਸਣੁ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਤ ਪਤਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
23.t: surag lok san maat lok sun sun saat pataal na jaanai|
23.e: The  also learn about heavens, mother earth and all the seven odds, but still they donot know the real truth.

23.g: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਨ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
23.t: bhoot bhavikh na varatamaan aadh madh a(n)t hoe hairaanai|
23.e: Neither do they hand the past future and the present, nor the mystery of the beginning middle, but are simply wonderstruck

23.g: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਮ ਨੀਚ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਝਿ ਨ ਸਕਣਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
23.t: autam madham neech hoi samajh na sakan choj viddaanai|
23.e: Through their classifications medium and low varnas they cannot understand the great play.

23.g: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣ ਆਖਾਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
23.t: raj gun tam gun aakheeaai sat gun sun aakhaan vakhaanai|
23.e: Engrossed in actions (rajoguni), inertia (tamoguni) and tranquillity (satoguni) also talk and listen,

23.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਸਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
23.t: man bach karam s bharamadhe saadhasa(n)gat satigur na sin(j)aanai|
23.e: But without understanding the holy nation and the true Guru, they wander through the activities of their eech and actions.

23.g: ਫਕੜ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੬॥
23.t: fakaR hi(n)dhoo musalamaanai ||16||
23.e: Thus the (classifications of) Muslims and Hindus

23.g: ੧੭ : ਜੁੱਗਾਂ ਦੇ ਧਰਮ
23.t: 17 : ju'gaa(n) dhe dharam
23.e: Duties of the yugs --the Time periods

23.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਫੜਿ ਦੇਸੁ ਪੀੜਾਏ।
23.t: satijug ik vigaaRadhaa tis pichhai faR dhes peeRaae|
23.e: In the Satyug the whole country suffered because of the evil deeds of one wrong-doer.

23.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਵਗਲੀਐ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਹਮਾਏ।
23.t: tretai nagaree vagaleeaai dhuaapar va(n)s narak sahamaae|
23.e: In Tretia the whole city was surrounded and in Dvapar, the whole family was to suffer hell.

23.g: ਜੋ ਫੇੜੈ ਸੋ ਫੜੀਦਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਾਏ।
23.t: jo feRai so faReedhaa kalijug sachaa niaau karaae|
23.e: The justice of Kaliyug is true because only he suffers who does the evil deeds.

23.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਸਤੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਜੁਗਾ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿੜਾਏ।
23.t: satijug sat tretai jugaa dhuaapar poojaa chaar dhiRaae|
23.e: In Satyug, the truth, in Treta- the yajti, in Dvapar ritualistic worship were accomplished.

23.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਹੋਰ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ।
23.t: kalijug naau araadhanaa hor karam kar mukat na paae|
23.e: In Kaliyug through no action other than constant remembering the Lord's name could attain liberation.

23.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਲੁਣੀਐ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ।
23.t: jug jug luneeaai beejiaa paap pu(n)n kar dhukh sukh paae|
23.e: In all the yugs (ages) the individual reaps what he has sown and earns sufferings and delights in accordance with his demer

23.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਪਹੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਏ।
23.t: kalijug chitavai pu(n)n fal paapahu lep adharam kamaae|
23.e: In Kaliyug, the individual desires to have the fruits of meritorious actions though he remains absorbed in the sinful deeds

23.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧੭॥
23.t: gurmukh sukh fal aap gavaae ||17||
23.e: Gurmukhs attain the pleasure fruit only by losing their sense of ego

23.g: ੧੮ : ਧਰਮ ਧਉਲ ਦਾ ਅਲੰਕਾਰ
23.t: 18 : dharam dhaul dhaa ala(n)kaar
23.e: Example of the Dharma Bull

23.g: ਸਤਜੁਗ ਦਾ ਅਨਿਆਉ ਵੇਖਿ ਧਉਲ ਧਰਮ ਹੋਆ ਉਡੀਣਾ।
23.t: satajug dhaa aniaau vekh dhaul dharam hoaa uddeenaa|
23.e: Seeing the injustice of Satyug, dharma in the form of a bull got sad.

23.g: ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਨਿ ਬਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣਾ।
23.t: surapat narapat chakravai rakh na ha(n)ghan bal mat heenaa|
23.e: Even the king of gods, Indr, and other kings with vast empires, engrossed egoism, devoid of power and wisdom could not sust

23.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਪੈਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜੁਗ ਥਾਪਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ।
23.t: trete khisiaa pair ik hom jag jug thaap pateenaa|
23.e: In Treta- its one foot slipped and now religious people started feeling satisfied by mere performance of the ceremonies of

23.g: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮ ਦੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਚਾਰ ਪਖੰਡੁ ਅਲੀਣਾ।
23.t: dhuaapur dhui pag dharam dhe poojaa chaar pakha(n)dd aleenaa|
23.e: In Dvapar remained only two feet of dharma and now people began to remain absorbed only ritualistic worship.

23.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੈਰ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਧਰਮ ਅਧੀਣਾ।
23.t: kalijug rahiaa pair ik hoi nimaanaa dharam adheenaa|
23.e: In Kaliyug, the dharma has only one feet and consequently has become quite feeble.

23.g: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਟ ਪਰਬੀਣਾ।
23.t: maan nimaanai satiguroo saadhasa(n)gat paragaT parabeenaa|
23.e: True Guru, the power of the powerless, has made it (dharma) manifest by and through creating the holy Icongretgations.

23.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਧਰਮ ਸਪੂਰਣੁ ਰੀਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
23.t: gurmukh dharam sapooran reenaa ||18||
23.e: The gurmukhs have brought to perfection the dharma earlier reduced to dust.

23.g: ੧੯ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪੰਥ
23.t: 19 : gurmukh pa(n)th
23.e: The gurmukh-wayfarer

23.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਾਪੈ।
23.t: chaar varan ik varan kar varan avaran saadhasa(n)g jaapai|
23.e: Since the true Guru integrated all the four varnas into one, this assemblage of varnas has come to be known as the holy con

23.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਥਾਪੈ।
23.t: chhia rutee chhia dharasanaa gurmukh dharasan sooraj thaapai|
23.e: Among six seasons and six philosophies, the Gurmukh-philosophy has been established like the Sun (among the planets).

23.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਵਡਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ।
23.t: baareh pa(n)th miTai kai gurmukh pa(n)th vaddaa parataapai|
23.e: Wiping out all the twelve ways (of yogis) the Guru has created the mighty Gurmukh-way (panth).

23.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਲਾਪੈ।
23.t: vedh katebahu baaharaa anahadh sabadh aga(n)m alaapai|
23.e: This panth keeps itself away from the boundaries of the Vedas and the Katebas and always remembers as well as sings the uns

23.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਪਛਾਪੈ।
23.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi gursikhaa raharaas pachhaapai|
23.e: On this Way of absolute humility and becoming dust of the feet of the Gum, the disciple learns the right conduct.

23.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਜਪੈ ਅਜਾਪੈ।
23.t: maiaa vich udhaas kar aap gavaae japai ajaapai|
23.e: This panth remains detached amidst maya and obliterating the sense of ego remembers the Lord spontaneously i.e. always rema

23.g: ਲੰਘ ਨਿਕਥੈ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ ॥੧੯॥
23.t: la(n)gh nikathai varai saraapai ||19||
23.e: It has gone far beyond the influence of boons and curses.

23.g: ੨੦ : ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕ ਬਰਾਬਰ
23.t: 20 : raajaa ra(n)k baraabar
23.e: The King and the poor are equal

23.g: ਮਿਲਦੇ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਦੁਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮਾਲੇਕੀ।
23.t: miladhe musalamaan dhui mil mil karan salaamaalekee|
23.e: When two Muslims meet they greet each other by saying `Salam' (salamalaikum).

23.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਦੇਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੀ।
23.t: jogee karan adhes mil aadh purakh aadhes visekhee|
23.e: When yogis meet they exchange Wes" salute to that ,primaeval Lord.

23.g: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਓਨਮੋ ਓਨਮ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੀ।
23.t: sa(n)niaasee kar onamo onam naarain bahu bhekhee|
23.e: Sannyasis of different garbs say 'On namah', 'om namah narayanah'.

23.g: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਆਸੀਰ ਵਚਨ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਖੀ।
23.t: baamhan no kar namasakaar kar aaseer vachan muh dhekhee|
23.e: When one bows before a brahmin, he also in view of the station of the person gives blessings accordingly.

23.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪਵਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਸਰੇਖੀ।
23.t: pairee pavanaa satiguroo gur sikhaa raharaas sarekhee|
23.e: Among the Sikhs, on meeting, the tradition of salulation by touching feet is there, and this is the best one.

23.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਿਮੇਖੀ।
23.t: raajaa ra(n)k baraabaree baalak biradh na bhedh nimekhee|
23.e: In this act the king and the poor are equal and no distinction of young and old is observed.

23.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਭਗਤਾ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੀ ॥੨੦॥
23.t: cha(n)dhan bhagataa roop na rekhee ||20||
23.e: The devotees like sandal wood make no discrimination (while spreading their fragrance).

23.g: ੨੧ : ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
23.t: 21 : ni(n)mrataa dhe dhirashaTaa(n)t
23.e: Examples of humilty

23.g: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ।
23.t: neechahu neech sadhaavanaa gur upadhes kamaavai koiee|
23.e: Any rare one practises the Guru's teaching of calling oneself the lowest among the lowly ones.

23.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਵੀਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੰਮ ਲੈ ਇਕੁ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਹੋਛਾ ਹੋਈ।
23.t: trai veehaa(n) dhe dha(n)m lai ik rupieeaa hochhaa hoiee|
23.e: When a rupee is changed into sixty paisas, its power is scattered and it becames weak.

23.g: ਦਸੀ ਰੁਪਯੀਂ ਲਈਦਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਨਈਆ ਹਉਲਾ ਸੋਈ।
23.t: dhasee rupayee(n) lieedhaa ik sunieeaa haulaa soiee|
23.e: If gold-muhar (coin) is changed for ten rupees, it loses its value.

23.g: ਸਹਸ ਸੁਨਈਏ ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਯੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਰ ਪਰੋਈ।
23.t: sahas sunie'ee mul kar layai heeraa haar paroiee|
23.e: And if a diamond is obtained for one thousand coins, it becomes so light that it is stringed in a necklace (and is worn).

23.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਈ।
23.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi man bach karam bharam bhau khoiee|
23.e: The man who by touching the feet and by becoming dust of the feet (of Guru) erases the illusions and fears of speech

23.g: ਹੋਇ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਮਾਰ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਸਗੋਈ।
23.t: hoi pa(n)chain pa(n)j maar baahar jaa(n)dhaa rakh sagoiee|
23.e: And actions from his mind and in the holy congregation wipes out the five evil propensities, he further restrains the mind

23.g: ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਓਈ ॥੨੧॥੨੩॥
23.t: bol abol saadh jan oiee ||21||23||
23.e: Such a one is a real sadhu (Gurmukh) and his words are ineffable.

24.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
24.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
24.e: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

24.g: ੧ : ਮੰਗਲਾ ਚਰਨ
24.t: 1 : ma(n)galaa charan
24.e: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

24.g: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
24.t: naarain nij roop dhar naathaa naath sanaath karaiaa|
24.e: Narayan, the lord of the destitutes, assuming forms has established mastery over all.

24.g: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
24.t: narapat nareh nari(n)dh hai nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|
24.e: He is the formless king of all men and kings who created various forms.

24.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ।
24.t: karataa purakh vakhaaneeaai kaaran karan biradh biradhaiaa|
24.e: As is creator of all the causes He is true to His reputation.

24.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
24.t: dhevee dhev dhevaadh dhev alakh abhev na alakh lakhaiaa|
24.e: Gods and goddesses also could not know the extent of that Lord, the imperceptible and beyond all mysteries.

24.g: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: sat roop satinaam kar satigur naanak dheau japaiaa|
24.e: The ture Guru Nanak Dev inspired people to remember the true name of the Lord whose form is truth.

24.g: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
24.t: dharamasaal karataar pur saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa|
24.e: Founding dharamsala, the place for dharma, at Kartarpur, it was inhabited by the holy congregartion as the abode

24.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
24.t: vaahiguroo gur sabadh sunaiaa ||1||
24.e: Word Wahiguru was imparted (by Guru Nanak) to the people.

24.g: ੨ : ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰੂ
24.t: 2 : jagat guroo
24.e: Guru of the world

24.g: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨੀਉ ਧਰਾਈਓਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਸਮੇਉ।
24.t: nihachal neeau dharaieeon saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd sameau|
24.e: The steadfast foundation of the abode of truth in the form of holy congregation was laid thoughtfully (by Guru Na-nak Dev)

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਮੇਉ।
24.t: gurmukh pa(n)th chalaion sukh saagar bea(n)t ameau|
24.e: And he promulgated gurmukh-panth (Sikhism) which is ocean of infinite pleasures.

24.g: ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ।
24.t: sach sabadh aaraadheeaai agam agochar alakh abheau|
24.e: There, true word is practised which is unapproachable, imperceptible and mystical.

24.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਉ।
24.t: chahu varanaa upadhesadhaa chhia dharasan sabh sevak seau|
24.e: That abode of truth preaches to all the four varnas and all the six philosophies (of Indian origin) remain absorbed in its service.

24.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਰਥੇਉ।
24.t: miThaa bolan niv chalan gurmukh bhaau bhagat aratheau|
24.e: Gurmukhs (there) speak sweetly, move humbly and are seekers of devotion.

24.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ।
24.t: aadh purakh aadhes hai abinaasee at achhal achheau|
24.e: Salutations are due to that primal Lord who is undestructible, undeceivable and unending.

24.g: ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ॥੨॥
24.t: jagat guroo gur naanak dheau ||2||
24.e: Guru Nanak is the enlightener (Guru) of the entire world.

24.g: ੩ : ਸੱਚਾ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹ
24.t: 3 : sa'chaa paatashaah
24.e: The true emperor

24.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਸਹਾਬਾ।
24.t: satigur sachaa paatisaahu beparavaahu athaahu sahaabaa|
24.e: The true Guru is the carefree emperor, unfathomable and full of all qualities of a master.

24.g: ਨਾਉ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੁਹਾਬਾ।
24.t: naau gareeb nivaaj hai bemuhataaj na moh muhaabaa|
24.e: His name is cherisher of the poor; neither He has attachment with anyone nor is He dependent on anybody.

24.g: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਲਾਹ ਸਿਞਾਬਾ।
24.t: besumaar nira(n)kaar hai alakh apaar alaeh sin(j)aabaa|
24.e: Formless, infinite and imperceptible, He is having all the attributes which deserve praise.

24.g: ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਵੇਦ ਕਿਤਾਬਾ।
24.t: kaim dhaim saahibee haajar naajar vedh kitaabaa|
24.e: The mastery of the true Guru is eternal because all the Vedas and other holy scriptures are always present before Him (for His praises).

24.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੀ ਛਾਬਾ।
24.t: agam addol atol hai tolanahaar na dda(n)ddee chhaabaa|
24.e: The true Guru is beyond all measures; He cannot be weighed on any scale.

24.g: ਇਕੁ ਛਤਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਂਵਦਾ ਦੁਸਮਣੁ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸੋਰ ਸਰਾਬਾ।
24.t: eik chhat raaj kamaa(n)vadhaa dhusaman dhoot na sor saraabaa|
24.e: Uniform is His kingdom wherein there is no enemy, no friend and no noisy clamour.

24.g: ਆਦਲੁ ਅਦਲੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ਜਾਲਮੁ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਨ ਜੋਰ ਜਰਾਬਾ।
24.t: aadhal adhal chalaidhaa jaalam julam na jor jaraabaa|
24.e: The true Guru is judicious; dispenses justice and in His kingdom no atrocity and tyranny is exacted.

24.g: ਜਾਹਰ ਪੀਰ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਬਾ ॥੩॥
24.t: jaahar peer jagat gur baabaa ||3||
24.e: Such a grand Guru (Nanak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.

24.g: ੪ : ਸੱਚਾ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹ
24.t: 4 : sa'chaa paatashaah
24.e: The true emperor

24.g: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਹਿੰਦੂਆ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾਂ ਮਕਾ ਕਾਬਾ।
24.t: ga(n)g banaaras hi(n)dhooaa musalamaanaa(n) makaa kaabaa|
24.e: Hindus adore Ganges and Banaras and Muslims consider Mecca-Kaba as a holy place.

24.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਵਜਨਿ ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗੁ ਰਬਾਬਾ।
24.t: ghar ghar baabaa gaaveeaai vajan taal miradha(n)g rabaabaa|
24.e: But to the accompaniment of mridang (drum) and rabaab (stringed instrument) the praises (of Baba Nanak) are sung.

24.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਅਜਬੁ ਅਜਾਬਾ।
24.t: bhagat vachhal hoi aaiaa patit udhaaran ajab ajaabaa|
24.e: Lover of the devotees, He has come to uplift the down trodden ones. He Himself is wonderful (because in spite of His powers He is egoless).

24.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਰਾਬਾ।
24.t: chaar varan ik varan hoi saadhasa(n)gat mil hoi taraabaa|
24.e: By His efforts, all the four varans have become one and now the individual gets liberated in the holy congregation.

24.g: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਖਰਾਬਾ।
24.t: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat aval dhom na sem kharaabaa|
24.e: Like the fragrance of sandalwood, He, without any discrimination, makes every one fragrant.

24.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਿਸ ਦੀ ਕਰੈ ਜਵਾਬਾ।
24.t: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko kudharat kis dhee karai javaabaa|
24.e: All act as ordained by Him and no one has the power to say no to Him.

24.g: ਜਾਹਰ ਪੀਰੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਬਾ ॥੪॥
24.t: jaahar peer jagat gur baabaa ||4||
24.e: Such grand Guru (Nanak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.

24.g: ੫ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਜੀ ਆਗਮਨ
24.t: 5 : guroo a(n)gadh jee aagaman
24.e: Advent of Guru Angad

24.g: ਅੰਗਹੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ਗੰਗਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਾਇਆ।
24.t: a(n)gahu a(n)g upaion ga(n)gahu jaan tara(n)g uThaiaa|
24.e: Guru Nanak created him ( Guru Angad) from his limbs as the waves are produced by Ganges out of itself.

24.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
24.t: gahir ga(n)bheer gaheer gun gurmukh gur gobi(n)dh sadhaiaa|
24.e: Embodied with deep and sublime attributes he (Angad) was known by gurmukhs as the form of the (imperceptible) supreme soul (paramatman).

24.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਣਿਹਾਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਾ ਲਾਇਆ।
24.t: dhukh sukh dhaataa dhenihaar dhukh sukh samasar lep naa laiaa|
24.e: He himself is bestower of pleasures and pains but remains always without any blot.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ।
24.t: gur chelaa chelaa guroo gur chele parachaa parachaiaa|
24.e: The love between the Guru and the disciple was such that the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.

24.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤਹੁ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਉ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ।
24.t: birakhahu fal fal te birakh piau putahu put piau pateeaaiaa|
24.e: It happened in the same manner as tree creates fruit and from fruit is created tree, or as father becomes happy over son and son feels happy in obeying the orders of father.

24.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
24.t: paarabraham pooran braham sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|
24.e: His consiconsness merged into word and the perfect transcendental Brahm made him see the imperceptible (Lord).

24.g: ਬਾਬਾਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੫॥
24.t: baabaane gur a(n)gadh aaiaa ||5||
24.e: Now Guru Angad got established as ( the extended form of) Baba Nanak.

24.g: ੬ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼
24.t: 6 : guroo a(n)gadh prakaash
24.e: Induction of Guru Angad

24.g: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਸਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਹਣਾ।
24.t: paaras hoaa paarasahu satigur parache satigur kahanaa|
24.e: Meeting paras (the philosopher's stone Guru Nanak) Guru Angad became paras himself and because of his love for the Guru he was called the true Guru.

24.g: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਚੰਦਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਹਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਣਾ।
24.t: cha(n)dhan hoiaa cha(n)dhanahu gur upadhes rahat vich rahanaa|
24.e: Living according to the preachings and code of conduct laid down by the Guru, he became sandal by meeting the sandal (Guru Nanak).

24.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਖ ਦਹਣਾ।
24.t: jot samaanee jot vich gurmat sukh dhuramat dhukh dhahanaa|
24.e: The light immersed in the light; the delight of the wisdom of Guru (gurmat) was attained and the sufferings of evil mindedness got burnt and wiped out.

24.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਮਹਣਾ।
24.t: acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh samahanaa|
24.e: The wonder met the wonder and becoming wondrous got imbued with the wonder (Guru Nanak).

24.g: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣੁ ਅਸਹੀਅਣੁ ਸਹਣਾ।
24.t: apiau peean nijhar jharan ajar jaran asaheean sahanaa|
24.e: After quaffing the nectar the fountain of joy emerges to flew and then the power of bearing the unbearable is obtained

24.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਹਣਾ।
24.t: sach samaanaa sach vich gaaddee raahu saadhasa(n)g vahanaa|
24.e: Moving on the highway of the holy congregation, the truth has merged into the truth.

24.g: ਬਾਬਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੬॥
24.t: baabaanai ghar chaanan lahanaa ||6||
24.e: In fact Lahana became the light of Baba Nanak's house.

24.g: ੭ : ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਸਪੁਤ੍ਰ
24.t: 7 : gur a(n)gadh saputr
24.e: The worthy son Guru Angad

24.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ।
24.t: sabadhai sabadh milaiaa gurmukh aghaR ghaRaae gahanaa|
24.e: Gurumukh (Angad) attuning his sabad (word) to the Sabad has chiselled his clumsy mind to make it an ornament.

24.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਖਹਣਾ।
24.t: bhai bhagat bhai chalanaa aap ganai na khalahal khahanaa|
24.e: He has disciplined himself in the fear of loving devotion and losing the sense of ego has saved himself from all sorts of imbroglios.

24.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਸ ਨਸੀਨੀ ਬਹਣਾ।
24.t: dheen dhunee dhee saahibee gurmukh gos naseenee bahanaa|
24.e: Achieving mastery over spirituality as well as temporarily, the gurmukh has resided in the loneliness.

24.g: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛਹਣਾ।
24.t: kaaran karan samarath hai hoi achhal chhal a(n)dhar chhahanaa|
24.e: Even being cause of all effects and all powerfull he remains in the world full of deceptions.

24.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਹਣਾ।
24.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath veechaar sahaj ghar ghahanaa|
24.e: Dopting truth, contentment, compassion dharma, richness and scriminatory wisdom(Vichar) he has made peace his abo

24.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਛਡਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਹੁ ਤਹਣਾ।
24.t: kaam krodh virodh chhadd lobh moh aha(n)kaarahu tahanaa|
24.e: Shedding lust, anger and opposition he has repudiated greed, infatuation and ego.

24.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਸਪੁਤੁ ਬਬਾਣੇ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੭॥
24.t: put saput babaane lahanaa ||7||
24.e: Such a worthy son Lahana (Angad) is born in the family of Baba (Nanak).

24.g: ੮ : ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਸਪੁਤ੍ਰ
24.t: 8 : gur a(n)gadh saputr
24.e: Worthy son, Guru Angad

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਫਲਿਆ।
24.t: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te a(n)mirat birakh a(n)mirat fal faliaa|
24.e: From the limb of Guru (Nanak) the tree of nector fruits in the name of Guru Angad has flourished.

24.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਈਅਨੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲਿਆ।
24.t: jotee jot jagaieean dheeve te jiau dheevaa baliaa|
24.e: As a lamp lits another lamp, with the light (of Guru Nanak), the flame (of Guru Angad) has been lit.

24.g: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੀ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਿਆ।
24.t: heerai heeraa bedhiaa chhal kar achhalee achhal chhaliaa|
24.e: The diamond has cut (to shape) the diamond as if through magic, the undeceivable (Baba Nanak) has brought under control the simple_minded one (Guru Angad)

24.g: ਕੋਈ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਰਲਿਆ।
24.t: koiee bujh na ha(n)ghiee paanee a(n)dhar paanee raliaa|
24.e: Now they connot be distinguished as if water has mingled with water.

24.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਹੁ ਢਲਿਆ।
24.t: sachaa sach suhaavaRaa sach a(n)dhar sach sachahu ddaliaa|
24.e: The Truth is always beautiful and in the die of truth he (Guru Angad) has moulded himself.

24.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਨ ਹਲੈ ਹਲਿਆ।
24.t: nihachal sachaa takhat hai abichal raaj na halai haliaa|
24.e: His throne is immovable and kingdom everlasting ; they connot be moved in spite of efforts.

24.g: ਸਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਸਚ ਟਕਸਾਲਹੁ ਸਿਕਾ ਚਲਿਆ।
24.t: sach sabadh gur saupiaa sach Takasaalahu sikaa chaliaa|
24.e: The ture word has been handed over ( to Guru Angad) by the Guru (Nanak) as if the coin has been issued from the mint

24.g: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਭ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿਕੈ ਹੋਏ ਖਲਿਆ।
24.t: sidh naath avataar sabh hath joRikai hoe khaliaa|
24.e: Now siddhs naths and incarnations (of gods) etc have stood before him with folded hands

24.g: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੮॥
24.t: sachaa hukamu su aTal na Taliaa ||8||
24.e: And this command is true,immutable and inevitable.

24.g: ੯ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ
24.t: 9 : guroo amaradhaas
24.e: Guru Amar Das

24.g: ਅਛਲੁ ਅਛੇਦੁ ਅਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
24.t: achhal achhedh abhedh hai bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaiaa|
24.e: The Lord is undeceivable, indestructible and non-dual, but because of His love for His devotees He is sometimes deluded by them (as in the case of 'Guru Amar Das).

24.g: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਿਤਿ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਲੰਘਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: mahimaa mit mirajaadh la(n)gh paramit paaraavaar na paiaa|
24.e: His grandeur has crossed all the limits and being boyond all the boundaries none could know about his extent.

24.g: ਰਹਰਾਸੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: raharaasee raharaas hai pairee pai jag pairee paiaa|
24.e: Among all the codes of couduct, the code of conduct of the Guru is the best one; he falling at the feet of Guru (Angad) has made the whole world bow at his own feet.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਲਾਇਆ।
24.t: gurmukh sukhafal amar padh a(n)mirat birakh a(n)mirat fal laiaa|
24.e: The pleasure fruit of the gurmuldts is the state of immortality and on the tree of nectar (Guru Angad) Guru Amar Das, the nectar fruit has grown.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਰਖਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
24.t: gur chelaa chelaa guroo purakhahu purakh upai samaiaa|
24.e: From the Guru emerged the disciple and the disciple became the Guru.

24.g: ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਵੀਹਿ ਵਿਸਵੇ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਹ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
24.t: varatamaan veeh visave hoi ikeeh sahaj ghar aaiaa|
24.e: Guru Angad the Cosmic spirit ( Purakh) having manifested the supreme spirit, (Guru Amar Das), himself merged in the supreme light.

24.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਮਰਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
24.t: sachaa amar amar varataiaa ||9||
24.e: Going beyond the perceptible world, he established himself in equipoise.Thus, Guru Amar Das has spead the true message.

24.g: ੧੦ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ
24.t: 10 : guroo amaradhaas
24.e: Amar Das,the Grandson of Guru Nanak

24.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇਕੈ ਚੇਲੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਚੇਲਾ।
24.t: sabadh surat parachaikai chele te gur gur te chelaa|
24.e: Absorbing consciousness in the Word, the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.

24.g: ਵਾਣਾ ਤਾਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸੂਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਕਪੜੁ ਮੇਲਾ।
24.t: vaanaa taanaa aakheeaai soot ik hui kapaR melaa|
24.e: Ward and weft are separate names but in the form of yam they are one and are known as the one, cloth.

24.g: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਦਹੀਅਹੁ ਮਖਣੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
24.t: dhudhahu dhahee vakhaaneeaai dhaheeahu makhan kaaj suhelaa|
24.e: The same milk becomes curd and from curd is made butter to be used variously.

24.g: ਮਿਸਰੀ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਕਮਾਦਹੁ ਰੇਲਾ ਪੇਲਾ।
24.t: misaree kha(n)dd vakhaaneeaai jaan kamaadhahu relaa pelaa|
24.e: From the sugar cane juice are prepared the lump sugar and other forms of sugar.

24.g: ਖੀਰਿ ਖੰਡੁ ਘਿਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ।
24.t: kheer kha(n)dd ghiau mel kar at visamaadh saadh ras kelaa|
24.e: Mixing the milk, sugar, ghee etc. many dainty dishes are prepared.

24.g: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੂਨੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
24.t: paan supaaree kath mil choone ra(n)g sura(n)g suhelaa|
24.e: Likewise when betal, betel nut, catechu and lime are mixed, they produce a beautiful colour.

24.g: ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੀਕੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥੧੦॥
24.t: potaa paravaaneek navelaa ||10||
24.e: In the same way the grandson Guru Amar Das has been authentically established.

24.g: ੧੧ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰ ਦਾਸ
24.t: 11 : guroo amar dhaas
24.e: Guru Amar Das

24.g: ਤਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਫੁਲ ਅਮੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਫੁਲੇਲਾ।
24.t: til mil ful amul jiau gursikh sa(n)dh suga(n)dh fulelaa|
24.e: As sesame mixed with flower becomes scented oil, likewise the, meeting of the Guru and the disciple makes a new personality.

24.g: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲਿ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਪਾਹ ਚਲਤ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਲਾ।
24.t: khaasaa malamal sireesaaf saeh kapaeh chalat bahu khelaa|
24.e: Cotten also after passing ugh many processes becomes cloth of different varieties (similarly the ciple after meeting the Gum obtains a high position) .

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
24.t: gur moorat gur sabadh hai saadhasa(n)gat mil a(n)mirat velaa|
24.e: Only the Guru's rd is the idol of Guru and this word is received in the holy congregation e ambrosial hours of the day.

24.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਸਚ ਮਣੀ ਸਚ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ।
24.t: dhuneeaa kooRee saahibee sach manee sach garab gahelaa|
24.e: The lordship of the world is false and truth must be caught hold of proudly.

24.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੁੜਾਇਅਨੁ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਘੇਲਾ।
24.t: dhevee dhev dhuRaian jiau miragaaval dhekh baghelaa|
24.e: Before such a truthful person, gods and goddesses run as a group of deer take to their heels on seeing a tiger
