24.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਪਿਛੇ ਲਗੇ ਨਕਿ ਨਕੇਲਾ।
24.t: hukam rajaiee chalanaa pichhe lage nak nakelaa|
24.e: People, accepting the will of the lord and wearing the nose bar (of love) move (calmly) with Guru Amar Das.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧੧॥
24.t: gurmukh sachaa amar suhelaa ||11||
24.e: Guru Amar Das is the truth mate, blest one gurmukh, the Guru oriented.

24.g: ੧੨ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦੇਵ
24.t: 12 : guroo amaradhev
24.e: Guru Amar Das

24.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਮਰ ਅਮਰਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
24.t: satigur hoaa satigurahu acharaj amar amar varataiaa|
24.e: From the true Guru (Angad Dev) becoming the truthful Guru, Amar

24.g: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
24.t: so Tikaa so baihanaa soiee sachaa hukam chalaiaa|
24.e: Has enacted a wondrous feat. The same light, the same seat and the same will of Lord is being spread by him.

24.g: ਖੋਲਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
24.t: khol khajaanaa sabadh dhaa saadhasa(n)gat sach mel milaiaa|
24.e: He has opened up the storehouse of word and has made the truth manifest through the holy congregation.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਲੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: gur chelaa paravaan kar chaar varan lai pairee paiaa|
24.e: Making the disciple authentic, the Guru has put all the four varnas at his feet.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
24.t: gurmukh ik dhiaaieeaai dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau miTaiaa|
24.e: Now all becoming gurmukhs adore the one Lord and evil wisdom and duality have been wiped out of them.

24.g: ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
24.t: kulaa dharam gursikh sabh maiaa vich udhaas rahaiaa|
24.e: Now the duty of the family and the teaching of the Guru is that one should be detacthed while living amidst maya

24.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
24.t: poore pooraa thaaT banaiaa ||12||
24.e: The perfect Guru has created the perfect grandeur.

24.g: ੧੩ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ
24.t: 13 : guroo amaradhaas
24.e: Guru Amar Das

24.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਬਦ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
24.t: aadh purakh aadhes kar aadh jugaadh sabadh varataiaa|
24.e: Having worshipped the primal Lord he made the word pervade all the yugs ,and even before the yugs i.e. before the advent of time

24.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
24.t: naam dhaan isanaan dhiR gur sikh dhe sai(n)saar taraiaa|
24.e: Instructing people and teaching about the remembrance of nam (Lord), charity and ablutions, the Guru has taken them across the world(ocean)

24.g: ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਇਕ ਪੈਰ ਹੁਇ ਚਾਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
24.t: kaleekaal ik pair hui chaar charan kar dharam dharaiaa|
24.e: The Guru provided dour legs to dharma which had remained one legged earlier.

24.g: ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਿਆਈਅਹੁ ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦੇ ਦਾ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
24.t: bhalaa bhalaa bhaliaaieeahu piau dhaadhe dhaa raahu chalaiaa|
24.e: From the point of view of public weal this was good and this way he further extended the ,,way shown by his (spiritual)father and grandfather.

24.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗਹਣਗਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
24.t: agam agochar gahanagat sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|
24.e: Teaching the skill of merging the cousciousness in the word, he has brought people face to face with that imperceptible (Lord)

24.g: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: apara(n)par aagaadh bodh paramit paaraavaar na paiaa|
24.e: His glory is unapproachable, invisible and deep; its limits cannot be known.

24.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
24.t: aape aap na aap janaiaa ||13||
24.e: He has known his real self but even then he has never attributed any importance to himself.

24.g: ੧੪ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ
24.t: 14 : guroo amaradhaas
24.e: Guru Ram Das

24.g: ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਹੈ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
24.t: raag dhokh niradhokh hai raaj jog varatai varataaraa|
24.e: Away from attachment and jealousies he has adopted rajyoga (The supreme yoga).

24.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਵਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਣਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
24.t: manasaa vaachaa karamanaa maram na jaapai apar apaaraa|
24.e: None can know the mystery of his mind, speech and actions.

24.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੈਆ ਦਾਨਿ ਦੇਵਸਥਲੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਾ।
24.t: dhaataa bhugataa dhaiaa dhaan dhevasathal satisa(n)g udhaaraa|
24.e: He is bestower ( unattached) enjoyer, and he has created holy congregation which is equal to the abode of gods.

24.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ।
24.t: sahaj samaadh agaadh bodh satigur sach savaaranahaaraa|
24.e: He remains absorbed in innate poise; the master of unfathomable intellect,  and being the true Guru he sets every one's disordered life in order.

24.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਜੁਹਾਰਾ।
24.t: gur amarahu gur raamadhaas jotee jot jagai juhaaraa|
24.e: From the flame of Guru Amar Das the flame of Guru Ram Das has been lighted. I salute him.

24.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰਧਾਰਾ।
24.t: sabadh surat gur sikh hoi anahadh baanee nijharadhaaraa|
24.e: By becoming a disciple of the Guru and merging his consciousness into the Divine Word, he has tasted the ever-flowing stream of the unstruck melody.

24.g: ਤਖਤੁ ਬਖਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
24.t: takhat bakhat paragaT paahaaraa ||14||
24.e: Sitting on the throne of Guru, he has become manifest in the world

24.g: ੧੫ : ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ
24.t: 15 : guroo raamadhaas
24.e: Guru Ram Das

24.g: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵੇਹਾ ਪੜਦਾਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਪੜੋਤਾ।
24.t: peeuoo dhaadhe jevehaa paRadhaadhe paravaan paRotaa|
24.e: Spiritual Great Grandfather Guru Nanak’s grandson, Guru Ram Das, has attained greatness like his spiritual father, Guru Amar Das, and his grandfather, Guru Angad, and is embraced by the congregation.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਜਗਾਇਦਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੌੜਾ ਸੋਤਾ।
24.t: gurmat jaag jagaidhaa kalijug a(n)dhar kauaRaa sotaa|
24.e: Having been awakened by Guru's instruction, he in turn awakens the dark age (Kaliyug) from deep slumber.

24.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦਾ ਥੰਮੁ ਹੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਥਰਬਣ ਥੰਮੑਹਿ ਖਲੋਤਾ।
24.t: dheen dhunee dhaa tha(n)m hui bhaar atharaban tha(n)m(h)h khalotaa|
24.e: For dharma and the world he stands like a supporting pillar.

24.g: ਭਉਜਲ ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚੜਿ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਗੋਤਾ।
24.t: bhaujal bhau na viaapiee gur bohith chaR khai na gotaa|
24.e: Whosoever has mounted the vessel of the Guru, is not scared of the world world ocean; and he is not to drown in it

24.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਕਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਹਟ ਨਾਲੈ ਵਣਜ ਸਓਤਾ।
24.t: avagun lai gun vikanai gur haT naalai vanaj sotaa|
24.e: Here virtues are sold for evils - such is the profitable shop of the Guru.

24.g: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੂਲ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ।
24.t: miliaa mool na vichhuRai ratan padhaarath haar parotaa|
24.e: Once visited none gets separated from him who has put on the garland of the pearls of virtues.

24.g: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਧੋਤਾ।
24.t: mailaa kadhe na hoviee gur saravar niramal jal dhotaa|
24.e: Washed himself in the pure water of the tank of the Guru's love, one never gets soiled again.

24.g: ਬਾਬਾਣੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਅਛੋਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
24.t: baabaanai kul kaval achhotaa ||15||
24.e: In the family of great grand father (Guru Nanak) he (Guru Ram Das) stands like a detached lotus.

24.g: ੧੬ : ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ
24.t: 16 : guroo raamadhaas
24.e: Guru Ram Das

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਸਚ ਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ।
24.t: gurmukh melaa sach dhaa sach milai sachiaar sa(n)jogee|
24.e: Gurmukh longs for the glimpse of truth and the truth is abtained only by providentially meeting an adopter of the truth.

24.g: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੀ।
24.t: gharabaaree paravaar vich bhog bhugat raaje ras bhogee|
24.e: Living in the family, the gurmukh like a dutiful householder enjoys all materials and like kings tastes all delights.

24.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੀਸਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ।
24.t: aasaa vich niraas hui jog jugat jogeesar jogee|
24.e: He remains detached amidst all hopes and, knowing the technique of yoga, is known as the king of yogis.

24.g: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ।
24.t: dhe(n)dhaa rahai na ma(n)geeaai marai na hoi vijog vijogee|
24.e: He always bestows and begs nothing. Neither he dies nor he suffers the pangs of the separation from the Lord.

24.g: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਇ ਪਿਤ ਕਫੁ ਰੋਗ ਅਰੋਗੀ।
24.t: aadh biaadh upaadh hai vai pit kaf rog arogee|
24.e: He is not troubled by pains and maladies and he remains free from the diseases of air, cough and heat.

24.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਅਪਦਾ ਸੋਗੀ।
24.t: dhukh sukh samasar gurmatee sa(n)pai harakh na apadhaa sogee|
24.e: He accepts sufferings and joys alike; wisdom of the Guru is his wealth and he is uninfluenced by joy and sorrows.

24.g: ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹੀ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ॥੧੬॥
24.t: dheh bidhehee log alogee ||16||
24.e: Being embodied he is yet beyond the body and while living in the world he is beyond the world.

24.g: ੧੭ : ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ
24.t: 17 : guroo raamadhaas
24.e: Guru Ram Das

24.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਗੀ।
24.t: sabhanaa saahib ik hai dhoojee jai na hoi na hogee|
24.e: The master of all is one; any body else has neither existed nor ever shall be in future.

24.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਪਰਮਹੰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਚੋਗੀ।
24.t: sahaj sarovar paramaha(n)s gurmat motee maanak chogee|
24.e: The creatures living in the tank of equipoise of the wisdom of Guru are known as param halls (swans of highest order)and they pick up only rubies and pearls i.e. they always adopt goodness in their life.

24.g: ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਜਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਜਣੁ ਭਜਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਧੋਗੀ।
24.t: kheer neer jiau kooR sach tajan bhajan gur giaan adhogee|
24.e: Like separating milk from water, discern truth from falsehood, and immerse yourself in the wisdom of the Guru’s teachings.

24.g: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਪਰਿਹਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦਰੋਗੀ।
24.t: eik man ik araadhanaa parihar dhoojaa bhaau dharogee|
24.e: Repudiating the sense of duality they adore the one Lord with single mindedness.

24.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਘਰੋਗੀ।
24.t: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g sahaj samaadh agaadh gharogee|
24.e: Although house holders, they, merging their consciousness in Word, in the holy congregation remain established ineffortless concentration

24.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਪਰਮਪਰ ਜੋਗੀ।
24.t: ja(n)man maranahu baahare paraupakaar paramapar jogee|
24.e: Such perfect yogis are benevolent and free from transmigration.

24.g: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਸਮੋਗੀ ॥੧੭॥
24.t: raamadhaas gur amar samogee ||17||
24.e: Among such persons is Guru Ram Das who is fully absorbed in Guru Amar Das i.e. he is his constituent.

24.g: ੧੮ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ
24.t: 18 : guroo arajan dhev jee
24.e: Guru Arjan Dev

24.g: ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਕਲ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
24.t: alakh nira(n)jan aakheeaai akal ajon akaal apaaraa|
24.e: That Lord is without blemish, beyond birth, beyond time and is infinite.

24.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੋਤ ਲੰਘਿ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ।
24.t: rav sas jot udhot la(n)gh param jot paramesar piaaraa|
24.e: Crossing the lights of sun and the moon, Guru Arjan Dev loves the supreme light of the Lord.

24.g: ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਗ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰਾ।
24.t: jagamag jot nira(n)taree jag jeevan jag jai jai kaaraa|
24.e: His light is ever effulgent. He is the life of the world and the whole world acclaims him.

24.g: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਉਧਾਰਾ।
24.t: namasakaar sa(n)saar vich aadh purakh aadhes udhaaraa|
24.e: All in the world salute him and he, ordained by the primal Lord, liberates one and all.

24.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ।
24.t: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa gurmukh maarag sach achaaraa|
24.e: Amidst the four vamas and six philosophies the way of the gurmukh is the way of adoption of truth.

24.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ।
24.t: naam dhaan isanaan dhiR gurmukh bhai bhagat nisataaraa|
24.e: Adopting the remebrance of the name (of Lord), charity and ablution steadfastly and with loving devotion, he (Guru Arjan Dev) gets the devoetees across ( the world ocean).

24.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧੮॥
24.t: guroo arajan sach sirajanahaaraa ||18||
24.e: Guru Arjan is the builder (of the Panth ).

24.g: ੧੯ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ
24.t: 19 : guroo arajan dhev
24.e: Guru Arjan Dev

24.g: ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦਾ ਪੜਦਾਦਿਅਹੁ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰ ਨਤਾ।
24.t: piau dhaadhaa paRadhaadhiahu kul dheepak ajaraavar nataa|
24.e: Guru Arjan Dev is the lamp of the line of his father, grand father and great grand father.

24.g: ਤਖਤੁ ਬਖਤੁ ਲੈ ਮਲਿਆ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਸਪਤਾ।
24.t: takhat bakhat lai maliaa sabadh surat vaapaar sapataa|
24.e: Having merged his consciousness into Word he in a dignified way has undertaken the task (of Guruship) and being blest st one, has assumed the authority of the throne (of the Lord).

24.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਭਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਥਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗ ਰਤਾ।
24.t: gurbaanee bha(n)ddaar bhar keeratan kathaa rahai ra(n)g rataa|
24.e: He is the storehouse of gurbdni (divine hymns) and remains absorbed in the eulogization (of the Lord).

24.g: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸ ਮਤਾ।
24.t: dhun anahadh nijhar jharai pooran prem amio ras mataa|
24.e: He allows the fountain of unstruck melody flow unabated and remains immersed in the nectar of perfect love.

24.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜ ਸਹਤਾ।
24.t: saadhasa(n)gat hai gur sabhaa ratan padhaarath vanaj sahataa|
24.e: When the court of Guru assumes the form of holy congregation, the exchange of jewels and gems of wisdom takes place

24.g: ਸਚ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ।
24.t: sach neesaan dheebaan sach sach taan sach maan mahataa|
24.e: The true court of Guru Arjan Dev is the true mark (of grandeur) and he has attained the true honour and greatness

24.g: ਅਬਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਣਖਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
24.t: abachal raaj hoaa sanakhataa ||19||
24.e: The kingdom of knowledgeable (Guru Arjan Dev) is immutable.

24.g: ੨੦ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ
24.t: 20 : guroo arajan dhev jee
24.e: Guru Arjan Dev

24.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਚਕ ਨਿਵਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਣਤਾ।
24.t: chaare chak nivaion sikh sa(n)gat aavai aganataa|
24.e: He has conquered all the four directions and the Sikh devotees come to him in countless number.

24.g: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣੀ ਬਣਤਾ।
24.t: la(n)gar chalai gur sabadh poore pooree banee banataa|
24.e: The free kitchen (latigar) wherein the word of the Guru is served runs unabated there and this is the perfect creation(arrangement) of the perfect Guru.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮਪਦ ਮਤਾ।
24.t: gurmukh chhatr nira(n)janee pooran braham paramapadh mataa|
24.e: Under the canopy of the Lord, the gurmukhs attain the supreme state bestowed by the perfect Lord.

24.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਤਾ।
24.t: vedh kateb agocharaa gurmukh sabadh saadh sa(n)g sataa|
24.e: In the holy congregation, the. Word Brahm, which is beyond the Vedas and the Ketebas , is attained by gurmukhs.

24.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜਨਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤਾ।
24.t: maiaa vich udhaas kar gur sikh janak asa(n)kh bhagataa|
24.e: The Guru has created myriad Janak-like devotees who remain detached amidst maya.

24.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਬਿਗਤਾ।
24.t: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai akath kathaa abigat abigataa|
24.e: The mystery of the power of His creation cannot be known and ineffable is the story of that unmanifest (Lord) .

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਗਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
24.t: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj sugataa ||20||
24.e: The gurmukhs receive their pleasure fruit without any effort.

24.g: ੨੧ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਜੀ ਤੋਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦ
24.t: 21 : guroo arajan jee to(n) guroo harigobi(n)dh
24.e: Guru Hargobind from Guru Arjan Dev

24.g: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਹਰਣ ਭਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰੰਦਾ।
24.t: harakhahu sogahu baaharaa haran bharan samarath sara(n)dhaa|
24.e: Beyond pleasures and sorrows he is creator, sustainer and destroyer.

24.g: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
24.t: ras kas roop na rekh vich raag ra(n)g niralep raha(n)dhaa|
24.e: He is away from enjoyments, repulsions, forms and even being amidst festivities, he remains detached and stabilized.

24.g: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ।
24.t: gosaT giaan agocharaa budh bal bachan bibek na chha(n)dhaa|
24.e: Unapproable through discussions, he is beyond the powers of intellect, speech; wisdom and praise.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ।
24.t: gur govi(n)dh govi(n)dh gur harigovi(n)dh sadhaa vigasa(n)dhaa|
24.e: Accepting Guru,(Arjan Dev) as God and God as Guru, Hargobind (the Guru)remains ever elated.

24.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
24.t: acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh mila(n)dhaa|
24.e: Being full of wonder he is absorbed in the supreme :Wonder and thus being awe inspired he remains immersed in supreme rapture , rapture.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਕਾਰ ਨਿਬਹੰਦਾ।
24.t: gurmukh maarag chalanaa kha(n)dde dhaar kaar nibaha(n)dhaa|
24.e: Moving on the way of gurmukhs is like treading on the edge of  sword.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ ॥੨੧॥
24.t: gur sikh lai gursikh chala(n)dhaa ||21||
24.e: Accepting the teachings of the Guru, the disciple adopts  them in his life.

24.g: ੨੨ : ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਹਿਂਮਾਂ ਸਿੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
24.t: 22 : guroo dhee mahi(n)maa(n) si'kh noo(n) upadhesh
24.e: Glory of the Guru, teaching for the Sikh  ,

24.g: ਹੰਸਹੁ ਹੰਸ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਧੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੈ ਪਾਣੀ।
24.t: ha(n)sahu ha(n)s giaan kar dhudhai vichahu kaddai paanee|
24.e: The gurmukhs are those swans who on the basis of their knowledge sift water (falsehood) from milk (truth).

24.g: ਕਛਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਘੁੰਮਣਵਾਣੀ।
24.t: kachhahu kachh dhiaan dhar lahar na viaapai ghu(n)manavaanee|
24.e: Among turtles, they are such ones who remain uninfluenced by waves and whirlpools.

24.g: ਕੂੰਜਹੁ ਕੂੰਜੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਉਡੈ ਅਸਮਾਣੀ।
24.t: koo(n)jahu koo(n)j vakhaaneeaai simaran kar uddai asamaanee|
24.e: They are like siberian cranes who go on remembering the Lord while flying high.

24.g: ਗੁਰਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ।
24.t: guraparachai gur jaaneeaai giaan dhiaan simaran gurbaanee|
24.e: Only by loving the Guru, the Sikh knows, understands and learns the knowledge, meditation and Gurbani, the holy hymns.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ।
24.t: gur sikh lai gursikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat jag a(n)dhar jaanee|
24.e: Having adopted the teachings of the Guru, the Sikhs become gursikhs, the Sikhs of the Guru, and join the holy congregation wherever they find it.

24.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਣੀ।
24.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi garab nivaar gareebee aanee|
24.e: The humility could be cultivated only by bowing at the feet, becoming the dust of feet of the Guru and by deleting ego from the self.

24.g: ਪੀ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ॥੨੨॥
24.t: pee charanodhak a(n)mirat vaanee ||22||
24.e: Only such persons take feet-wash of the Guru and their speech becomes nectar (for others).

24.g: ੨੩ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਜੀ ਦੀ ਜੋਤੀਜੋਤ
24.t: 23 : guroo arajan jee dhee joteejot
24.e: Mingling of the light of Guru Arjan Dev with the eternal light

24.g: ਰਹਿਦੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੀਨ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ।
24.t: rahidhe gur dhareeaau vich meen kuleen het nirabaanee|
24.e: Liberating the soul from the body, Guru (Arjan Dev) stabilized himself in the water of river as the fish remains in water.

24.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ।
24.t: dharasan dhekh pata(n)g jiau jotee a(n)dhar jot samaanee|
24.e: As the moth rows itself into the flame, his light mingled with light of the Lord.

24.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਭੀੜ ਪਈ ਚਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਣੀ।
24.t: sabadh surat liv mirag jiau bheeR piee chit avar na aanee|
24.e: Caring of for life, as the deer keeps its consciousness concentrated when in peril, the Guru also, when undergoing suffering kept none else except the Lord in is' consciousness.

24.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਵਰ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
24.t: charan kaval mil bhavar jiau sukh sa(n)paT vich rain vihaanee|
24.e: As the black bee remains enrapt in the petals of flower • enjoy fragrance, the Guru also spent night of suffering by keeping joyfully s concentration on the feet of Lord.

24.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਖ ਵਖਾਣੀ।
24.t: gur upadhes na visarai baabeehe jiau aakh vakhaanee|
24.e: The Guru like a rainbird spoke to his disciples that the teachings of the Guru should not be forgotten.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਣੀ।
24.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)g jaanee|
24.e: The pleasure it of the Gurmukh (Guru Arjan Dev) is the delight of love and he accepts the holy congregation as the natural state of meditation.

24.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੩॥
24.t: gur arajan viTahu kurabaanee ||23||
24.e: I am sacrifice unto Guru Arjan Dev.

24.g: ੨੪ : ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਗੋਬਿੰਦ
24.t: 24 : guroo haragobi(n)dh
24.e: Guru Hargobind

24.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: paarabraham pooran braham satigur aape aap upaiaa|
24.e: The true Guru has been created in the form of perfect Brahm by the transcendent Brahm. Guru is God and God is the Guru; two names are of the same supreme reality.

24.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
24.t: gur gobi(n)dh govi(n)dh gur jot ik dhui naav dharaiaa|
24.e: The son for the father and the father for the son created wonder by receiving the wondrous Word .

24.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਅਹੁ ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤ ਤੇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦਹੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
24.t: put piahu piau put te visamaadhahu visamaadh sunaiaa|
24.e: A wonderful beauty has been created in the action of tree becoming fruit and fruit the tree.

24.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਆਚਰਜਹੁ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
24.t: birakhahu fal fal te birakh aacharajahu aacharaj suhaiaa|
24.e: From the two banks of a river its true extent cannot be understood simply by saying that the one is far and the other near bank.

24.g: ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੇ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਪੁਛੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
24.t: nadhee kinaare aakheean puchhe paaraavaar na paiaa|
24.e: Guru Arjan Dev and Guru Hargobind are in fact one and the same.

24.g: ਹੋਰਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
24.t: horan alakh na lakheeaai gur chele mil alakh lakhaiaa|
24.e: None else can perceive the imperceptible Lord but the disciple (Hargobind) having met the Guru (Arjan Dev) has visualised the imperceptible Lord.

24.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੪॥
24.t: har govi(n)dh guroo gur bhaiaa ||24||
24.e: Guru Hargobind is dear to the Lord who is the Guru of the Gurus.

24.g: ੨੫ : ਖ਼ਸ਼ਟ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਰਣਨ
24.t: 25 : khhashaT guroo varanan
24.e: Description of the sixth Guru

24.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
24.t: nira(n)kaar naanak dheau nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|
24.e: The formless Lord assumed the form of Guru Nanak Dev who is second all forms.

24.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਗੰਗਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਾਇਆ।
24.t: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te ga(n)gahu jaan tara(n)g uThaiaa|
24.e: In turn, he created Afigad from his limbs as the waves e created by Ganges.

24.g: ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
24.t: amaradhaas gur a(n)gadhahu jot saroop chalat varataiaa|
24.e: From Guru Angad came Guru Amar Das and the miracle of the transference of the light was seen by one and all.

24.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
24.t: gur amarahu gur raamadhaas anahadh naadhahu sabadh sunaiaa|
24.e: From. Guru ar Das Rim Das came into being in such a way as if the Word was ated from the unstruck sounds.

24.g: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਹੁ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
24.t: raamadhaasahu arajan guroo dharasan dharapan vich dhikhaiaa|
24.e: Guru Arjan Dev by Guru Ram 'Ws was ated as if he is the image of the latter in the mirror.

24.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜਨਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਾਉਂ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
24.t: har gobi(n)dh gur arajanahu gur gobi(n)dh naau(n) sadhavaiaa|
24.e: Being created by Guru Arjan Dev, Guru Hargobind made himself famous as the form of the Lord.

24.g: ਗੁਰਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ।
24.t: gurmoorat gur sabadh hai saadhasa(n)gat vich paragaTee aaiaa|
24.e: In fact the physical body of the Guru is 'Word' of the Guru which comes perceptible only in the form of holy congregation.

24.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨੫॥੨੪॥
24.t: pairee pai sabh jagat taraiaa ||25||24||
24.e: Thus, the true liberated the whole world making people bow at the Lord's feet.

25.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
25.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
25.e: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

25.g: ੧ : ਖਸ਼ਟਮ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਗਲਾ ਚਰਣ
25.t: 1 : khashaTam gur ma(n)galaa charan
25.e: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

25.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
25.t: aadh purakh aadhes kar aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|
25.e: The Guru bowed before the Lord and the primal Lord made the whole world bow before the Guru.

25.g: ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
25.t: eka(n)kaar akaar kar gur govi(n)dh naau sadhavaiaa|
25.e: The formless Brahm assuming (human) form has got himself called Guru (Har) Gobind.

25.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਰਗੁਣ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
25.t: paarabraham pooran braham niragun saragun alakh lakhaiaa|
25.e: Assuming form and being formless at the same time, the transcendental perfect Brahm has made His unmanifest form manifest.

25.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
25.t: saadhasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaiaa|
25.e: The holy congregation adored Him; and being in love with the devotees He, the undeceivable, got deluded (and became manifest in the form of Guru).

25.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਪਸਾਇਆ।
25.t: oa(n)kaar akaar kar ik kavaau pasaau pasaiaa|
25.e: The Maar assuming form created the whole world by His one commanding vibration.

25.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
25.t: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR samaiaa|
25.e: In His each trichome He contained millions of universes.

25.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
25.t: saadh janaa gur charan dhiaaiaa ||1||
25.e: The sadhus adore the Lord in the form of the Guru's feet.

25.g: ੨ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਾਰਗ
25.t: 2 : gurmukh maarag
25.e: The way of the gurumukh

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਦਹਿਦਿਸਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਧਾਇਆ।
25.t: gurmukh maarag pair dhar dhahidhis baareh vaaT na dhaiaa|
25.e: The guru-oriented treading the path leading towards the Guru does not stray into the paths of the twelve sects of the yogis.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
25.t: gurmoorat gur dhiaan dhar ghaT ghaT pooran braham dhikhaiaa|
25.e: Concentrating on the form of Guru i.e. Word of the Guru, he adopts it in life and comes face to :face with the perfect Brahm.

25.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਲਿਵ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
25.t: sabadh surat upadhes liv paarabraham gur giaan janaiaa|
25.e: Concentration of consciousness on the word of the Guru and knowledge bestowed by the Guru provides the awareness about the transcendental Brahm .

25.g: ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਪਿਆਇਆ।
25.t: silaa aloonee chaTanee charan kaval charanodhak piaaiaa|
25.e: Only such a persen quaffs the nectar of feet-wash of the Guru.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ।
25.t: gurmat nihachal chit kar sukh sa(n)paT vich nij ghar chhaiaa|
25.e: This however is nothing less than licking of the tasteless stone. He stablizes his mind in the wisdom of the Guru and reclines comfortably in the chamber of his inner self.

25.g: ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰਹਰੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
25.t: par tan par dhan parahare paaras paras aparas rahaiaa|
25.e: Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of the Guru , he repudiating the wealth and physical body of others remains detached from all.

25.g: ਸਾਧਿ ਅਸਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
25.t: saadh asaadh saadh sa(n)g aaiaa ||2||
25.e: For curing his chronic maladies (of evil propensities) he goes to the holy congregation.

25.g: ੩ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਿਧੀ
25.t: 3 : gurmukhaa(n) dhee bidhee
25.e: Uplift of the gurmukhs

25.g: ਜਿਉ ਵੜ ਬੀਉ ਸਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਸਥਾਰੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਉਪਜਾਇਆ।
25.t: jiau vaR beeau sajeeau hoi kar visathaar birakh upajaiaa|
25.e: As the seed of banyan tree getting developed extends itself in the form of a large tree

25.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਹੰਸ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੀਅ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
25.t: birakhahu hoi saha(n)s fal fal fal vich bahu beea samaiaa|
25.e: And then on that very tree grow thousands of fruits containing myriad seeds (likewise gurmukh makes others like his own self).

25.g: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਗਾਸ ਜਿਉ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
25.t: dhuteeaa cha(n)dh agaas jiau aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|
25.e: That primal Lord, like the second day's moon in the sky, gets himself worshipped iby one and all.

25.g: ਤਾਰੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
25.t: taare ma(n)ddal sa(n)t jan dharam saal sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa|
25.e: The saints are constellation inhabiting the abode of truth in the form of religious places.

25.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
25.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi aap gavai na aap janaiaa|
25.e: They bowing at the feet and becoming dust of , the feet lose there ego and never allow themselves to be noticed by any one.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਜਿਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਵਾਸ ਅਗਾਸੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal dhraoo jivai nihachal vaas agaas chaRhaiaa|
25.e: Attainer of the pleasure fruit, the gurmukh lives steadfastly like the pole star in the sky.

25.g: ਸਭ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
25.t: sabh taare chaufer firaiaa ||3||
25.e: All the stars revolve around him.

25.g: ੪ : ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ
25.t: 4 : bhagat naamadhev
25.e: Namdev, the saint

25.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਂਬਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
25.t: naamaa chhee(n)baa aakheeaai gurmukh bhai bhagat liv laiee|
25.e: Namdev, the calico minter having become gurmukh merged his consciousness in loving devotion.

25.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੈ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
25.t: khatree brahaman dhehurai utam jaat karan vaddiaaiee|
25.e: High caste kshatriyas and Brahmins who went to temple to eulogize the Lord caught hold and ousted Namdev.

25.g: ਨਾਮ ਪਕੜਿ ਉਠਾਲਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਪਿਛਵਾੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ।
25.t: naam pakaR uThaaliaa beh pichhavaaRai har gun gaiee|
25.e: While sitting in the back yard of the temple, he started singing the praises of the Lord.

25.g: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲ ਆਖਾਇਦਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਪੈਜਿ ਰਖਾਈ।
25.t: bhagat vachhal aakhaidhaa fer dhehuraa paij rakhaiee|
25.e: The Lord known as kind to devotees turned the face of the temple towards him and maintained His own reputation.

25.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
25.t: dharageh maan nimaaniaa saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee|
25.e: In the shelter of  holy congregation, the true Guru and the Lord, the humble ones also get honour.

25.g: ਉਤਮੁ ਪਦਵੀ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਵਰਣ ਪਏ ਪਗ ਆਈ।
25.t: autam padhavee neech jaat chaare varan pe pag aaiee|
25.e: High, ranking as well as the so-called low castes i.e. all the four as fell at the feet of Namdev

25.g: ਜਿਉ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
25.t: jiau neevaan neer chal jaiee ||4||
25.e: Just as the water flows down towards low

25.g: ੫ : ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਤ ਨਹੀਂ
25.t: 5 : bhagataa(n) dhee jaat nahee(n)
25.e: The saints have no caste

25.g: ਅਸੁਰ ਭਭੀਖਣੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਵਿਖਲੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
25.t: asur bhabheekhan bhagat hai bidhar dhraoo vikhalee saranaiee|
25.e: Saint Vibhisaa a demon, and Vidur son of maid servant came in the shelter of the Lord. Dhanni is known as a jai

25.g: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਧਨਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕਸਾਈ।
25.t: dha(n)naa jaT vakhaaneeaai sadhanaa jaat ajaat kasaiee|
25.e: And Sadhana was an out caste butcher. Saint Kabir was a weaver

25.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੁਲਾਹੜਾ ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਂਬਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ।
25.t: bhagat kabeer julaahaRaa naamaa chhee(n)baa har gun gaiee|
25.e: And Namdev a calicoprinter who sang the praises of the Lord. Ravidas was a cobbler and saint Sairt belonged to (the so-called ) low barber caste.

25.g: ਕੁਲਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੈਣੁ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਈ।
25.t: kul ravidhaas chamaar hai sain sanaatee a(n)dhar naiee|
25.e: Female crow takes care of the fledgelings of nightingale but they ultimately meet their own family.

25.g: ਕੋਇਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਾਵਣੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਈ।
25.t: koil paalai kaavanee a(n)t milai apane kul jaiee|
25.e: Though Yagoda nurtured Krsna, yet he came to be known as the lotus (son) ) of the family of Vasudev.

25.g: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਜਸੋਧਾ ਪਾਲਿਆ ਵਾਸਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਕਵਲ ਸਦਾਈ।
25.t: kisan jasodhaa paaliaa vaasadhev kul kaval sadhaiee|
25.e: As the pot of any type containing ghee is not said to be bad,

25.g: ਘਿਅ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਭਗਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ।
25.t: ghia bhaa(n)ddaa na veechaareeaai bhagataa jaat sanaat na kaiee|
25.e: Likewise, the saints also have no high or low caste whatsoever.

25.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
25.t: charan kaval satigur saranaiee ||5||
25.e: They all remain in the shelter of the lotus feet of the true Guru.

25.g: ੬ : ਨੀਚ ਥਾਓਂ ਉੱਤਮ ਵਸਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
25.t: 6 : neech thaao(n) u'tam vasataa(n) dhe dhirashaTaa(n)t
25.e: Examples of the lowly places and the best articles

25.g: ਡੇਮੂੰ ਖਖਰਿ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਮਖੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਮਖੀਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
25.t: ddemoo(n) khakhar misaree makhee mel makheer upaiaa|
25.e: From hornets' nest lump sugar and by honey bees the honey hive is produced.

25.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰਿ ਕੀੜਿਅਹੁ ਕੁਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਸਣੁ ਕਿਰਤਾਸੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
25.t: paaT paTa(n)bar keeRiahu kuT kaT san kirataas banaiaa|
25.e: From worms is produced silk and by pounding the hemp, paper is prepared.

25.g: ਮਲਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਵੜੇਵਿਅਹੁ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ।
25.t: malamal hoi vaReviahu chikaR kaval bhavar lobhaiaa|
25.e: Muslin is prepared from cotton seed and in the mire grows the lotus on the black bee gets enamoured.

25.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਥਰੁ ਹੀਰੇ ਮਾਣਕ ਛਾਇਆ।
25.t: jiau man kaale sap sir pathar heere maanak chhaiaa|
25.e: A gem remains in the hood of black snake  and among the stones are found diamonds and rubies.

25.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਲੋਹੁ ਘੜਾਇਆ।
25.t: jaan kathooree mirag tan naau bhagautee loh ghaRaiaa|
25.e: The musk is found in the navel of deer and from ordinary iron the powerful sword is aced.

25.g: ਮੁਸਕੁ ਬਿਲੀਅਹੁ ਮੇਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਜਲਸ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹ ਮਹਕਾਇਆ।
25.t: musak bileeahu medh kar majalas a(n)dhar meh mahakaiaa|
25.e: The brain marrow of musk cat makes the whole gethering fragrant.

25.g: ਨੀਚ ਜੋਨਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
25.t: neech jon utam fal paiaa ||6||
25.e: Thus the creatures and materials of lower species give and attain the highest fruits.

25.g: ੭ : ਰਾਜਾ ਬਲਿ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ
25.t: 7 : raajaa bal dhaa prasa(n)g
25.e: Tale of Bali, the King

25.g: ਬਲਿ ਪੋਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਦਾ ਇੰਦਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਦੀ ਇਛ ਇਛੰਦਾ।
25.t: bal potaa prahilaadh dhaa i(n)dhar puree dhee ichh ichha(n)dhaa|
25.e: Son of Virochan and grand son of Prahalad, king Bali, had a desire of ruling the abode of Indr.

25.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਉ ਇਕ ਇਕੋਤਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
25.t: kar sa(n)pooran jag sau ik ikotar jag kara(n)dhaa|
25.e: He had accomplished hundred yajns (burnt  offerings) and his other hudred yajns were in progress.

25.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਰੰਦਾ।
25.t: baavan roopee aai kai garab nivaar bhagat udhara(n)dhaa|
25.e: Lord in the form of a dwarf came to remove his ego and thus liberated him.

25.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣ ਨੋ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਤਾਲਿ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ।
25.t: ei(n)dhraasan no paraharai jai pataal su hukamee ba(n)dhaa|
25.e: He repudiated the throne of Indr and like an obedient servant went to the nether world.

25.g: ਬਲਿ ਛਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਛਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਰਵਾਨ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ।
25.t: bal chhal aap chhalaion dharavaaje dharavaan hova(n)dhaa|
25.e: The Lord Himself got enamoured of Bali and had to stay as a door keeper of Bali.

25.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਲੈ ਸਿਪ ਜਿਉ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਭੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ।
25.t: savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh lai sip jiau motee chubhee maar suha(n)dhaa|
25.e: Bali, the king is like that shell which in the svati naksatr (a special star formation) receiving a drop and making it a pearl dives deep at the bottom of the sea.

25.g: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ ॥੭॥
25.t: heerai heeraa bedh mila(n)dhaa ||7||
25.e: The diamond heart of devotee Bali, cut by the diamond Lord was finally subsumed in Him.

25.t: 8 : keeRee
25.e: Example of an ant

25.g: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਸਦਾਵਣਾ ਕੀੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ।
25.t: neechahu neech sadhaavanaa keeRee hoi na aap ganaae|
25.e: Ants never make themselves noticed and are known lowest among the lowly.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਖਡੁ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਮਾਏ।
25.t: gurmukh maarag chalanaa ikat khadd saha(n)s samaae|
25.e: They follow the path of gurmukhs and due to their broad mindedness they live in thousands, in a small hole.

25.g: ਘਿਅ ਸਕਰ ਦੀ ਵਾਸ ਲੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਥੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਏ।
25.t: ghia sakar dhee vaas lai jithai dharee tithai chal jaae|
25.e: Only by smelling ghee and sugar, they reach the place where these things are kept (gurmukhs also search out he holy congregations).

25.g: ਡੁਲੈ ਖੰਡੁ ਜੁ ਰੇਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੰਡੂ ਦਾਣਾ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਏ।
25.t: ddulai kha(n)ddu ju ret vich kha(n)ddoo dhaanaa chun chun khaae|
25.e: They pick up the sugar bits scattered in sand similarly as a gurmukh  cherishes the virtues.

25.g: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਦੇ ਭੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ।
25.t: bhira(n)gee dhe bhai jai mar hovai bhira(n)gee maar jeevaae|
25.e: Dying of the fear of worm bhringi the ant itself becomes bhringi and makes others also like itself.

25.g: ਅੰਡਾ ਕਛੂ ਕੂੰਜ ਦਾ ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ।
25.t: a(n)ddaa kachhoo koo(n)j dhaa aasaa vich niraas valaae|
25.e: Like the eggs of heron and tortoise, it (ant) remains detached amidst hopes.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
25.t: gurmukh gursikh sukh fal paae ||8||
25.e: Similarly gurmukhs also getting educated attain the pleasure fruits.

25.g: ੯ : ਨਿੱਕੇ ਹੋਣ ਪੁਰ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਧ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ
25.t: 9 : ni'ke hon pur lok prasi'dh prasa(n)g
25.e: Many a story of becoming humble

25.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਆਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਭੁਣਹਣਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ।
25.t: sooraj paas biaas jai hoi bhunahanaa ka(n)n samaanaa|
25.e: Rishi Vyas went to sun and becoming a small insect entered into his ear i.e. most humbly he remained with him and got educated by sun).

25.g: ਪੜੑਹਿ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ।
25.t: paR(h)h vidhiaa ghar aaiaa gurmukh baalameek man bhaanaa|
25.e: Valmiki also only becoming guru- oriented attained knowledge and then he returned home.

25.g: ਆਦਿ ਬਿਆਸ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ।
25.t: aadh biaas vakhaaneeaai kath kath saasatr vedh puraanaa|
25.e: The exponent of many stories of the Vedas, Shastras and the Puranas Valmili is known as the primal poet.

25.g: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਗਵਤੁ ਪੜੑਹਿ ਪਤੀਆਣਾ।
25.t: naaradh mun upadhesiaa bhagat bhaagavat paR(h)h pateeaanaa|
25.e: Sage Narad  preached to him and only after reading the Blia-gavat of devotion he could attain peace.

25.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧਿਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਸੁਖਾਣਾ।
25.t: chaudheh vidhiaa sodhikai paraupakaar achaar sukhaanaa|
25.e: He researched  the fourteen skills but ultimately he got happiness due to his benevolent conduct.

25.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
25.t: paraupakaaree saadhasa(n)g patit udhaaran biradh vakhaanaa|
25.e: Association with such humble sadhus is altruistic and makes one habitual liberates of the fallen ones.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੯॥
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal pat paravaanaa ||9||
25.e: Gurmukhs attain pleasure fruits in it and get dignified acceptance in the court of the Lord.

25.g: ੧੦ : ਸੁਕਦੇਵ
25.t: 10 : sukadhev
25.e: Sukadev

25.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਮਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਕਿ ਲਈ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
25.t: baareh varhe garabhaas vas ja(n)madhe hee suk liee udhaasee|
25.e: Having remained in his mother's womb for twelve years, Sukadev adopted  detachedness right form the very time of his birth.

25.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਹਠ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੰਦਿਖਲਾਸੀ।
25.t: maiaa vich ateet hoi man haTh budh na ba(n)dhikhalaasee|
25.e: Though he went beyond  maya yet because of his intellect pushed by stubbornness of mind, he could not attain liberation.

25.g: ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਆਸ ਪਰਬੋਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਜਨਕ ਸਹਜ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ।
25.t: pitaa biaas parabodhiaa gur kar janak sahaj abhiaasee|
25.e: His father Vyas made him understand that he should adopt king Janak as his guru who is well grounded in the art of remaining in equipoise.

25.g: ਤਜਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਈ ਸਿਰ ਧਰਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਾਬਾਸੀ।
25.t: taj dhuramat gurmat liee sir dhar jooTh milee saabaasee|
25.e: Doing so, and divesting himself of the evil wisdom,he acquired he wisdom of Guru and as ordered by his guru he carried left overs on his head and thus earned pats from the guru.

25.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ।
25.t: gur upadhes aves kar garab nivaar jagat gurdhaasee|
25.e: When inspired by the teachings f the guru he repudiated ego, the whole world accepted him as guru and  became his servant .

25.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ।
25.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi gurmat bhaau bhagat paragaasee|
25.e: By falling at the feet, by becoming dust of the feet and by the wisdom of the guru, loving devotion came up in him.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੧੦॥
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj nivaasee ||10||
25.e: As a gurmukh attaining pleasure fruit he got himself lodged in equipoise.

25.g: ੧੧ : ਗੁਰ ਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਖਤਾ
25.t: 11 : gur si'khaa(n) dhee vishekhataa
25.e: Virtues of the Sikhs of Guru

25.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਜਨਕ ਦੇ ਵਡਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
25.t: raaj jog hai janak dhe vaddaa bhagat kar vedh vakhaanai|
25.e: Janak is a king as well as a yogi and the books of knowledge describe him as great devotee.

25.g: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਣੈ।
25.t: sanakaadhik naaradh udhaas baal subhai ateet suhaanai|
25.e: Sanaks and Narad from their very childhood were of detached nature and adorned themselves with indifference to all.

25.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੈ।
25.t: jog bhog lakh la(n)gh kai gur sikh saadhasa(n)gat nirabaanai|
25.e: Going beyond millions of detachments and enjoyments, the Sikhs of Guru also remain humble m the holy congregation.

25.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
25.t: aap ganai viguchanaa aap gavaae aap sin(j)aanai|
25.e: He who gets himself counted or noticed goes astray in illusions; but he who loses his ego infact identifies his self.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਚ ਦਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਵਣਾ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੈ।
25.t: gurmukh maarag sach dhaa pairee pavanaa raaje raanai|
25.e: Gurmukh' s way is the way of truth whereby all the kings and emperors fall on his feet.

25.g: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਕੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਣੈ।
25.t: garab gumaan visaarikai gurmat ridhai gareebee aanai|
25.e: Treader of this path, forgetting his ego and pride cherishes humility in his heart through the wisdom of the Guru.

25.g: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੧॥
25.t: sachee dharageh maan nimaanai ||11||
25.e: Such an humble person gets respects and regards in the true court.

25.g: ੧੨ : ਚਰਣੋਦਿਕ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਖਤਾ
25.t: 12 : charanodhik vishekhataa
25.e: Virtues of the feet wash

25.g: ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੇ ਵਾਲਾ।
25.t: sir uchaa abhimaan vich kaalakh bhariaa kaale vaalaa|
25.e: Proud head remains erect and high yet it is coveved by the blackness of hair.

25.g: ਭਰਵਟੇ ਕਾਲਖ ਭਰੇ ਪਿਪਣੀਆਂ ਕਾਲਖ ਸੂਰਾਲਾ।
25.t: bharavaTe kaalakh bhare pipaneeaa(n) kaalakh sooraalaa|
25.e: Eyebrows are full of blackness and the eye lashes are also like black thorns.

25.g: ਲੋਇਣ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਦਾੜੀ ਮੁਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲਾ।
25.t: loin kaale jaaneean dhaaRee muchhaa kar muh kaalaa|
25.e: Eyes are black (in India) and like wise beards and moustaches are also black.

25.g: ਨਕ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਕ ਵਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਲੂੰਇ ਲੂੰਇ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ।
25.t: nak a(n)dhar nak vaal bahu loo(n)i loo(n)i kaalakh betaalaa|
25.e: Many trichomes are there in the nose and all of them are black.

25.g: ਉਚੈ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
25.t: auchai a(n)g na poojeean charan dhooR gurmukh dharamasaalaa|
25.e: Organs placed higher are not worshipped and the dust of the feet of gurmukhs  is adorable like holy places .

25.g: ਪੈਰਾ ਨਖ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਨਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦੁਰਾਲਾ।
25.t: pairaa nakh mukh ujale bhaar uchain dheh dhuraalaa|
25.e: Feet and nails are blessed because they carry`the load of the whole body.

25.g: ਸਿਰ ਧੋਵਣੁ ਅਪਵਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਜਗ ਭਾਲਾ।
25.t: sir dhovan apavi'tr hai gurmukh charanodhak jag bhaalaa|
25.e: The head wash is considered dirty but the feet wash of the gurmukhs is sought after by the whole world.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧੨॥
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj sukhaalaa ||12||
25.e: Attaining the pleasure fruit the gurmukhs in their equipoise, remain as the store house of all delights.

25.g: ੧੩ : ਈਸ਼੍ਵਰੀਯ ਰਚਨਾ
25.t: 13 : ieeshavaireey rachanaa
25.e: Godly creation

25.g: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ।
25.t: jal vich dharatee dharamasaal dharatee a(n)dhar neer nivaasaa|
25.e: Earth, the abode for the conduct of dharma is supported by water and inside earth,too, resides water.

25.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੁਵਾਸਾ।
25.t: charan kaval saranaagatee nihachal dheeraj dharam suvaasaa|
25.e: Coming into the shelter of the lotus feet (of the Guru), the earth is pervaded by the fragrance of firm fortitude, and dharma.

25.g: ਕਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੁਸਮਾਵਲੀ ਬੂਟੀ ਜੜੀ ਘਾਹ ਅਬਿਨਾਸਾ।
25.t: kirakh birakh kusamaavalee booTee jaRee ghaeh abinaasaa|
25.e: On it (earth) grow trees, lines of flowers, herbs and grass which never exhaust.

25.g: ਸਰ ਸਾਇਰ ਗਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ।
25.t: sar sair gir mer bahu ratan padhaarath bhog bilaasaa|
25.e: Many a pond, ocean, mountain, jewel and pleasure giving material are there on it.

25.g: ਦੇਵ ਸਥਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਣੇ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ।
25.t: dhev sathal teerath ghane ra(n)g roop ras kas paragaasaa|
25.e: Many godly places, pilgrimage centres, hues, forms, edibles and inedibles come forth from it.

25.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ।
25.t: gur chele raharaas kar gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat gunataasaa|
25.e: Owing to the tradition of the Guru-disciple, the holy congregation of the gurmukhs is also a similar ocean of virtues.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧੩॥
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal aas niraasaa ||13||
25.e: Remaining detached amidst hopes and desires is the pleasure fruit for the gurmukhs.

25.g: ੧੪ : ਸਾਧ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾ
25.t: 14 : saadh charan poojaa
25.e: Worship of the feet of sadhu

25.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
25.t: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR samaiee|
25.e: The Lord has subsumed crores of universes in His each trichome.

25.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
25.t: paarabraham pooran braham sat purakh satigur sukhadhaiee|
25.e: The true Guru form of that primal perfect and transcendental Brahm is bestower of delights.

25.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
25.t: chaar varan gursikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee|
25.e: All the four vamas come to the shelter of the true Guru in the form of holy congregation

25.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
25.t: giaan dhiaan simaran sadhaa gurmukh sabadh surat liv laiee|
25.e: And the gurmukhs there merge their consciousness in the Word through learning, meditation and, prayer.

25.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੇ ਵਸਾਈ।
25.t: bhai bhagat bhau piram ras satigur moorat ridhe vasaiee|
25.e: Fear of the Lord, loving devotion and the delight of love, for them, is the idol of the true Guru whom they cherish in their heart.

25.g: ਏਵਡੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਂਦੇ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ।
25.t: evadd bhaar uchai(n)dhe saadh charan poojaa gur bhaiee|
25.e: The feet of the true Guru in the form of sadhu bear so much load (mental as well as spiritual) of their disciples that,

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal keem na paiee ||14||
25.e: 0 my brothers you, ought to worship them. The value of the pleasure fruit of the gunnukhs cannot be estimated.

25.g: ੧੫ : ਅਨੵਾਈ ਰਾਜੇ
25.t: 15 : anayeaiee raaje
25.e: Unjust kings

25.g: ਵਸੈ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇਕੈ ਪਰਨਾਲੀਂ ਹੁਇ ਵੀਹੀਂ ਆਵੈ।
25.t: vasai chhahabar laikai paranaalee(n) hui veehee(n) aavai|
25.e: When it rains cats and dogs, the water flowing through gargoyles comes down in the streets.

25.g: ਲਖ ਨਾਲੇ ਉਛਲ ਚਲਨਿ ਲਖ ਪਰਵਾਹੀ ਵਾਹ ਵਹਾਵੈ।
25.t: lakh naale uchhal chalan lakh paravaahee vaeh vahaavai|
25.e: Millions of streams overflowing become millions of currents.

25.g: ਲਖ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਖ ਵਾਹਿ ਵਹਿ ਨਦੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਲੇ ਰਲਾਵੈ।
25.t: lakh naale lakh vaeh veh nadheeaa a(n)dhar rale ralaavai|
25.e: Millions of rivulets join the currents of rivers.

25.g: ਨਉ ਸੈ ਨਦੀ ਨੜਿੰਨਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਪਛਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਚਲਾਵੈ।
25.t: nau sai nadhee naRi(n)navai poorab pachham hoi chalaavai|
25.e: Nine hundred and ninety nine rivers flow in the east and the west directions.

25.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਜਾਇ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ।
25.t: nadheeaa jai samu(n)dh vich saagar sa(n)gam hoi milaavai|
25.e: Rivers go to meet the sea.

25.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਗੜਾੜ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ਨ ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰਾਵੈ।
25.t: sat samu(n)dh gaRaaR meh jai samaeh na peT bharaavai|
25.e: Seven such seas merge into the oceans but still the oceans are not satiated.

25.g: ਜਾਇ ਗੜਾੜੁ ਪਤਾਲ ਹੇਠਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਵੇ ਦੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
25.t: jai gaRaaR pataal heTh hoi tave dhee boo(n)dh samaavai|
25.e: In the nether world, such oceans also look like a drop of water on a hot plate.

25.g: ਸਿਰ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਇੰਨਣੁ ਜਾਲਿ ਤਵੇ ਨੋ ਤਾਵੈ।
25.t: sir patisaahaa lakh lakh i(n)nan jaal tave no taavai|
25.e: To heat this plate, millions of heads of the emperors are used as fuel.

25.g: ਮਰਦੇ ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦਾਵੈ ॥੧੫॥
25.t: maradhe kheh kheh dhuneeaa dhaavai ||15||
25.e: And these emperors staking their claims on this earth go on fighting and dying.

25.g: ੧੬ : ਦੋ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹ-ਵੀਹ ਫਕੀਰ
25.t: 16 : dho paatashaaha-veeh fakeer
25.e: Two Kings and twenty faquirs -

25.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਥੇਕੈ ਦੁਇ ਖੜਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਪਾਤਸਾਹ ਨ ਮੁਲਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੈ।
25.t: eikat thekai dhui khaRag dhui paatasaeh na mulak samaanai|
25.e: In one sheath two swords and two emperors in one country cannot be accommodated;

25.g: ਵੀਹ ਫਕੀਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਿੰਥ ਖਿੰਧੋਲੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਲੁਕਾਣੈ।
25.t: veeh fakeer maseet vich khi(n)th khi(n)dholee heTh lukaanai|
25.e: But twenty faquirs in one mosque under one patched blanket can remain (comfortably).

25.g: ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੀਹ ਦੁਇ ਪੋਸਤ ਡੋਡੇ ਖਸਖਸ ਦਾਣੈ।
25.t: ja(n)gal a(n)dhar seeh dhui posat ddodde khasakhas dhaanai|
25.e: Emperors are like two lions in a jungle whereas the faquirs are like the opium seeds in one pod.

25.g: ਸੂਲੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਬਜਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਣੈ।
25.t: soolee upar khelanaa sir dhar chhatr bajaar vikaanai|
25.e: These seeds play on the 'bed of thorns before they get the honour of selling in the market.

25.g: ਕੋਲੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੀੜੀਅਨਿ ਪੋਸਤਿ ਪੀਹਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਛਾਣੈ।
25.t: koloo a(n)dhar peeReean posat peeh piaale chhaanai|
25.e: They are rushed in the press with water before they are strained into the cup .

25.g: ਲਉਬਾਲੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ।
25.t: laubaalee dharagaeh vich garab gunaahee maan nimaanai|
25.e: In the court of the fearless Lord, the proud ones are called sinners and the humble get respects and regards.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਂਦੇ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੈ ॥੧੬॥
25.t: gurmukh ho(n)dhe taan nitaanai ||16||
25.e: That is why the gurmukhs though powerful behave as the meek ones.

25.t: 17 : ba'karee
25.e: She goat

25.g: ਸੀਹ ਪਜੂਤੀ ਬਕਰੀ ਮਰਦੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੜ ਹੜ ਹਸੀ।
25.t: seeh pajootee bakaree maradhee hoiee haR haR hasee|
25.e: A goat was caught by a lion and while about to die, it gave out a horse­ laugh.

25.g: ਸੀਹੁ ਪੁਛੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਇ ਇਤੁ ਅਉਸਰ ਕਿਤੁ ਰਹਸਿ ਰਹਸੀ।
25.t: seeh puchhai visamaadh hoi it aausar kit rahas rahasee|
25.e: The surprised lion asked why it was so happy at such a moment (of its death).

25.g: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ ਬਕਰੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਾਡੇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਖਸੀ।
25.t: binau kare(n)dhee bakaree putr asaadde keechan khasee|
25.e: Humbly the goat replied that the testicals of our male progeny are crushed in order to castrate them.

25.g: ਅਕ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਕੁਹਿ ਕੁਹਿ ਖਲ ਉਖਲਿ ਵਿਣਸੀ।
25.t: ak dhatooraa khaadhiaa kuh kuh khal ukhal vinasee|
25.e: We eat only wild plants of arid regions yet our skin is peeled and pounded.

25.g: ਮਾਸੁ ਖਾਨਿ ਗਲ ਵਢਿਕੈ ਹਾਲੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਹੋਵਸੀ।
25.t: maas khaan gal vaddikai haal tinaaRaa kaun hovasee|
25.e: I think about the plight of those (like you) who cut the throat of others and eat their flesh.

25.g: ਗਰਬੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਦੇਹ ਖੇਹ ਖਾਜੁ ਅਖਾਜੁ ਅਕਾਜੁ ਕਰਸੀ।
25.t: garab gareebee dheh kheh khaaj akhaaj akaaj karasee|
25.e: The body of both of the proud and the humble will become dust ultimately, but, even then the body of the arrogant (lion) is inedible and that of the humble (goat) attaims the status of edible.

25.g: ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ਮਰਸੀ ॥੧੭॥
25.t: jag aaiaa sabh koi marasee ||17||
25.e: All who came to this world have to die ultimately.

25.g: ੧੮ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ
25.t: 18 : gurmukh
25.e: Gurmukh

25.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ।
25.t: charan kaval raharaas kar gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat paragaasee|
25.e: By remaining in and around the lotus feet, the gurmukh receives the light of the holy congregation.

25.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਮਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।
25.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi lekh alekh amar abinaasee|
25.e: Worshipping the feet and becoming the dust of the feet one becomes detached , immortal and indestructible .

25.g: ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਆਚਮਨ ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ।
25.t: kar charanodhak aachaman aadh biaadh upaadh khalaasee|
25.e: Drinking the ash of the feet of gurmukhs, freedom from all physical mental and spiritual ailments is attained.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
25.t: gurmat aap gavaiaa maiaa a(n)dhar karan udhaasee|
25.e: Through the wisdom of the Guru they lose, their ego and do not get absorbed in maya.

25.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
25.t: sabadh surat livaleen hoi nira(n)kaar sachakha(n)dd nivaasee|
25.e: Absorbing their consciousness in the word, they reside in the true abode (holy congregation) of the formless one.

25.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ।
25.t: abigat gat agaadh bodh akath kathaa acharaj gurdhaasee|
25.e: The tale of the servants of the Lord is unfathomable ineffable and Manifest.

25.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ॥੧੮॥
25.t: gurmukh sukh fal aas niraasee ||18||
25.e: Remaining indifferent to hopes is the pleasure fruit of the Gurmukhs.

25.g: ੧੯ : ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਤਾਰਦਾ ਹੈ
25.t: 19 : satisa(n)g niradhokh taaradhaa hai
25.e: Holy congregation liberates even the knaves

25.g: ਸਣ ਵਣ ਵਾੜੀ ਖੇਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਜਣਾਵੈ।
25.t: san van vaaRee khet ik paraupakaar vikaar janaavai|
25.e: Hemp and cotton grow in the same field but the use of one is benevolent while the other one is put to evil use.

25.g: ਖਲ ਕਢਾਹਿ ਵਟਾਇ ਸਣ ਰਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਨ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
25.t: khal kaddaeh vaTai san rasaa ba(n)dhan hoi banhaavai|
25.e: After peeling off the hemp plant rope is made whose nooses are used to tie people in bondage.

25.g: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਤਾਇ ਕਪਾਹ ਵੁਣਾਵੈ।
25.t: khaasaa malamal sireesaaf soot katai kapaeh vunaavai|
25.e: On the other hand, from cotton are made coarse cloth muslin and sirisaf.

25.g: ਲਜਣੁ ਕਜਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਧੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਵੈ।
25.t: lajan kajan hoi kai saadh asaadh biradh biradhaavai|
25.e: Cotton in the form of cloth covers the modesty of others and protects the dharma of sadhus as well as wicked persons.

25.g: ਸੰਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਨ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ।
25.t: sa(n)g dhokh niradhokh mokh sa(n)g subhaau na saadh miTaavai|
25.e: The sadhus even when they associate with the evil never repudiate their saintly nature.

25.g: ਤ੍ਰਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੁਮਾਵੈ।
25.t: trapaR hovai dharamasaal saadhasa(n)gat pag dhooR dhumaavai|
25.e: When the hemp transformed into coarse cloth is brought to the holy places for spreading in the holy congregation, it also becomes blest after coming in touch with the dust of the feet of the sadhus.

25.g: ਕੁਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਸਣ ਕਿਰਤਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ।
25.t: kuT kuT san kirataas kar har jas likh puraan sunaavai|
25.e: Also, when after getting a thorough beating paper is made of it, the holy men write praises of the Lord.on it and recite the same for others.

25.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
25.t: patit puneet karai jan bhaavai ||19||
25.e: The holy congregation makes the fallen ones also  holy.

25.g: ੨੦ : ਸੰਗਤ ਗੁਣ
25.t: 20 : sa(n)gat gun
25.e: virtues of the holy congregation

25.g: ਪਥਰ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਚੂਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਗੀ ਦਧਾ।
25.t: pathar chit kaThor hai choonaa(n) hovai agee dhadhaa|
25.e: When the hard hearted stone is burnt, it turns into lime stone. sprinkling of  water extinguishes fire

25.g: ਅਗ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਲੁ ਛਿੜਕਿਐ ਚੂਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਉਠੈ ਅਤਿ ਵਧਾ।
25.t: ag bujhai jal chhiRakiaai choonaa ag uThai at vadhaa|
25.e: But in the case of lime water produces great heat.

25.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਏ ਵਿਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਧਾ।
25.t: paanee paae vih na jai agan na chhuTai avagun badhaa|
25.e: Its poison does not go away even if water is thrown on it and its foul fire remains in it .

25.g: ਜੀਭੈ ਉਤੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਛਾਲੇ ਪਵਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਲਧਾ।
25.t: jeebhai utai rakhiaa chhaale pavan sa(n)g dhukh ladhaa|
25.e: If put on tongue, it creates painful blisters.

25.g: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੁ ਸਧਾ।
25.t: paan supaaree kath mil ra(n)g sura(n)g sa(n)pooran sadhaa|
25.e: But getting company of betel leaf, betel nut and catechu its colour becomes bright, beautiful and completely refined.

25.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਮਧਾ।
25.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil saadh hoi gurmukh mahaa asaadh samadhaa|
25.e: Similarly joining the holy congregation becoming holy men, the gurmukhs get rid of even the chronic ailments.

25.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਲੁ ਅਧਾ ॥੨੦॥੨੫॥
25.t: aap gavai milai pal adhaa ||20||25||
25.e: When the ego is lost, God is visualized even in half a moment.

26.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
26.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
26.e: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

26.g: ੧ : ਮੰਗਲਾਚਰਨ
26.t: 1 : ma(n)galaacharan
26.e: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: satigur sachaa paatisaeh paatisaahaa paatisaahu sira(n)dhaa|
26.e: The true Guru is true emperor and He is creator of the emperor of the emperors.

26.g: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਵਸੰਦਾ।
26.t: sachai takhat nivaas hai saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasa(n)dhaa|
26.e: He sits on the throne of truth and resides in holy congregation, the abode of truth.

26.g: ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ਫਿਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: sach furamaan neesaan sach sachaa hukam na mool fira(n)dhaa|
26.e: Truth is His mark and truth He utters and His command is irrefutable.

26.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
26.t: sach sabadh Takasaal sach gur te gur hui sabadh mila(n)dhaa|
26.e: He whose Word is true and whose treasure is true, is attainable in the form of the word of the Guru.

26.g: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ।
26.t: sachee bhagat bha(n)ddaar sach raag ratan keeratan bhaava(n)dhaa|
26.e: His devotion is true, His warehouse is true and He likes love and praise.

26.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਦੋਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th hai sach dhohee sach raaj kara(n)dhaa|
26.e: The way of the gurmukhs is also true, their slogan is truth and their kingdom is also the kingdom of truth.

26.g: ਵੀਹਿ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹੰਦਾ ॥੧॥
26.t: veeh ikeeh chaRhaau chaRha(n)dhaa ||1||
26.e: The treader on this path, crossing the world goes on to meet the Lord.

26.g: ੨ : ਉਹੋ ਹੀ
26.t: 2 : uho hee
26.e: Invocation

26.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
26.t: gur paramesar jaaneeaai sache sachaa naau dharaiaa|
26.e: The Guru ought to be known as the Supreme Lord because only that true being has adopted the true name (of the Lord).

26.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
26.t: nira(n)kaar aakaar hoi eka(n)kaar apaar sadhaiaa|
26.e: The formless Lord has made His self known in the form of Ekaiikar, the one boundless Being.

26.g: ਏਕੰਕਾਰਹੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
26.t: eka(n)kaarahu sabadh dhun oa(n)kaar akaar banaiaa|
26.e: From Ekanka came up Oankar, the Word vibration which further came to be known as the world, full of names and forms.

26.g: ਇਕਦੂ ਹੋਏ ਤਿਨ ਦੇਵ ਤਿਹੁਂ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
26.t: eikadhoo hoe tin dhev tihu(n) mil dhas avataar ganaiaa|
26.e: From the one Lord came out three gods (Brahma-, Visnu and Mahes'a) who further got themselves counted among the ten incarnations (of the supreme Being).

26.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨ੍ਹਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
26.t: aadh purakh aadhes hai oh vekhai onhaa nadhar na aaiaa|
26.e: I salute this primal Being who sees them all but is Himself invisible.

26.g: ਸੇਖ ਨਾਗੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਵਾਂ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
26.t: sekh naag simaran karai naavaa(n) a(n)t bia(n)t na paiaa|
26.e: The mythical snake (Sesanag) recites and remembers Him through His myriad names but even then knows nothing about His ultimate extent.

26.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
26.t: gurmukh sach naau man bhaiaa ||2||
26.e: The true name of same Lord is loved by gurmukhs.

26.g: ੩ : ਈਸ਼੍ਵਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ
26.t: 3 : ieeshavairee usatat
26.e: Praises of the Wondrous Guru  the Lord

26.g: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਇਆ।
26.t: a(n)bar dharat vichhoRian kudharat kar karataar kahaiaa|
26.e: God has stabilized earth and sky separately and for His this power He is known as the creator.

26.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮਾਂ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
26.t: dharatee a(n)dhar paaneeaai vin tha(n)maa(n) aagaas rahaiaa|
26.e: He has settled earth in water and without props the sky He has placed in a stable position.

26.g: ਇੰਨ੍ਹਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਿ ਧਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
26.t: ei(n)nhan a(n)dhar ag dhar ahinis sooraj cha(n)dh upaiaa|
26.e: Putting fire in the fuel He has created sun and moon shining day and night.

26.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ।
26.t: chhia rut baarahamaeh kar khaanee baanee chalat rachaiaa|
26.e: Making six seasons and twelve months He has undertaken the sport of creating four mines and four speeches.

26.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
26.t: maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai safal janam gur pooraa paiaa|
26.e: Human life is rare and whosoever has found the perfect Gum, his life has become blessed.

26.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
26.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil sahaj samaiaa ||3||
26.e: Meeting the holy congregation man is absorbed in equipoise.

26.g: ੪ : ਉਹੋ ਹੀ
26.t: 4 : uho hee
26.e: Benevolence of the true Guru

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ।
26.t: satigur sach dhaataar hai maanas janam amol dhivaiaa|
26.e: The true Guru is truly benevolent as he has granted us the human life.

26.g: ਮੂਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੇ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
26.t: mooh akhee nak ka(n)n kar hath pair dhe chalai chalaiaa|
26.e: Mouth, eyes, nose, ears He created and has given feet so that the individual could move around.

26.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
26.t: bhaau bhagat upadhes kar naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa|
26.e: Preaching loving devotion, the true Guru has bestowed on the people steadfastness in remembering the Lord, ablution and charity.

26.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਨਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੁ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ।
26.t: a(n)mirat velai naavanaa gurmukh jap gurma(n)t japaiaa|
26.e: In ambrosial hours the gurmukhs undertake to inspire themselves and others to bathe and recite the mantra of the Guru.

26.g: ਰਾਤ ਆਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
26.t: raat aaratee sohilaa maiaa vich udhaas rahaiaa|
26.e: In the evening, instructing the recitation of Arati and Sohild, the true Guru has inspired people to remain detached even amidst maya.

26.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
26.t: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhei na aap ganaiaa|
26.e: The Guru has preached people to speak mildly, to conduct themselves humbly and to not to get noticed even after giving something to others.

26.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
26.t: chaar padhaarath pichhai laiaa ||4||
26.e: This way the true Guru has made all the four ideals (dharma, arch, Wm and moks) of life to follow him.

26.g: ੫ : ਗੁਰ ਉਸਤਤਿ
26.t: 5 : gur usatat
26.e: Praises of the Guru

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
26.t: satigur vaddaa aakheeaai vadde dhee vaddee vaddiaaiee|
26.e: The true Guru is called great and the glory of the great is also great.

26.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
26.t: oa(n)kaar akaar kar lakh dhareeaau na keemat paiee|
26.e: Oankar has assumed the form of the world and millions of life-streams could not know about His grandeur.

26.g: ਇਕ ਵਰਭੰਡੁ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦਿਵਾਈ।
26.t: eik varabha(n)dd akha(n)dd hai jeea ja(n)t kar rijak dhivaiee|
26.e: The One Lord uninterruptedly is pervading the whole universe and provides livelihood to all creatures.

26.g: ਲੂੰਅ ਲੂੰਅ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
26.t: loo(n)a loo(n)a vich rakhion kar varabha(n)dd karoR samaiee|
26.e: That Lord has subsumed crores of universes in His each trichome.

26.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਵਣ ਥਾਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੁਛਾ ਜਾਈ।
26.t: kevadd vaddaa aakheeaai kavan thaau kis puchhaa jaiee|
26.e: How His expanse may be explained and whom should one ask as to where He resides.

26.g: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
26.t: apaR koi na ha(n)ghiee sun sun aakhan aakh sunaiee|
26.e: None can reach Him; all talk about Him is on the basis of hearsay.

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਈ ॥੫॥
26.t: satigur moorat paragaTee aaiee ||5||
26.e: That Lord has become manifest in the form of the true Guru.

26.g: ੬ : ਗੁਰ ਉਸਤਤਿ
26.t: 6 : gur usatat
26.e: Praises of the Guru

26.g: ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜਾਣੋਈ।
26.t: dhiaan mool gur dharasano pooran braham jaan jaanoiee|
26.e: The glimpse of the Guru is the basis of meditation because Guru is Brahm and this fact is known to a rare one.

26.g: ਪੂਜ ਮੂਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਈ।
26.t: pooj mool satigur charan kar gurdhev sev sukh hoiee|
26.e: The feet of true Guru, the root of all delights, should be worshipped and only then the delight would be atttained.

26.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਚਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਰਾਧੈ ਕੋਈ।
26.t: ma(n)tr mool satigur bachan ik man hoi araadhai koiee|
26.e: The instructions of the true Guru is the basic formula (mantra) whose adoration with single minded devotion is undertaken by rare one.

26.g: ਮੋਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਈ।
26.t: mokh mool kirapaal gur jeevan mukat saadhasa(n)g soiee|
26.e: The basis of liberation is the grace of the Guru and one attains liberation in life in the holy congregation alone.

26.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ।
26.t: aap ganai na paieeaai aap gavai milai viraloiee|
26.e: Making oneself noticed none can attain the Lord and even shedding the ego any rare one meets Him.

26.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ।
26.t: aap gavaae aap hai sabh ko aap aape sabh koiee|
26.e: He who annihilates his ego, in fact, is the Lord Himself; he knowns everyone as his form and all accept him as their form.

26.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
26.t: gur chelaa chelaa gur hoiee ||6||
26.e: This way that individual in the form of Guru becomes disciple and the disciple is turned to be Guru.

26.g: ੭ : ਚਾਰ ਜੁਗਾਂ ਦੇ ਧਰਮ
26.t: 7 : chaar jugaa(n) dhe dharam
26.e: Conduct of the four Ages

26.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ ਇਕਸ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ।
26.t: satijug paap kamaaniaa ikas pichhai sabh dhes dhukhaalaa|
26.e: In satyug, the whole country suffered due to the evil deeds of even one individual.

26.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਲਾ।
26.t: tretai nagaree peeReeaai dhuaapur paap va(n)s ko dhaalaa|
26.e: In tretayug, the evil committed by one, made the whole city suffer and in dvapar the whole family underwent the pains.

26.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਉ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ।
26.t: kalijug beejai so lunai varatai dharam niaau sukhaalaa|
26.e: Simple is the justice of kaliyug; here only he reaps who sows.

26.g: ਫਲੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਫਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲਾ।
26.t: falai kamaanaa tih jugee kalijug safal dharam tatakaalaa|
26.e: In other three yugs, the fruit of the action was earned and accumulated but in kaliyug, one gets the fruit of dharma immediately.

26.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਵਾਲਾ।
26.t: paap kamaanai lep hai chitavai dharam sufal falavaalaa|
26.e: Somethin* happens only after doing something in the kaliyug but even the thought of dharma gives the happy fruit in it.

26.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
26.t: bhai bhagat gurapurab kar beejan beej sachee dharamasaalaa|
26.e: The gurmukhs, contemplating on the wisdom of Guru and the loving devotion, sow the seed in earth, the true abode of truth.

26.g: ਸਫਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਣ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
26.t: safal manorath pooran ghaalaa ||7||
26.e: They succeed in their practice and objective.

26.g: ੮ : ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਦਾ ਧਰਮ
26.t: 8 : kalijug dhaa dharam
26.e: Conduct in the Kaliyug

26.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਤਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਜੁਗਾ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਹਲੀ ਘਾਲਾ।
26.t: satijug sat tretai jugaa dhuaapar poojaa bahalee ghaalaa|
26.e: In satyug the truth, in treta and dvapar worship and ascetice discipline were in vogue.

26.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਭਵਜਲ ਭਰਨਾਲਾ।
26.t: kalijug gurmukh naau lai paar pavai bhavajal bharanaalaa|
26.e: The gurmukhs, in kaliyug go across the world-ocean by repeating the name of the Lord.

26.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਤਿਜੁਗੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਰਣ ਉਕਾਲਾ।
26.t: chaar charan satijugai vich tretai chauthai charan ukaalaa|
26.e: Dharma had four feet in the satyug but in treta, the fourth foot of dharma was made cripple.

26.g: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਕਤੈ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੰਮੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ।
26.t: dhuaapur hoe pair dhui ikatai pair dhara(n)m dhukhaalaa|
26.e: In dvapar only two feet of dharma survived and in kaliyug the dharma stands only on one foot to undergo the sufferings.

26.g: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ।
26.t: maan nimaanai jaan kai binau karai kar nadhar nihaalaa|
26.e: Considering the Lord as the strength of the powerless ones, it (dharma) started praying for the liberation through the grace of the Lord.

26.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
26.t: gur poorai paragaas kar dheeraj dharam sachee dharamasaalaa|
26.e: The Lord manifesting in the form of the perfect Gum created the true abode of fortitude and the dharma.

26.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਤ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੮॥
26.t: aape khet aape rakhavaalaa ||8||
26.e: Himself is the field (of creation) and Himself its protector.

26.g: ੯ : ਜਿੱਤ ਕੇ ਹਾਰਨਾ
26.t: 9 : ji't ke haaranaa
26.e: Winning by losing

26.g: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਭਾਉ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਅਗੈ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹਾ।
26.t: jinhaa(n) bhaau tin naeh bhau much bhau agai nibhaviaahaa|
26.e: They are not scared of anybody who have cherished the love of the Lord and those who are devoid of the fear of Lord remain scared in the court of Lord.

26.g: ਅਗਿ ਤਤੀ ਜਲ ਸੀਅਲਾ ਨਿਵ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਤਾਹਾ।
26.t: ag tatee jal seealaa niv chalai sir karai utaahaa|
26.e: Since it keeps its head high, the fire is hot and because the water flows downwards, it is cold.

26.g: ਭਰਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਖਾਲੀ ਤਰੈ ਵਜਿ ਨ ਵਜੈ ਘੜੈ ਜਿਵਾਹਾ।
26.t: bhar ddubai khaalee tarai vaj na vajai ghaRai jivaahaa|
26.e: The filled up pitcher drowns and makes no sound and the empty one not only goes on swimming, it rather makes the noise also (likewise is the egotist and the egoless one, the latter absorbing in loving devotion gets liberated and the former goes on tossing

26.g: ਅੰਬੁ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਿ ਝੁਕਿ ਲਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਰੰਡੁ ਨ ਨਿਵੈ ਤਲਾਹਾ।
26.t: a(n)b sufal fal jhuk lahai dhukh fal ara(n)dd na nivai talaahaa|
26.e: Being full of fruits, the mango tree bends down in humility but the castor tree being full of bitter fruits never bows in humility.

26.g: ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਫਲ ਖਾਹਾ।
26.t: man pa(n)kheroo dhaavadhaa sa(n)g subhai jai fal khaahaa|
26.e: The mind-bird keeps flying and according to its nature picks up the fruits.

26.g: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਹਉਲਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਹਾ।
26.t: dhar taaraajoo toleeaai haulaa bhaaraa tol tulaahaa|
26.e: On the scale of justice, the light and the heavy are weighed (and good and bad are differentiated).

26.g: ਜਿਣਿ ਹਾਰੈ ਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਣੈ ਪੈਰਾ ਉਤੇ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਾਹਾ।
26.t: jin haarai haarai jinai pairaa ute sees dharaahaa|
26.e: He who looks to be winning here loses in the court of the Lord and likewise the loser here wins there.

26.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੯॥
26.t: pairee pai jag pairee paahaa ||9||
26.e: All bow at his feet. The individual first falls at the feet (of Guru) and then he makes all to fall at his feet.

26.g: ੧੦ : ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲ
26.t: 10 : jehaa bhaau tehaa fal
26.e: One gets what one desires

26.g: ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ।
26.t: sach hukam sach lekh hai sach kaaran kar khel rachaiaa|
26.e: The order of the Lord is true, His writ is true and from the true cause He has created the creation as His sport.

26.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
26.t: kaaran karate vas hai viralai dhaa oh karai karaiaa|
26.e: All the causes are under the control of the creator but He accepts the deeds of any rare devotee.

26.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ।
26.t: so kih hor na ma(n)giee khasamai dhaa bhaanaa tis bhaiaa|
26.e: The devotee who has loved the will of the Lord, does not beg anything from any one else.

26.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
26.t: khasamai evai bhaavadhaa bhagat vachhal hui biradh sadhaiaa|
26.e: Now the Lord also loves to accept the prayer of the devotee because protection of the devotee is His nature.

26.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਵ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ।
26.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv kaaran karataa karadhaa aaiaa|
26.e: The devotees who keep their consciousness absorbed in the Word in the holy congregation, know well that the creator Lord is the perennial cause of all causes.

26.g: ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਤੀਤ ਜਗਿ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਦਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ।
26.t: baal subhai ateet jag var saraap dhaa bharam chukaiaa|
26.e: The devotee like the innocent child remains detached from the world and keeps himself free from delusions of boons and curses.

26.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
26.t: jehaa bhaau teho fal paiaa ||10||
26.e: He receives the fruit in accordance with his desert.'

26.g: ੧੧ : ਅਉਗਣ ਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਣਾ
26.t: 11 : aaugan dhaa gun karanaa
26.e: Making of the virtue from the evil

26.g: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਦਾ।
26.t: aaugun keete gun karai sahaj subhaau tarovar ha(n)dhaa|
26.e: The tree being in equipoise does good even to the evil doer.

26.g: ਵਢਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਛਾਉ ਬਹਿ ਚੰਗੇ ਦਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵੰਦਾ।
26.t: vaddan vaalaa chhaau beh cha(n)ge dhaa ma(n)dhaa chitava(n)dhaa|
26.e: The tree cutter sits under the shade of the same and thinks evil of that benevolent one.

26.g: ਫਲ ਦੇ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਆ ਵਢਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: fal dhe vaT vagaiaa vaddan vaale taar tara(n)dhaa|
26.e: It gives fruits to the stone throwers and boat to the cutters to get them across.

26.g: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਫਲ ਨਾ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਫਲ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਫਲੰਦਾ।
26.t: bemukh fal naa paidhe sevak fal anaganat fala(n)dhaa|
26.e: The individuals opposed to the Gum do not get fruit and the servants receive infinite reward.

26.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: gurmukh viralaa jaaneeaai sevak sevak sev kara(n)dhaa|
26.e: Any rare gurmukh is known in this world who serves the servants of the Lord's servants.

26.g: ਜਗੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੇ ਚੰਦ ਨੋ ਸਾਇਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਵਧੰਦਾ।
26.t: jag johaare cha(n)dh no sair lahar ana(n)dh vadha(n)dhaa|
26.e: The second day moon is saluted by all and the ocean also becoming glad throws its waves towards it.

26.g: ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
26.t: jo teraa jag tis dhaa ba(n)dhaa ||11||
26.e: 0 Lord! the whole world becomes his who is yours own.

26.g: ੧੨ : ਕਮਾਦ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
26.t: 12 : kamaadh dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
26.e: The example of the sugarcane

26.g: ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਉਪੰਨਾ।
26.t: jiau visamaadh kamaadh hai sir talavaiaa hoi upa(n)naa|
26.e: Nature of sugarcane is wondrous: it takes birth head down.

26.g: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਖਲ ਉਖਲਿਕੈ ਟੋਟੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੰਨਣਿ ਭੰਨਾ।
26.t: pahile khal ukhalikai ToTe kar kar bha(n)nan bha(n)naa|
26.e: First its skin is eeled off and it is cut into pieces.

26.g: ਕੋਲੂ ਪਾਇ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਟਟਰਿ ਕਸ ਇੰਨਣ ਵੰਨਾ।
26.t: koloo pai peeRaiaa ras TaTar kas i(n)nan va(n)naa|
26.e: Then it is crushed in cane crusher; its nice is boiled in a cauldren and the bagasse is burnt as fuel.

26.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਇ ਅਵਟਣੁ ਜਗ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨਾ।
26.t: dhukh sukh a(n)dhar sabar kar khai avaTan jag dha(n)n dha(n)naa|
26.e: It remains ontented in joys and sufferings alike and after getting boiled is called est in the world.

26.g: ਗੁੜੁ ਸਕਰੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਬੰਨਾ।
26.t: guR sakar kha(n)dd misaree gurmukh sukh fal sabh ras ba(n)naa|
26.e: Attaining the pleasure fruit, like gurmukh, it becomes he base of jaggery, sugar and crystal sugar.

26.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਥੀਵਣੁ ਗੰਨਾ।
26.t: piram piaalaa peevanaa mar mar jeevan theevan ga(n)naa|
26.e: Death after quaffing the cup f love is similar to the life of sugarcane which after getting crushed becomes live.

26.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲ ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤੰਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
26.t: gurmukh bol amol rata(n)naa ||12||
26.e: Sayings of gurmukhs are invaluable like jewels.

26.g: ੧੩ : ਗੁਰ ਦਰੀਆਉ
26.t: 13 : gur dhareeaau
26.e: Guru ocean

26.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਹੈ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: gur dhareeaau amaau hai lakh dhareeaau samaau kara(n)dhaa|
26.e: Guru is such an immeasurable ocean that millions of rivers are absorbed in it.

26.g: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਹੰਦਾ।
26.t: eikas ikas dhareeaau vich lakh teerath dhareeaau vaha(n)dhaa|
26.e: Millions of pilgrimage centres are there on each river and in each stream millions of waves are raised by nature.

26.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਵਾਹੜੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਲਖ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠੰਦਾ।
26.t: eikat ikat vaahaRai kudharat lakh tara(n)g uTha(n)dhaa|
26.e: In that Guru-ocean myriad jewels and all the four ideals (dharma, arth, kam and moks) moves around in the form of fish.

26.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਣੁ ਰਤਨਾਵਲੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੀਨ ਤਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: sair san ratanaavalee chaar padhaarath meen tara(n)dhaa|
26.e: All these things are not equal even to one wave (one sentence) of the Guru-ocean.

26.g: ਇਕਤ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤ ਲਹੰਦਾ।
26.t: eikat lahar na pujanee kudharat a(n)t na a(n)t laha(n)dhaa|
26.e: The mystery of the extent of His power is unknowable.

26.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: piram piaale ik boo(n)dh gurmukh viralaa ajar jara(n)dhaa|
26.e: The unbearable drop of the cup of love can be cherished by any rare gurmukh.

26.g: ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖੰਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
26.t: alakh lakhai na alakh lakha(n)dhaa ||13||
26.e: The Guru himself sees that imperceptible Lord, who is not visible to others.

26.g: ੧੪ : ਈਸ਼ਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹੈ
26.t: 14 : ieeshar bea(n)t hai
26.e: God is infinite

26.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦਾਸਣ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
26.t: brahame thake bedh paR i(n)dhr i(n)dhaasan raaj kara(n)dhe|
26.e: Many Brahmas reciting Vedas and many Indrs ruling the kingdoms got tired.

26.g: ਮਹਾਂਦੇਵ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਹੋਇ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਭਵੰਦੇ।
26.t: mahaa(n)dhev avadhoot hoi dhas avataaree bisan bhava(n)dhe|
26.e: Mahadev becoming recluse and Visnu assuming ten incarnations roamed hither and thither.

26.g: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗੀਸਰਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਭੇਵ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
26.t: sidh naath jogeesaraa dhevee dhev na bhev laha(n)dhe|
26.e: Siddhs, naths, chiefs of the yogis, gods and goddesses could not know the mystery of that Lord.

26.g: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਤੀਰਥਾ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਦੇ।
26.t: tape tapeesur teerathaa jatee satee dheh dhukh saha(n)dhe|
26.e: Ascetics, the people going to pilgrimage centres, celebates and numerous satis in order to know Him suffer through their bodies.

26.g: ਸੇਖਨਾਗ ਸਭ ਰਾਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੰਦੇ।
26.t: sekhanaag sabh raag mil simaran kar nit gun gaava(n)dhe|
26.e: Sesanag also along with all musical measures remembers and praises Him.

26.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
26.t: vaddabhaagee gursikh jag sabadh surat satasa(n)g mila(n)dhe|
26.e: In this world only gurmukhs are fortunate who merging their consciousness in the Word gather in holy congregation.

26.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖੰਦੇ ॥੧੪॥
26.t: gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakha(n)dhe ||14||
26.e: Gurmukhs only, become face to face with that imperceptible Lord and attain the fruit of delight.

26.g: ੧੫ : ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਣ
26.t: 15 : ni(n)mrataa dhaa gun
26.e: Merits of humility

26.g: ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਫਲ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦਾ।
26.t: sir talavaiaa birakh hai hoi sahas fal sufal fala(n)dhaa|
26.e: The head (root) of the tree remains downwards and there for it is laden with flowers and fruit.

26.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਨੀਵਾ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਚਲੰਦਾ।
26.t: niramal neer vakhaaneeaai sir neevaa neevaan chala(n)dhaa|
26.e: The water is known as pure because it flows downward.

26.g: ਸਿਰ ਉਚਾ ਨੀਵੇ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਪਵੰਦਾ।
26.t: sir uchaa neeve charan gurmukh pairee sees pava(n)dhaa|
26.e: The head is higher and the feet lower but even then the head bows on the feet of the gurmukh.

26.g: ਸਭਦੂ ਨੀਵੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੈ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਹੰਦਾ।
26.t: sabhadhoo neevee dharat hoi an dhan sabh sai saar saha(n)dhaa|
26.e: The lowest is the earth which bears the burden of the whole world and of the wealth in it.

26.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ।
26.t: dha(n)n dharatee oh thaau dha(n)n gur sikh saadhoo pair dhara(n)dhaa|
26.e: That land and that place is blest where the Guru, the Sikh and ..he holymen put their feet.

26.g: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਵੇਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਿ ਸੁਣੰਦਾ।
26.t: charan dhooR paradhaan kar sa(n)t vedh jas gaav suna(n)dhaa|
26.e: That the dust of the feet of the saints is the highest is told even by the Vedas.

26.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਲਹੰਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
26.t: vaddabhaagee paakhaak laha(n)dhaa ||15||
26.e: Any fortunate one attains the dust of the feet.

26.g: ੧੬ : ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ
26.t: 16 : guroo naanak pooran guroo hai
26.e: The perfect Guru

26.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਠਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
26.t: pooraa satigur jaaneeaai poore pooraa ThaaT banaiaa|
26.e: The perfect true Guru is known in his majestic form.

26.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਘਟਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
26.t: poore pooraa tol hai ghaTai na vadhai ghaTai vadhaiaa|
26.e: Perfect is the justice of the perfect Guru to which nothing can be added nor reduced from.

26.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਸੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ।
26.t: poore pooree mat hai horas puchh na mataa pakaiaa|
