28.e: Inverse is the tradition of love which makes the head bow to the feet. The altruist Sikh considers none as the bad or the worse.

28.g: ੧੩ : ਸਿੱਖ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ
28.t: 13 : si'kh ni(n)mr te paraupakaaree hai
28.e: Sikh, the humble and the benevolent

28.g: ੧੩ : ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੀਆਂ ਚਿਰਜੀਵੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ।
28.t: 13 : gursikh prataapeeaa(n) chirajeeveeaa(n) to(n) u'chaa sukh fal vich hai|
28.e: Sikh, the humble and the benevolent

28.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਪੈਰਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਹੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਵਸੰਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ।
28.t: dharatee pairaa heTh hai dharatee heTh vasa(n)dhaa paanee|
28.e: The earth is under our feet but under the earth is water.

28.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਚਲੈ ਨੀਵਾਣ ਨੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
28.t: paanee chalai neevaan no niramal seetal sudh paraanee|
28.e: Water flows downward and makes others cool and clean.

28.g: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਜਾਣੀ।
28.t: bahu ra(n)gee ik ra(n)g hai sabhanaa a(n)dhar iko jaanee|
28.e: Mixed with various colours, it assumes those colours, but in itself it is colourless common to all.

28.g: ਤਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਪ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਵੈ ਠੰਢਾ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਹਾਣੀ।
28.t: tataa hovai dhup vich chhaavai Tha(n)ddaa viratee haanee|
28.e: It becomes hot in the sun and cool in the shade, that is it acts in consonance with its companions (sun and shade).

28.g: ਤਪਦਾ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨੋ ਠੰਢੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
28.t: tapadhaa paraupakaar no Tha(n)dde paraupakaar vihaanee|
28.e: Whether hot or cold, it's purpose always is for others' good.

28.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਪਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਠੰਢਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਆਣੀ।
28.t: agan bujhaae tapat vich Tha(n)ddaa hovai bilam na aanee|
28.e: Though itself warm, it extinguishes the fire and takes no time to get cold again.

28.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਦੀ ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥੧੩॥
28.t: gur sikhee dhee eh neesaanee ||13||
28.e: These are the virtuous marks of the Sikh culture.

28.g: ੧੪ : ਸਿਖ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰੀ ਤੇ ਪਰੋਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ
28.t: 14 : sikh ni(n)mree te paropakaaree hai
28.e: Sikh, the humble and the benevolent

28.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਸੈ।
28.t: paanee a(n)dhar dharat hai dharatee a(n)dhar paanee vasai|
28.e: Earth is in water and in the earth also is water.

28.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਰਸੈ।
28.t: dharatee ra(n)g na ra(n)g sabh dharatee saau na sabh ras rasai|
28.e: Earth has no colour yet it has all colours (in the form of different vegetation) in it.

28.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਤਰਸੈ।
28.t: dharatee ga(n)dh na ga(n)dh bahu dharat na roop anoop tarasai|
28.e: Earth has no taste yet all the tastes are contained in it.

28.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਦਸੈ।
28.t: jehaa beejai so lunai karam bhoom sabh koiee dhasai|
28.e: No smell is there in the earth, yet all the fragrances reside in it.

28.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਕਸੂਤੁ ਨ ਧਸੈ।
28.t: cha(n)dhan lep na lep hai kar mal moot kasoot na dhasai|
28.e: Earth is a field for actions; here one reaps what one sows.

28.g: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੀਹ ਜਮਾਇਦੇ ਡਵਿ ਲਗੈ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ।
28.t: vuThe meeh jamaidhe ddav lagai a(n)goor vigasai|
28.e: Plastered with sandal paste, it does not get attached to it and fouled up by creatures' excreta it does not sink with anger and shame.

28.g: ਦੁਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਹਸੈ ॥੧੪॥
28.t: dhukh na rovai sukh na hasai ||14||
28.e: After rains people sow corn in it and even after (getting heat) fire new seedlings sprout from it. It does not wail in suffering nor laughs in pleasure.

28.g: ੧੫ : ਸਿੱਖ ਦੀ ਨਿੱਤ ਕਮਾਈ
28.t: 15 : si'kh dhee ni't kamaiee
28.e: Daily conduct of the Sikh

28.g: ਪਿਛਲ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ।
28.t: pichhal raatee jaaganaa naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaae|
28.e: The Sikh awakes in the pre-dawn hour and meditating upon Nan, he becomes alert for ablution and charity.

28.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਏ।
28.t: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhe kai bhalaa manaae|
28.e: He speaks sweetly, moves humbly and giving away something by his hands for the well being of others feels happy.

28.g: ਥੋੜਾ ਸਵਣਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਥੋੜਾ ਬੋਲਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ।
28.t: thoRaa savanaa khaavanaa thoRaa bolan gurmat paae|
28.e: Sleeping and eating maderately he, according to the teachings of the Guru, also does not speak much.

28.g: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ।
28.t: ghaal khai sukirat karai vaddaa hoi na aap ganaae|
28.e: He toils to earn, performs good deeds and though being great never gets his greatness noticed.

28.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈਂ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਏ।
28.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil gaa(n)vadhe raat dhihai(n) nit chal chal jaae|
28.e: Walking for day and night he reaches where Gurbani is sung in the congregation.

28.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਪਰਚਾਏ।
28.t: sabadh surat parachaa karai satigur parachai man parachaae|
28.e: He keeps his consciousness merged in the Word and maintains in the mind love for the true Guru.

28.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
28.t: aasaa vich niraas valaae ||15||
28.e: Amid hopes and desires, he remains detached.

28.g: ੧੬ : ਸਿਖ ਦੀ ਨਿੱਤ ਕਮਾਈ
28.t: 16 : sikh dhee ni't kamaiee
28.e: Daily conduct of the Sikh

28.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ।
28.t: gur chelaa chelaa guroo gur sikh sun gursikh sadhaavai|
28.e: Having listened to the teachings of the Guru the disciple and the Guru become one (in form and spirit).

28.g: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ।
28.t: eik man ik araadhanaa baahar jaa(n)dhaa varaj rahaavai|
28.e: He with single mind adores the one Lord and keeps his straying mind under control.

28.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
28.t: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hoi kai khasamai dhaa bhaanaa tis bhaavai|
28.e: He becomes obedient servant of the lord and loves His will and command.

28.g: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਸੋਇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਰਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
28.t: muradhaa hoi mureedh soi ko viralaa gur gor samaavai|
28.e: Any rare Sikh becoming disciple be a dead person enters the guru-grave.

28.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੈਰਾਂ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਾਵੈ।
28.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi pairaa(n) upar sees dharaavai|
28.e: Falling on the feet and becoming dust of the feet, he reposes his head on the feet of the Guru.

28.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ।
28.t: aap gavaae aap hoi dhoojaa bhaau na nadharee aavai|
28.e: Becoming one with Him he loses his ego and now the sense of duality is nowhere visible with him.

28.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੬॥
28.t: gur sikhee gurusikh kamaavai ||16||
28.e: Such an accomplishment is had only by Sikh of the Guru.

28.g: ੧੭ : ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸਿੱਖ
28.t: 17 : virale si'kh
28.e: Rare Sikh

28.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
28.t: te virale sai(n)saar vich dharasan jot pata(n)g mila(n)dhe|
28.e: Rare are those people who like a moth rush toward the flame of the glimpse (of the Lord).

28.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਗ ਮਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: te virale sai(n)saar vich sabadh surat hoi mirag mara(n)dhe|
28.e: They are also rare in the world who merging their consciousness in the Word die like a deer.

28.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਹੁਇ ਭਵਰ ਵਸੰਦੇ।
28.t: te virale sai(n)saar vich charan kaval hui bhavar vasa(n)dhe|
28.e: Rare are they in this world who like black bee adore lotus feet of the Guru.

28.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਮੀਨ ਤਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: te virale sai(n)saar vich piram sanehee meen tara(n)dhe|
28.e: Rare are (the Sikhs) in the world who becoming full of love swim like fish.

28.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: te virale sai(n)saar vich gur sikh gur sikh sev kara(n)dhe|
28.e: Such Sikhs of the Guru are also rare who serve other Sikhs of the Guru.

28.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਨਿ ਭੈ ਰਹਨਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ।
28.t: bhai vich ja(n)man bhai rahan bhai vich mar gur sikh jeeva(n)dhe|
28.e: Taking birth and sustaining in His order (fear), the Sikhs of the Guru who die while alive (are also rare).

28.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖੰਦੇ ॥੧੭॥
28.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram chakha(n)dhe ||17||
28.e: Thus becoming gurmukhs they taste the fruit of joy.

28.g: ੧੮ : ਸਿੱਖੀ ਸਰਬ ਸ਼ਿਰੋਮਣੀ ਹੈ
28.t: 18 : si'khee sarab shiromanee hai
28.e: Sikh life is supreme

28.g: ਲਖ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਲਖ ਵਰਤ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: lakh jap tap lakh sa(n)jamaa hom jag lakh varat kara(n)dhe|
28.e: Millions of recitations, disciplines, continences, burnt oblations and fasts are performed.

28.g: ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਲਖ ਊਲਖਾ ਲਖ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਗੰਦੇ।
28.t: lakh teerath lakh uoolakhaa lakh pureeaa lakh purab laga(n)dhe|
28.e: Millions of holy journeys, charities are undertaken and millions of holy occasions are celebrated.

28.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਹੁਰੇ ਲਖ ਪੁਜਾਰੀ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: dhevee dheval dhehure lakh pujaaree pooj kara(n)dhe|
28.e: In the abodes of goddesses, and the temples, millions of priests perform worship.

28.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: jal thal maheeal bharamadhe karam dharam lakh fer fira(n)dhe|
28.e: Moving on earth and in the sky, millions practitioners of dharma-oriented activities run hither and thither.

28.g: ਲਖ ਪਰਬਤ ਵਣਖੰਡ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਵੰਦੇ।
28.t: lakh parabat vanakha(n)dd lakh lakh udhaasee hoi bhava(n)dhe|
28.e: Millions of people becoming unconcerned with worldy affairs go on moving in the mountains and forests.

28.g: ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਗੁ ਜਲਾਇਂਦੇ ਲਖ ਹਿਮੰਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਗਲੰਦੇ।
28.t: aganee a(n)g jalai(n)dhe lakh hima(n)chal jai gala(n)dhe|
28.e: Millions are there who die by burning themselves and millions are there who die by freezing themselves In the snowy mountains.

28.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ ॥੧੮॥
28.t: gur sikhee sukh til na laha(n)dhe ||18||
28.e: But they all cannot take even a fraction of joy ,Attainable in the life of a Sikh of the Guru.

28.g: ੧੯ : ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ''ਨਾਨਕ'' ਬਿਨ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀਂ
28.t: 19 : pooraa guroo ''naanaka'' bin gat nahee(n)
28.e: No liberation without the perfect Guru  ''

28.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਣ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
28.t: chaar varan kar varatiaa varan chihan kih nadhar na aaiaa|
28.e: That Lord is diffused in all the four varnas, but , His own colour and mark are imperceptible.

28.g: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀਆਂ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
28.t: chhia dharasan bhekhadhaareeaa(n) dharasan vich na dharasan paiaa|
28.e: The followers of the six philosophical orders (of India) could not see Him in their philosophies.

28.g: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਵ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
28.t: sa(n)niaasee dhas naav dhar naau ganai na naau dhiaaiaa|
28.e: Sannyasis giving ten names to their sects, counted His many names but donnot contemplate the Nam.

28.g: ਰਾਵਲ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
28.t: raaval baareh pa(n)th kar gurmukh pa(n)th na alakh lakhaiaa|
28.e: Ravals (yogis) made their twelve sects but the imperceptible way of the gurmukhs could not be known by them.

28.g: ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀਏ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
28.t: bahu roopee bahu roope'ee roop na rekh na lekh miTaiaa|
28.e: The mimics assumed many forms but even then they could not wipe out the writ (inscribed by the Lord) i.e. they could not attain liberation from transmigration.

28.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਲਦੇ ਸੰਗ ਲਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ।
28.t: mil mil chaladhe sa(n)g lakh saadhoo sa(n)g na ra(n)g ra(n)gaiaa|
28.e: Though millions of people move jointly creating various leagues and sects but they also could not dye their minds in the (steadfast) colour of holy congregation.

28.g: ਵਿਣ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
28.t: vin gur poore mohe maiaa ||19||
28.e: Without the perfect Guru, they all are infatuated by maya.

28.g: ੨੦ : ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ
28.t: 20 : virale ba(n)dhe
28.e: Rare behave according to the wisdom of the Guru

28.g: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਤ ਬੀਜਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
28.t: kirasaanee kirasaan kar khet beej sukh fal na laha(n)dhe|
28.e: Farmers even having done their farming donot attain the fruit of spiritual Leasure.

28.g: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੰਦੇ।
28.t: vanaj karan vaapaare'e lai laahaa nij ghar na vasa(n)dhe|
28.e: The traders engaged in profitable trading donot remain stablized theirselves.

28.g: ਚਾਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸੁਲਹ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
28.t: chaakar kar kar chaakaree haumai maar na suleh kara(n)dhe|
28.e: The servants go on doing their jobs but not eschewing ego Alley donot meet the Lord.

28.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆਂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਬ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੰਦੇ।
28.t: pu(n)n dhaan cha(n)giaaieeaa(n) kar kar karatab thir na raha(n)dhe|
28.e: People, despite their virtues and charities and .even performing many duties donot remain stablized.

28.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਪਰਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੇ।
28.t: raaje paraje hoi kai kar kar vaadh na paar pava(n)dhe|
28.e: Becoming rulers And subjects, people undertake many quarrels but donot go across the world wean.

28.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
28.t: gur sikh sun gurusikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat kar mel mila(n)dhe|
28.e: Sikhs of the Guru, adopt teachings of the Guru, and joining the holy congregation attain that supreme Lord.

28.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਲਦੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ॥੨੦॥
28.t: gurmat chaladhe virale ba(n)dhe ||20||
28.e: Only rare ones behave in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru, the Gurmati.

28.g: ੨੧ : ਬਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰੂ
28.t: 21 : bin gun guroo
28.e: Guru without virtues

28.g: ਗੁੰਗਾ ਗਾਵਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਬੋਲਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੈ।
28.t: gu(n)gaa gaav na jaaniee bolaa sunai na a(n)dhar aanai|
28.e: The dumb person cannot sing and the deaf cannot hear so that nothing enters their understanding.

28.g: ਅੰਨ੍ਹੈ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੀ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
28.t: a(n)nhai dhis na aaviee raat anheree ghar na sin(j)aanai|
28.e: The blind cannot see and in the dark and he cannot identify the house (he lives in).

28.g: ਚਲਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਲੂਲ੍ਹਾ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
28.t: chal na sakai pi(n)gulaa loolhaa gal mil het na jaanai|
28.e: A cripple cannot keep pace and a handicapped cannot embrace to show his love.

28.g: ਸੰਢਿ ਸਪੁਤੀ ਨ ਥੀਐ ਖੁਸਰੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਰਲੀਆਂ ਮਾਣੈ।
28.t: sa(n)dd saputee na theeaai khusare naal na raleeaa(n) maanai|
28.e: A barren woman cannot have a son, nor can she enjoy coition with a eunuch.

28.g: ਜਣਿ ਜਣਿ ਪੁਤਾ ਮਾਈਆਂ ਲਾਡਲੇ ਨਾਂਵ ਧਰੇਨ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
28.t: jan jan putaa maieeaa(n) laaddale naa(n)v dharen dhin(g)aanai|
28.e: The mothers giving births to their sons give them pet names lovingly (but mere good names cannot make a good man).

28.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਟਟਾਣੈ।
28.t: gursikhee satiguroo vin sooraj jot na hoi TaTaanai|
28.e: Sikh life without the true Guru is impossible as a glow worm cannot enlighten the sun.

28.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੨੧॥
28.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh vakhaanai ||21||
28.e: In the holy congretation the word of the Guru is explained (and the jiv cultivates understanding).

28.g: ੨੨ : ਸਿੱਖੀ ਸਰਬ ਸ਼ਿਰੋਮਣੀ ਹੈ
28.t: 22 : si'khee sarab shiromanee hai
28.e: Sikh life is supreme

28.g: ਲਖ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਨ ਅਪੜਿ ਸਕੈ।
28.t: lakh dhiaan samaadh lai gurmukh roop na apaR sakai|
28.e: Millions of meditational postures and concentrations cannot equal the form of the gurmukh.

28.g: ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਡਾਰੀ ਥਕੈ।
28.t: lakh giaan vakhaan kar sabadh surat uddaaree thakai|
28.e: Millions got tired with learning and elaborations and with flights of consciousness to reach the divine Word.

28.g: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਲਖ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਦਰਿ ਧਕੈ।
28.t: budh bal bachan bibek lakh ddeh ddeh pavan piram dhar dhakai|
28.e: Millions of people using their intellect and powers talk of discerning wisdom but they fall and stagger, and, at the door of the Lord they get jolts and blows.

28.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਲਖ ਸਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਹਕੈ।
28.t: jog bhog bairaag lakh seh na sakeh gun vaas mahakai|
28.e: Millions of yogis, pleasure seekers and recluses cannot bear the passions and fragrance of the three qualities of nature (sattv, rajas and tamas).

28.g: ਲਖ ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੋਇ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਕੈ।
28.t: lakh acharaj acharaj hoi abigat gat abigat vich akai|
28.e: Millions of wonderstruck people have got tired of the unmanifest nature of the unmanifest Lord.

28.g: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਲਖ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਮਿ ਸਹਕੈ।
28.t: visamaadhee visamaadh lakh akath kathaa vich saham sahakai|
28.e: Millions are awe-struck, with the ineffable story of that wondrous Lord.

28.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦੈ ਅਖਿ ਫਰਕੈ ॥੨੨॥੨੮॥
28.t: gursikhee dhai akh farakai ||22||28||
28.e: They all are equal to the delight of one moment of the life of a Sikh of the Guru.

29.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
29.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
29.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

29.g: ੧ : ਮੰਗਲਾ ਚਰਣ
29.t: 1 : ma(n)galaa charan
29.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

29.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
29.t: aadh purakh aadhes hai satigur sach naau sadhavaiaa|
29.e: Salutation to that primal Lord who is known by the true name of Satigura.

29.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
29.t: chaar varan gursikh kar gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th chalaiaa|
29.e: Transforming all the four varnas into the Sikhs of the Guru, that true Guru (Gum Nanak Dev) has initiated a true way for the Gurmukhs.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਵਾਇਆ।
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil gaa(n)vadhe satigur sabadh anaahadh vaiaa|
29.e: The true Guru has vibrated such an unstruck word which is sung in the holy congregation by one and all.

29.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
29.t: gur saakhee upadhes kar aap tarai sai(n)saar taraiaa|
29.e: The Gurmukhs recite the teachings of the Guru; they go across and make the world go across (the world ocean).

29.g: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੂਨੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
29.t: paan supaaree kath mil choone ra(n)g sura(n)g chaRhaiaa|
29.e: As in betel leaf mixing of catechu, lime and betel nut makes a nice colour, similarly, gurmukh way of life consisting of all the four varnas is beautiful.

29.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
29.t: giaan dhiaan simaran jugat gurmat mil gur pooraa paiaa|
29.e: He, who having met the perfect Gum has attained Gurmati; the wisdom of the Guru, has in fact identified the teachnique of knowledge, concentration and meditation.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa ||1||
29.e: The true Guru has established the abode of truth in the form of holy congregation.

29.g: ੨ : ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਬਚਾਇਆ ?
29.t: 2 : gur naanak ne kive(n) bachaiaa ?
29.e: The true Guru arranged the glimpse of the imperceptible     ?

29.g: ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
29.t: par tan par dhan par ni(n)dh meT naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa|
29.e: Holding (me) back from other's body, wealth and slander, the true Guru, has made me resolute for the practice of meditation on Lord's name, ablution and charity.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਕੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
29.t: gurmat man samajhaikai baahar jaa(n)dhaa varaj rahaiaa|
29.e: People also making their minds understand through the teaching of the Gum have restrained it from going astray.

29.g: ਮਨਿ ਜਿਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਇਕਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
29.t: man jitai jag jin liaa asaTadhaat ikadhaat karaiaa|
29.e: As the eight metals touching the philosopher's stone become gold, similarly, the gurmukhs, having conquered their mind have conquered the whole world.

29.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਏ ਪਾਰਸਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
29.t: paaras hoe paarasahu gur upadhes aves dhikhaiaa|
29.e: Such is the effect of the Guru's teaching that the Sikh acquires the same qualifies as if a stone by touching a philosopher's stone has itself become another philosopher's stone.

29.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
29.t: jog bhog jin jugat kar bhai bhagat bhai aap gavaiaa|
29.e: Systematically, having won yoga as well as pleasures and getting immersed in devotion they have lost their fears.

29.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
29.t: aap giaa aap varatiaa bhagat vachhal hoi vasagat aaiaa|
29.e: When the ego vanished, God was not only realized as diffused all around, but also because of love for His devotees

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat vich alakh lakhaiaa ||2||
29.e: He came under their control.

29.g: ੩ : ਅਸਾਧ ਸਤਿਗੰਗ ਨੇ ਸਾਧੇ
29.t: 3 : asaadh satiga(n)g ne saadhe
29.e: Chronic ailments cured

29.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੇ।
29.t: sabadh surat mil saadhasa(n)g gurmukh dhukh sukh samakar saadhe|
29.e: In the holy congregation, getting attuned to the Word, the gurmukh treats pains and joys in the same vein.

29.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ।
29.t: haumai dhuramat paraharee gurmat satigur purakh aaraadhe|
29.e: He renounces egotist ill thoughts and adopting the teachings of the true Guru adores the Timeless Lord.

29.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਲੰਘਿਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੇ।
29.t: siv sakatee no la(n)ghikai gurmukh sukh fal sahaj samaadhe|
29.e: Going beyond the phenomena of the Siva-Sakti (maya), the Gurnzukh calmly merges in the fruits of delight.

29.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕ ਜਾਣਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਉਪਾਧੇ।
29.t: gur paramesar ek jaan dhoojaa bhaau miTai upaadhe|
29.e: Considering Guru and God as one, he decimates the ills of the sense of duality.

29.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਅਜਰਾਵਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ।
29.t: ja(n)man maranahu baahare ajaraavar mil agam agaadhe|
29.e: Gurmukhs go out of the cycle of transmigration and meeting that unapproachable and unfathomable Lord go away from the impacts of time (oldage).

29.g: ਆਸ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਧੇ।
29.t: aas na traas udhaas ghar harakh sog vih a(n)mirat khaadhe|
29.e: Hopes and fears do not torture them. They reside in home while being detached and to them nectar or poison, happiness and sorrows are all the same.

29.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
29.t: mahaa asaadh saadhasa(n)g saadhe ||3||
29.e: In the holy congregation, the frightening chronic ailments are also cured.

29.g: ੪ : ਸਿੱਖ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 4 : si'kh karanee saadh sa(n)g
29.e: Conduct of a Sikh

29.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਰਜ ਗੁਣੁ ਤਮ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਤ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਤਾ।
29.t: paun paanee baisa(n)taro raj gun tam gun sat gun jitaa|
29.e: Air, water, fire and the three qualities – tranquillity, activity and inertness have been conquered by the Sikh.

29.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਸੰਕਲਪ ਕਰਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗੋਇ ਦੁਚਿਤਾ।
29.t: man bach karam sa(n)kalap kar ik man hoi vigoi dhuchitaa|
29.e: With the concentration of mind, speech, action and meditating upon the One, he has lost the sense of duality.

29.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਾ।
29.t: lok vedh gur giaan liv a(n)dhar ik baahar bahu bhitaa|
29.e: Absorption in the knowledge of the Guru is his conduct in the world. In his innerself he is One (with the Lord) while he performs diverse duties in the world.

29.g: ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਜਿਣਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਥਿਤਾ।
29.t: maat lok paataal jin surag lok vich hoi athitaa|
29.e: Conquering the earth and the nether world he establishes himself in heavens.

29.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ।
29.t: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhe kar patit pavitaa|
29.e: By speaking sweetly, behaving humbly and bestowing charities with one's own hands, even the fallen ones have become pure.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਡੋਲ ਅਮੋਲ ਅਮਿਤਾ।
29.t: gurmukh sukh fal paiaa atul addol amol amitaa|
29.e: Thus, the gurmukh attains incomparable and invalauable fruits of delight.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੀੜਿ ਨਪਿਤਾ ॥੪॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil peeR napitaa ||4||
29.e: Associating with the holy congregation he squeezes out the ego (from the mind).

29.g: ੫ : ਸਿੱਖ ਗਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਚਾਰ ਗਿਣਤੀ
29.t: 5 : si'kh gatee saadh sa(n)ga-chaar ginatee
29.e: Successful transaction they do in the holy congregation ,  -

29.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ।
29.t: chaar padhaarath hath joR hukamee ba(n)dhe rahan khaRote|
29.e: The four ideals (dharma, arth, ktim, moks) stand w'th folded hands around the obedient servant (of the Lord).

29.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਚਕ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਇਕ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਤੇ।
29.t: chaare chak nivaiaa pairee pai ik soot parote|
29.e: This servant has made the four directions bow to him by bowing to One who has strung one and all into one thread.

29.g: ਵੇਦ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ।
29.t: vedh na pain bhedh kih paR paR pa(n)ddit sun sun srote|
29.e: The Vedas, the reciter pandits of the Vedas and their audience cannot understand His mystery.

29.g: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਦਰ ਜਾਗਦੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤੇ।
29.t: chahu jug a(n)dhar jaagadhee ot pot mil jagamag jote|
29.e: His ever radiant flame glows in all the four yugso ages.

29.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਵੜੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਤੇ।
29.t: chaar varan ik varan hoi gursikh vaReean gurmukh gote|
29.e: The Sikhs of all the four vamas became one varna and they have entered the (larger) clan of Gurmukhs.

29.g: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੀਜਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਸੁ ਵਣਜ ਸਓਤੇ।
29.t: dharamasaal vich beejadhe kar gurapurab su vanaj sote|
29.e: They at the abodes of dharma (Gurdvaras) celebrate anniversaries of the Gurus and thus sow the seeds of virtuous actions.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਾਦੇ ਪੋਤੇ ॥੫॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil dhaadhe pote ||5||
29.e: In the holy congregation the grandson and the grandfather (i.e. young and old) are equal to each other.

29.g: ੬ : ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਪੰਜ ਗਿਣਤੀ
29.t: 6 : gurbhaiee saadh sa(n)ga-pa(n)j ginatee
29.e: Holy congregation is adorned by the fellow disciples  -

29.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਧਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਦੀ ਜੋਹ ਮਿਟਾਈ।
29.t: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar saadh lobh moh dhee joh miTaiee|
29.e: Sikhs in sadh sangat (holy company) controlling the kam (lust) krodh (anger), ahatilair ego), decimate their greed and infatuation.

29.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਗਰਥੁ ਸਮਾਈ।
29.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath samarath sugarath samaiee|
29.e: In the holy congregation, truth contentment, compassion, dharma, wealth, power all are subsumed.

29.g: ਪੰਜੇ ਤਤ ਉਲੰਘਿਆ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ।
29.t: pa(n)je tat ula(n)ghiaa pa(n)j sabadh vajee vaadhaiee|
29.e: Crossing the five elements, the felicitation of the five words (instruments) are. played there.

29.g: ਪੰਜੇ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਹੁਇ ਦੇਸ ਦੁਹਾਈ।
29.t: pa(n)je mudhraa vas kar pa(n)chain hui dhes dhuhaiee|
29.e: Having controlled five yogic postures, the respectable member of the congregation become famous all around.

29.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਹੈ ਪੰਜ ਮਿਲਿ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
29.t: paramesar hai pa(n)j mil lekh alekh na keemat paiee|
29.e: Where the five persons sit together, Lord God, is there; this mystery of indescribable Lord cannot be known.

29.g: ਪੰਜ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਤਜਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
29.t: pa(n)j mile parapa(n)ch taj anahadh sabadh sabadh liv laiee|
29.e: But only those five meet (to sit together) who repudiating hypocrisy have merged their consciousness in the unstruck melody of the Word.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥੬॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat sohan gur bhaiee ||6||
29.e: Such fellow-disciples adome the holy congregation.

29.g: ੭ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਛੇ ਗਿਣਤੀ
29.t: 7 : gurmukh saadh sa(n)ga-chhe ginatee
29.e: Gurmukh, association with the saints  count of six),  -

29.g: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਰਸਣਿ ਘਣੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
29.t: chhia dharasan tarasan ghane gurmukh satigur dharasan paiaa|
29.e: Followers of six (Indian. philosophies) crave intensely but only gurmukh gets the glimpse of the Lord.

29.g: ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
29.t: chhia saasatr samajhaavanee gurmukh gur upadhes dhiRaiaa|
29.e: The six Shastras make one understand in a round about manner but gurmukhs make the teachings of the Guru firmly lodged in the heart.

29.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
29.t: raag naadh visamaadh vich gurmat satigur sabadh sunaiaa|
29.e: All the musical measures and melodies are wonder-struck to feel that

29.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
29.t: chhia rutee kar varatamaan sooraj ik chalat varataiaa|
29.e: The true Guru is such as the one sun remains stabilized in all the six seasons.

29.g: ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇਆ।
29.t: chhia ras saau na painee gurmukh sukh fal piram chakhaiaa|
29.e: Such a pleasure-fruit has been attained by Gurmukhs, the taste of which could not be known by six pleasures.

29.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੇ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ।
29.t: jatee satee chir jeevane chakravarat hoi mohe maiaa|
29.e: Anchorites, followers of truth, long lived ones and universally acclaimed ones are all engrossed in delusions.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil sahaj samaiaa ||7||
29.e: Only joining the holy congregation, one could be absorbed in one's innate nature.

29.g: ੮ : ਸ਼ਬਦ ਕਮਾਈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਸੱਤ ਗਿਣਤੀ
29.t: 8 : shabadh kamaiee saadh sa(n)ga-sa't ginatee
29.e: Discipline of Word, association with saints  the count of seven ,  -

29.g: ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ।
29.t: sat samu(n)dh samai lai bhavajal a(n)dhar rahe niraalaa|
29.e: Gurmukhs moving in the holy congregation and having controlled the seven seas remain detached in this world ocean.

29.g: ਸਤੇ ਦੀਪ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦ ਉਜਾਲਾ।
29.t: sate dheep anher hai gurmukh dheepak sabadh ujaalaa|
29.e: All the seven continents are in darkness; gurmukh enlightener them by lamp of Word.

29.g: ਸਤੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸੋਧੀਆ ਸਹਜ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਚੀ ਧ੍ਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
29.t: sate pureeaa sodheeaa sahaj puree sachee dhramasaalaa|
29.e: The gurmukh has reformed all the seven purls (abodes of gods), and has found that only the state of equipoise is the real abode of truth.

29.g: ਸਤੇ ਰੋਹਣਿ ਸਤ ਵਾਰ ਸਾਧੇ ਫੜਿ ਫੜਿ ਮਥੇ ਵਾਲਾ।
29.t: sate rohan sat vaar saadhe faR faR mathe vaalaa|
29.e: All the major nakstrs such as Sva-ti etc, and the seven days, he has controlled by holding them from their heads i.e. he has gone beyond their deceptions.

29.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ।
29.t: trai sate brahama(n)dd kar veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh sukhaalaa|
29.e: Twenty-one cities and their ostentations he has crossed and he lives happily (in his self).

29.g: ਸਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਤੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਲਾ।
29.t: sate sur bharapoor kar satee dhaaree paar piaalaa|
29.e: He has known the comprehensiveness of the seven melodies (of music) and he has crossed the seven streams of the mountains.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸਮਾਲਾ ॥੮॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh samaalaa ||8||
29.e: This could be possible because he has sustained and accomplished the Word of the Guru in the holy congregation.

29.g: ੯ : ਮਨਵਸ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਅੱਠ ਗਿਣਤੀ
29.t: 9 : manavas saadh sa(n)ga-a'Th ginatee
29.e: Association with the saints  the count of eight,  -

29.g: ਅਠਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
29.t: aThakha(n)dd paakha(n)dd mat gurmat ik man ik dhiaaiaa|
29.e: The person conducting in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru, goes beyond the hypocrisies of eight division (of four varnas and four ashramas) and adores the Lord with single minded devotion.

29.g: ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਿਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ।
29.t: asaTadhaat paaras milee gurmukh ka(n)chan jot jagaiaa|
29.e: Eight metals in the form of four vamas and four religions having met the philosopher's stone in the form of Guru have convereted themselves into gold, the gurmukh, the enlightened one.

29.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾਂ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
29.t: ridh sidh sidh saadhikaa(n) aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|
29.e: The siddhs and other miraculous practitioners have saluted to that primal Lord alone.

29.g: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
29.t: aThe pahar araadheeaai sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|
29.e: That Lord ought to be adored all the eight watches of time; by merger of the consciousness in the Word, the imperceptible is perceived.

29.g: ਅਸਟ ਕੁਲੀ ਵਿਹੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ।
29.t: asaT kulee vih utaree satigur mat na mohe maiaa|
29.e: By adopting the advice of the true Gum, the poison (stigma) of the eight generations is wiped out and now the intellect does not get deluded due to maya.

29.g: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਧਾਇਆ।
29.t: man asaadh na saadheeaai gurmukh sukhafal saadh sadhaiaa|
29.e: The gurmukhs by their loving devotion have refined the incorrigible mind.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਨ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੯॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil man vas aaiaa ||9||
29.e: The mind is controlled only by meeting the holy congregation.

29.g: ੧੦ : ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ-ਨੌਂ ਗਿਣਤੀ
29.t: 10 : gurmat saadh sa(n)ga-naua(n) ginatee
29.e: Gurmat, association with saint  the count of nine  -

29.g: ਨਉ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੈ ਨਵੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ।
29.t: nau parakaaree bhagat kar saadhai navai dhuaar gurmatee|
29.e: People adopt ninefold devotion but the gurmukh while adopting the wisdom of Guru accomplishes the nine doors.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇਆ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਰਤੀ।
29.t: gurmukh piram chakhaiaa gaavai jeebh rasain ratee|
29.e: Tasting the joy of love, the Gurmukh with full attachment, recites the praises of the Lord.

29.g: ਨਵੀ ਖੰਡੀ ਜਾਣਾਇਆ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਸਤੀ ਅਸਤੀ।
29.t: navee kha(n)ddee jaanaiaa raaj jog jin satee asatee|
29.e: Through Rajyoga, the gurmukh has conquered both the truth and the falsehood and thus he is known all over the nine regions of the earth.

29.g: ਨਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਉ ਘਰ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਪਰਲਉ ਉਤਪਤੀ।
29.t: nau kar nau ghar saadhiaa varatamaan paralau utapatee|
29.e: Becoming humble he has disciplined the nine doors and besides he has diffused himself in creation and dissolution.

29.g: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਪਿਛ ਲਗਣੀ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਜੁਗਤੀ।
29.t: nav nidhee pichh laganee naath anaath sanaath jugatee|
29.e: The nine treasures follow him earnestly and the gurmukh unfolds to the nine naths, the technique of getting liberated.

29.g: ਨਉ ਉਖਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਖਲੀ ਮਿਠੀ ਕਉੜੀ ਠੰਢੀ ਤਤੀ।
29.t: nau ukhal vich ukhalee miThee kauRee Tha(n)ddee tatee|
29.e: Among the nine sockets (in the humanbody), the tongue which was bitter, sweet, hot and cool, now

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਣਖਤੀ ॥੧੦॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gurmat sanakhatee ||10||
29.e: Due to the association with the holy congregation and the wisdom of Guru, has become blest and full of delights.

29.g: ੧੧ : ਸਿਖ ਕੀਹ ਕਰੇ? ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 11 : sikh keeh kare? saadh sa(n)g
29.e: What a Sikh ought to do  ?

29.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈਆ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਮਾਵਾਂ ਭੈਣਾਂ ਧੀਆਂ ਜਾਣੈ।
29.t: dhekh paraieeaa cha(n)geeaa maavaa(n) bhainaa(n) dheeaa(n) jaanai|
29.e: The Sikh ought to treat beautiful women of others as his mothers, sisters, and daughters.

29.g: ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰੁ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ।
29.t: aus sooar us gai hai par dhan hi(n)dhoo musalamaanai|
29.e: Others' wealth for him is as beef for Hindu and pork for a Muslim.

29.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਧੋਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
29.t: putr kalatr kuTa(n)b dhekh mohe moh na dhoh dhin(g)aanai|
29.e: Out of infatuation for his son, wife or family, he should not betray and deceive anyone.

29.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
29.t: ausatat ni(n)dhaa ka(n)n sun aapahu buraa na aakh vakhaanai|
29.e: While listening to the praises and slander of others, he should not talk ill of anybody.

29.g: ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਰਞਾਣੈ।
29.t: vadd parataap na aap gan kar aha(n)meau na kisai ran(j)aanai|
29.e: Neither he should count himself as great and glorious nor should he out of his ego, snub anybody.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਰਸ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ।
29.t: gurmukh sukhafal paiaa raaj jog ras raleeaa maanai|
29.e: Gurmukh of such a nature practises Raj yoga (the highest yoga), lives peacefully a

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥੧੧॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat viTahu kurabaanai ||11||
29.e: And goes to sacrifice his self unto the holy congregation.

29.g: ੧੨ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਦੀ ਅਵਸਥਾ
29.t: 12 : gurmukh dhee avasathaa
29.e: The state of a Gurmukh

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਖਾਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ।
29.t: gurmukh piram chakhaiaa bhukh na khaan peean a(n)n paanee|
29.e: The gurmukh having tasted the joy of love feels no desire for food and ink.

29.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੀਂਦ ਉਘੜੀ ਜਾਗਦਿਆਂ ਸੁਖ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
29.t: sabadh surat nee(n)dh ughaRee jaagadhiaa(n) sukh rain vihaanee|
29.e: Due to the merger of his consciousness in the Word, he gets no eep and by getting awake, he spends his night delightfully.

29.g: ਸਾਹੇ ਬਧੇ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਮੈਲਾਪੜ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
29.t: saahe badhe sohadhe mailaapaR paravaan paraanee|
29.e: As for a few ays before marriage, the bride and the bridegroom look beautiful even in gs, the gurmukhs also remain adorned.

29.g: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਮਿਹਮਾਨ ਆਏ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ।
29.t: chalan jaan sujaan hoi jag mihamaan aae mihamaanee|
29.e: Since they understand the mystery f going from the world, they live like guests in the world (who must sooner r later go).

29.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਖੇਪ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।
29.t: sach vanaj khep lai chale gurmukh gaaddee raahu neesaanee|
29.e: Being familiar with the highway of the wisdom of the Guru, Gurmukhs move on it with full load of the truthful merchandise.

29.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ।
29.t: halat palat mukh ujale gur sikh gursikhaa(n) man bhaanee|
29.e: The Sikhs ove the teachings of the Guru and their faces remain bright in this and in the world hereafter.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੧੨॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat vich akath kahaanee ||12||
29.e: Always in the holy congregation, the ineffable story of the grandeur of) the Lord is told.

29.g: ੧੩ : ਸਿੱਖੀ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ
29.t: 13 : si'khee saadhan saadhasa(n)g
29.e: Accept the will of the Lord in the holy congregation ,

29.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਵੈ।
29.t: haumai garab nivaareeaai gurmukh ridhai gareebee aavai|
29.e: Repudiating pride and ego a gurmukh should be humble.

29.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਭਰਮ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ।
29.t: giaan matee ghaT chaananaa bharam agiaan a(n)dher miTaavai|
29.e: With the light of knowledge in his mind he should dispel darkness of ignorance and delusions.

29.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਢਹਿ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਪਾਵੈ।
29.t: hoi nimaanaa ddeh pavai dharageh maan nimaanaa paavai|
29.e: He should fall on the feet (of Lord) in humility because only the humble are honoured in the court of the Lord.

29.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ।
29.t: khasamai soiee bhaavadhaa khasamai dhaa jis bhaanaa bhaavai|
29.e: Master also loves that man who loves the will of the master.

29.g: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੈ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਵੈ।
29.t: bhaanaa ma(n)nai ma(n)neeaai aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaavai|
29.e: One who accepts the will of God is accepted by one understands that he is a guest in this world;

29.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਦਾਵਾ ਛਡਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਾ ਦਾਵੈ।
29.t: dhuneeaa vich paraahunaa dhaavaa chhadd rahai laa dhaavai|
29.e: That is why foregoing all claims, he lives without making any claim for himself.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil hukam kamaavai ||13||
29.e: Being in the holy congregation, he acts in consonance with the commands of the Lord.

29.g: ੧੪ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਕਾਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 14 : gurmukh kaar saadh sa(n)g
29.e: Only one Lord adored in the holy congregation ,

29.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
29.t: gur paramesar ik jaan gurmukh dhoojaa bhaau miTaiaa|
29.e: Accepting Guru and God as one, the gurmukh has erased the sense of duality.

29.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਲਿ ਢਹਾਇਕੈ ਤਾਲ ਨਦੀ ਦਾ ਨੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
29.t: haumai paal ddahaikai taal nadhee dhaa neer milaiaa|
29.e: Knocking down the wall of ego, the gurmukh has united the pond (self) with the  river (Brahm).

29.g: ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਦੁਹ ਵਲੀ ਇਕਦੂ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
29.t: nadhee kinaarai dhuh valee ikadhoo paaraavaar na paiaa|
29.e: Undoubtedly the river remains contained within its two banks neither one knowing the other.

29.g: ਰੁਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਤੈ ਫਲਹੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
29.t: rukhahu fal tai falahu rukh ik naau fal rukh sadhaiaa|
29.e: From tree the fruit and from fruit the e are born and in fact both are one though they have different names.

29.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਝ ਹੈ ਸੁਝੈ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
29.t: chhia rutee ik sujh hai sujhai sujh na hor dhikhaiaa|
29.e: The sun is one in all the six seasons; knowing this, one does not think of different suns.

29.g: ਰਾਤੀਂ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਦੇ ਦਿਹ ਚੜਿਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਆਖੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ।
29.t: raatee(n) taare chamakadhe dheh chaRiaai kin aakh lukaiaa|
29.e: At night the stars twinkle but with the break of day under whose command they hide themselves? (they automatically go and likewise with light of knowledge the darkness of ignorance is dispelled of its own).

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat ik man ik dhiaaiaa ||14||
29.e: The holy congregation, the gurmukhs adore the Lord with single-minded devotion.

29.g: ੧੫ : ਅਸਲੀ ਯੋਗ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 15 : asalee yog saadh sa(n)g
29.e: Gursikh a yogi ,

29.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਗਦੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
29.t: gursikh jogee jaagadhe maiaa a(n)dhar karan udhaasee|
29.e: Yogi Sikhs of the Guru are ever awake and remain detached amidst maya.

29.g: ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਰਾਂ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਧੂੜਿ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਸੁ ਲਾਸੀ।
29.t: ka(n)nee mu(n)dharaa(n) ma(n)tr gur sa(n)taa(n) dhooR bibhoot su laasee|
29.e: Gurumantr for them is the earring and the dust of the feet of saints is ashes for them.

29.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾਂ ਹੰਢਾਵਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਉ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ।
29.t: khi(n)thaa khimaa(n) ha(n)ddaavanee prem patr bhaau bhugat bilaasee|
29.e: Forgiveness is their patched blanket, love their begging bowl and devotion is their trumpet (sitig),

29.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਜੈ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ।
29.t: sabadh surat si(n)n(g)ee vajai dda(n)ddaa giaan dhiaan gurdhaasee|
29.e: Knowledge is their staff, and obedience to the Guru is their meditation.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਫੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur gufai beh sahaj samaadh agaadh nivaasee|
29.e: Sitting in the cave in the form of holy congregation, they reside in unfathomable equipoise.

29.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਅਰੋਗ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਖਲਾਸੀ।
29.t: haumai rog arog hoi kar sa(n)jog vijog khalaasee|
29.e: Getting cured of the ailment of ego, they are liberated from the bonds of comings and goings (birth and death).

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਬਾਸੀ ॥੧੫॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gurmat saabaasee ||15||
29.e: Holy congregation is applauded because of the wisdom of the Guru that resides in it.

29.g: ੧੬ : ਆਸ਼ਕ ਹੋਵੇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 16 : aashak hove saadh sa(n)g
29.e: See yourself as lover of the holy congregation ,

29.g: ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਲਖ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਿ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ।
29.t: lakh brahame lakh vedh paR net net kar kar sabh thake|
29.e: Millions of Brahmas, reciting millions of Vedas got tired saying nett nett )(this is not, this is not).

29.g: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਣੀਦੈ ਅਕੇ।
29.t: mahaadhev avadhoot lakh jog dhiaan uneedhai ake|
29.e: Mahadev and millions of recluses are also fed up with sleeplessness of yogic practice.

29.g: ਲਖ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਲੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਫੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੇ।
29.t: lakh bisan avataar lai giaan khaRag faR pahuch na sake|
29.e: Becoming millions of incarnations, Visnu even catching hold of the double edged sword of knowledge could not reach Him.

29.g: ਲਖ ਲੋਮਸੁ ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵਣੇ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਧਕੇ।
29.t: lakh lomas chir jeevane aadh a(n)t vich dheerak dhake|
29.e: Millions of long lived rishi such as Lomas despite their fortitude are, ultimately jostled about.

29.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰ ਢਕੇ।
29.t: tin loa jug chaar kar lakh brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd kar ddake|
29.e: That Lord has covered with His 'self, all the three worlds, four ages, millions of universes and their divisions, i.e.

29.g: ਲਖ ਪਰਲਉ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਲਖ ਹਰਹਟ ਮਾਲਾ ਅਖਿ ਫਰਕੇ।
29.t: lakh paralau utapat lakh harahaT maalaa akh farake|
29.e: He is bigger than these all. Millions of creations and dissolutions go on moving like the chain of pots on persian wheel and all this is enacted  within the time of the fall of an eyelid.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਸਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਕੇ ॥੧੬॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat aasak hoi take ||16||
29.e: If someone becomes lover of the ,holy congregation, only then he can understand this mystery

29.g: ੧੭ : ਮਨ ਜਿਤ ਆਪ ਜਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 17 : man jit aap jit saadh sa(n)g
29.e: The world is conquered only by conquering the mind ,  ,

29.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਈ।
29.t: paarabraham pooran braham aadh purakh hai satigur soiee|
29.e: Transcendental Brahm is the perfect Brahm; He is the primal cosmic spirit (purakh) and the true Guru.

29.g: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਹੋਈ।
29.t: jog dhiaan hairaan hoi vedh giaan paravaeh na hoiee|
29.e: Yogis became awestruck in meditation for He does not care for knowledge of the Vedas.

29.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਭਵਦੀ ਲੋਈ।
29.t: dhevee dhev sarevadhe jal thal maheeal bhavadhee loiee|
29.e: Adoring the gods and goddesses, people go on roaming (in different lives) in water on earth and in the sky.

29.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਈ।
29.t: hom jag jap tap ghane kar kar karam dharam dhukh roiee|
29.e: They perform many burnt offerings, oblations and ascetic disciplines and still weep while performing the so-called ritualistic activities (because their sufferings are not removed).

29.g: ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਅਠੁ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਗੋਈ।
29.t: vas na aavai dhaavadhaa aTh kha(n)dd paakha(n)dd vigoiee|
29.e: Ever-running mind does not come under control and the mind has spoiled all the eight divisions of life (four varnas and four ashrams).

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ।
29.t: gurmukh man jin jag jinai aap gavai aape sabh koiee|
29.e: The gurmukhs after conquering the mind have won the whole world and losing their ego, they have seen themselves in one and all.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੧੭॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gun haar paroiee ||17||
29.e: The gurmukhs have prepared the garland of virtues in the holy congregation.

29.g: ੧੮ : ਗੁਰੂ ਮਲਾਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 18 : guroo malaeh saadh sa(n)g
29.e: Guru, the boat man and association with the saints ,

29.g: ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
29.t: alakh nira(n)jan aakheeaai roop na rekh alekh apaaraa|
29.e: The imperceptible and blemishless Lord is said to be beyond all the forms and writs.

29.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੇਖ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰਾ।
29.t: abigat gat abigat ghanee simaran sekh na aavai vaaraa|
29.e: The nature of that unmanifest Lord is also deeply unmanifest, and in spite of continuous recitations by Sesanffg His mystery could not be understood.

29.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਉਂ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ।
29.t: akath kathaa kiau(n) jaaneeaai koi na aakh sunaavanahaaraa|
29.e: How can His ineffable story be known because none is there to tell it.

29.g: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਨੋ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੁਮਾਰਾ।
29.t: acharaj no aacharaj hoi visamaadhai visamaadh sumaaraa|
29.e: Thinking about Him, the wonder also feels itself full of wonder and the awe also becomes awe struck.

29.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਵਣਜ ਵਪਾਰਾ।
29.t: chaar varan gur sikh hoi ghar baaree bahu vanaj vapaaraa|
29.e: Becoming the Sikh of the Guru the people of all the four varnas leading the household life,

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ।
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa bhagat vachhal gur roop muraaraa|
29.e: Have undertaken to perform various types of business and trade.

29.g: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੮॥
29.t: bhav saagar gur saagar taaraa ||18||
29.e: In the holy congregations, they adore the Guru-God, affectionate towards the devotees, and the Guru gets them go across the world-ocean.

29.g: ੧੯ : ਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ
29.t: 19 : guroo noo(n) sojhee paiee
29.e: Gurmukh attains the wisdom of understanding

29.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
29.t: nira(n)kaar eka(n)kaar hoi oa(n)kaar akaar apaaraa|
29.e: The formless Lord assuming the form of ekarikcir created myriad names and forms out of Oankar.

29.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
29.t: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR pasaaraa|
29.e: In His each trichome He has kept the expanse of crores of universes.

29.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ।
29.t: ketaRiaa jug varatiaa agam agochar dhu(n)dhookaaraa|
29.e: None knows for how many yugs, ages, there was imperceptible and impenetrable mist.

29.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ।
29.t: ketaRiaa jug varatiaa kar kar ketaRiaa avataaraa|
29.e: For many ages continued the activities of many an incarnation (of God).

29.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਪਰਗਟ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ।
29.t: bhagat vachhal hoi aaiaa kaleekaal paragaT paahaaraa|
29.e: The same God, for the sake of his love for the devotees, has appeared in Kalijug (in the form of Guru).

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੋਆ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਰਾ।
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat vasagat hoaa ot pot kar piram piaaraa|
29.e: Being like warp and weft and the lover and the beloved one He, controlled by the holy congregation, resides there in.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਝੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਾਹਾਰਾ ॥੧੯॥
29.t: gurmukh sujhai sirajanaahaaraa ||19||
29.e: Only gurmukh possesses the knowledge of that creator Lord.

29.g: ੨੦ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਿੱਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
29.t: 20 : satigur te si'kh saadh sa(n)g
29.e: The true Guru and the Sikh, association with the saints)  ,

29.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ।
29.t: satigur moorat paragaTee gurmukh sukh fal sabadh vichaaraa|
29.e: With the emergence of the true Guru, the gurmukhs got the pleasure fruit of the pondering upon the Word.

29.g: ਇਕਦੂ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਾ।
29.t: eikadhoo hoi sahas fal gur sikh saadhasa(n)gat oa(n)kaaraa|
29.e: From that one Oankar, thousands of fruits emerged in the form of Gum, Sikh, and holy congregation.

29.g: ਡਿਠਾ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ।
29.t: ddiThaa suniaa ma(n)niaa sanamukh se virale saisaaraa|
29.e: Rare are the Gurmukhs who being face to face with the Guru have seen him, listened to him and have obeyed his commands.

29.g: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਗ ਛਾਰਾ।
29.t: pahilo dhe paakhaak hoi pichhahu jag ma(n)gai pag chhaaraa|
29.e: First, they become the dust of the feet of the Guru and later on, the whole world desires the dust of their feet.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ।
29.t: gurmukh maarag chaliaa sach vanaj kar paar utaaraa|
29.e: Treading the path of Gurmukhs and transacting in truth, one goes across (the world ocean).

29.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨ ਲਿਖਣਿਹਾਰਾ।
29.t: keemat koi na jaaniee aakhan sunan na likhanihaaraa|
29.e: None knows the glory of such persons nor can it be written, listened to and talked about.

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨੦॥
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh piaaraa ||20||
29.e: In the holy congregation, only the word of the Guru, is loved.

29.g: ੨੧ : ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਦਾ ਮੇਲ
29.t: 21 : gur chele dhaa mel
29.e: Union of Guru and disciple

29.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇਆ।
29.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv gurmukh sukhafal piram chakhaiaa|
29.e: After merging their consciousness in the word of the Guru and the holy congregation, the gutmukhs have tasted the pleasure fruit in the form of contemplation of the Sabad.

29.g: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
29.t: sabh nidhaan kurabaan kar sabhe fal balihaar karaiaa|
29.e: For this fruit, they have offered all the treasures and other fruits also have been sacrificed for the same.

29.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਆਂ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
29.t: tirasanaa jalan bujhaieeaa(n) saa(n)t sahaj sa(n)tokh dhiRaiaa|
29.e: This fruit has quenched all desires and fires and has further firmed up the feeling of peace, equipoise and contentment.

29.g: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਇਆ।
29.t: sabhe aasaa pooreeaa aasaa vich niraas valaiaa|
29.e: All the hopes have been fulfilled and now the feeling of detachment towards them has come up.

29.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੈ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨ ਧਾਇਆ।
29.t: manasaa maneh samailai man kaaman nihakaam na dhaiaa|
29.e: The waves of mind have been subsumed in the mind itself and mind now having become free of desires does not run in any direction.

29.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਲ ਜਮਜਾਲ ਕਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
29.t: karam kaal jamajaal kaT karam kare nihakaram rahaiaa|
29.e: Cutting asunder the rituals and the noose of death, the mind while becoming active has become free of desires for reward.

29.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
29.t: gur upadhes aves kar pairee pai jag pairee paiaa|
29.e: Getting inspired by the teachings of the Guru, first, the gurmukh fell on the feet of the Guru and then he made the whole world fall cn his feet.

29.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੨੯॥
29.t: gur chele parachaa parachaiaa ||21||29||
29.e: This way, being with the Guru, the disciple has identified Love.

30.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
30.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
30.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

30.g: ੧ : ਮੰਗਲਾ ਚਰਣ ਸੱਚ-ਕੂੜ
30.t: 1 : ma(n)galaa charan sa'cha-kooR
30.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

30.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
30.t: satigur sachaa paatisaahu gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th suhelaa|
30.e: The true Guru is the true emperor and the way of gurmukhs is the way of happiness.

30.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਂਵਦੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ।
30.t: manmukh karam kamaa(n)vadhe dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau dhuhelaa|
30.e: Mind-orientd, manmukhs, act controlled by ill intellect and tread on painful path of duality.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ।
30.t: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g bhai bhagat kar gurmukh melaa|
30.e: Gurmukhs attain the fruit of delight in the holy congregation and with loving devotion meet the gurmukhs.

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਹੁਵੇਲਾ।
30.t: kooR kusat asaadh sa(n)g manmukh dhukhafal hai vihuvelaa|
30.e: In the company of falsehood and the wicked, the fruit of sufferings of the mannzukhs grows like a poisonous creeper.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਉਣਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।
30.t: gurmukh aap gavaavanaa pairee paaunaa neh navelaa|
30.e: Losing the ego and falling on the feet is a new path of love followed by gurmukhs.

30.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਕੜੁ ਚੇਲਾ।
30.t: manmukh aap gavaavanaa gurmat gur te ukaR chelaa|
30.e: The manmukh makes himself noticed and moves away from the Guru and the wisdom of the Guru.

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਹ ਬਕਰ ਖੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
30.t: kooR sach seeh bakar khelaa ||1||
30.e: The game of truth and falsehood is similar to (impossible) meeting of the lion and the goat.

30.g: ੨ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੱਚ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 2 : gurmukh manmukh sa'ch kooR
30.e: Gurmukh, manmukh, truth and falsehood ,

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਾਵਾ।
30.t: gurmukh sukh fal sach hai manmukh dhukh fal kooR kooRaavaa|
30.e: The gurmukh attains the pleasure fruit of truth and the manmukh receives the bitter fruit of falsehood.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਪਛਾਵਾ।
30.t: gurmukh sach sa(n)tokh rukh dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau pachhaavaa|
30.e: Gurmukh is tree of truth and contentment and the wicked person is the unstable shade of duality.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਡੋਲ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੀ ਛਾਵਾਂ।
30.t: gurmukh sach addol hai manmukh fer fira(n)dhee chhaavaa(n)|
30.e: Gurmukh is firm like truth and manmukh, the mind oriented is like ever shifting shade.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਇਲ ਅੰਬ ਵਣ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਾਂਵਾਂ।
30.t: gurmukh koil a(n)b van manmukh van van ha(n)ddan kaa(n)vaa(n)|
30.e: Gurmukh is like nightingale which resides in mango groves but manmukh is like a crow which wanders in forests from place to place.

30.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਗ ਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ਸਚਾਵਾਂ।
30.t: saadhasa(n)gat sach baag hai sabadh surat gurma(n)t sachaavaa(n)|
30.e: The holy congregation is the true garden where gurmantr inspires the consciousness to merge in the Word, the true shade.

30.g: ਵਿਹੁ ਵਣ ਵਲਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨਿਗੋਸਾਵਾਂ।
30.t: vih van val asaadh sa(n)g bahut siaanap nigosaavaa(n)|
30.e: Company of the wicked is like a wild poisonous creeper and the manmukh in order to develop it goes on playing many tricks.

30.g: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਵੰਸੁ ਨਿਨਾਵਾਂ ॥੨॥
30.t: jiau kar vesuaa va(n)s ninaavaa(n) ||2||
30.e: He is like the son of a prostitute who goes without a family name.

30.g: ੩ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੱਚ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 3 : gurmukh manmukh sa'ch kooR
30.e: Gurmukh, manmukh, truth and falsehood ,

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਆਹੀਐ ਦੁਹੀ ਵਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰਾ।
30.t: gurmukh hoi veeaaheeaai dhuhee valee mil ma(n)galachaaraa|
30.e: Gurmukhs are such as the marriage of two families where sweet songs are sung on both sides and pleasures is attained.

30.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਾ।
30.t: dhuh mil ja(n)mai jaaneeaai pitaa jaat paravaar sadhaaraa|
30.e: They are such as the son born of the union of mother and father gives happiness to the parents because the lineage and family of the father gets increased.

30.g: ਜੰਮਦਿਆਂ ਰਣਝੁੰਝਣਾ ਵੰਸਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਰੁਣਝੁਣਕਾਰਾ।
30.t: ja(n)madhiaa(n) ranajhu(n)jhanaa va(n)s vadhaiee runajhunakaaraa|
30.e: Clarionets are played upon the birth of a child and celebrations are arranged on the further development of the family.

30.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਦਕ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਵਿਰਤੀਸਰ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਦਤਾਰਾ।
30.t: naanak dhaadhak sohile virateesar bahu dhaan dhataaraa|
30.e: In the homes of mother and father songs of joy are sung and the servants are given many a gift.

30.g: ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਨਾ ਪਿਉ ਨਾਉਂ ਨਿਨਾਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ।
30.t: bahu mitee hoi vesuaa naa piau naau(n) ninaau pukaaraa|
30.e: Son of a prostitute, friendly to everyone, has no name of his father and he is known as nameless.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਠਗ ਬਗ ਵੰਸ ਹਤਿਆਰਾ।
30.t: gurmukh va(n)see param ha(n)s manmukh Thag bag va(n)s hatiaaraa|
30.e: The family of gurmukhs is like paramhatis (the swans of high order which can sift milk from water i.e. truth from falsehood) and the family of the mind-oriented ones is like hypocrite cranes who kill others.

30.g: ਸਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
30.t: sach sachiaar kooRahu kooRiaaraa ||3||
30.e: From truth the truthful and from falsehood the Hers are begotten.

30.g: ੪ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ-ਮਨਮੁਖ। ਸੱਚ-ਕੂੜ
30.t: 4 : gurmukha-manmukh| sa'cha-kooR
30.e: Gurmukh, manmukh, truth and falsehood- -

30.g: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲਾ।
30.t: maan sarovar saadhasa(n)g maanak motee ratan amolaa|
30.e: Manasarovar (lake) in the form of holy congregation contains in it many invaluable rubies, pearls and jewels.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮਹੰਸ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲਾ।
30.t: gurmukh va(n)see paramaha(n)s sabadh surat gurmat addolaa|
30.e: Gurmukhs too belong to the family of swans of highest order who merging their consciousness in the Word remain stabilized.

30.g: ਖੀਰਹੁ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਕਾਲਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ।
30.t: kheerahu neer nikaaladhe gurmukh giaan dhiaan nirolaa|
30.e: Due to their power of knowledge and meditiation, the gurmukhs sift milk from water (i.e. truth from falsehood).

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਤੋਲਾ।
30.t: gurmukh sach salaaheeaai tol na tolanahaar atolaa|
30.e: Eulogising the truth, gurmukhs become incomparable and their glory cannot be measured by any one.

30.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਖਾਇ ਅਬੋਲਾ।
30.t: manmukh bagul samaadh hai ghuT ghuT jeeaa(n) khai abolaa|
30.e: Manmukh, the mind-oriented, is like a crane who silently strangulates the creatures and eats them up.

30.g: ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਉ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਛਪੜਿ ਊਹੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਹਚੋਲਾ।
30.t: hoi lakhaau Tikai jai chhapaR uooh paRai muhacholaa|
30.e: Seeing it sitting at a pond, the creatures therein create an uproar and cries of distress.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਊ ਕੂੜੁ ਗਹਿਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ॥੪॥
30.t: sach saauoo kooR gahilaa golaa ||4||
30.e: Truth is noble whereas falsehood is lowly slave.

30.g: ੫ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ-ਮਨਮੁਖ। ਸਚ-ਕੂੜ
30.t: 5 : gurmukha-manmukh| sacha-kooR
30.e: Gurmukh, manmukh, truth and falsehood- -

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਲਖਣ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ।
30.t: gurmukh sach sulakhanaa sabh sulakhan sach suhaavaa|
30.e: The true gurmukh possesses auspicious characteristics and all good marks adorn him.

30.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਲਖਣਾ ਸਭ ਕੁਲਖਣ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਦਾਵਾ।
30.t: manmukh kooR kulakhanaa sabh kulakhan kooR kudhaavaa|
30.e: Manmukh, the self-willed, keeps false marks and besides all bad characteristics in him, be possesses all deceptive tricks.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੁ ਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਮੁਲਿ ਮੁਲਾਵਾ।
30.t: sach suinaa kooR kach hai kach na ka(n)chan mul mulaavaa|
30.e: Truth is gold and falsehood is like glass. Glass cannot be priced as gold.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹਉਲੜਾ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਰਤਕ ਰਤਨੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ।
30.t: sach bhaaraa kooR haulaRaa pavai na ratak ratan bhulaavaa|
30.e: Truth is invariably heavy and the falsehood light; there is not the least doubt in this.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਟਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੜੈ ਜੜਾਵ ਨ ਜੁੜੈ ਜੁੜਾਵਾ।
30.t: sach heeraa kooR faTak hai jaRai jaRaav na juRai juRaavaa|
30.e: The truth is diamond and the falsehood stone which cannot be studded in a string.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਗਤਾ ਦਿਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਚੋਰ ਸਾਹ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ।
30.t: sach dhaataa kooR ma(n)gataa dhih raatee chor saeh milaavaa|
30.e: The truth is bestower whereas falsehood is a beggar; like a thief and a rich person or the day and the night they never meet.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਫਾਵਾ ॥੫॥
30.t: sach saabat kooR firadhaa faavaa ||5||
30.e: The truth is perfect and the falsehood a loser gambler running from pillar to post.

30.g: ੬ : ਸੱਚ ਅਤੇ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 6 : sa'ch ate kooR
30.e: Truth and falsehood

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਹੈ ਮੂਲ ਮਜੀਠ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਟਲੰਦਾ।
30.t: gurmukh sach sura(n)g hai mool majeeTh na Talai Tala(n)dhaa|
30.e: Truth in the form of gurmukhs is such a beautiful madder colour which never fades.

30.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਹੈ ਫੁਲ ਕੁਸੁੰਭੈ ਥਿਰ ਨ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
30.t: manmukh kooR kura(n)g hai ful kusu(n)bhai thir na raha(n)dhaa|
30.e: The colour of mind oriented, manmukh, is like the colour of safflower which soon fades away.

30.g: ਥੋਮ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ ਨਕੁ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ।
30.t: thom kathooree vaas lai nak maroRai man bhaava(n)dhaa|
30.e: The falsehood, as against truth, is like garlic contrasted to musk. At the smell of the former the nose is turned away whereas the latter's fragrance is pleasing to mind.

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਕ ਅੰਬ ਫਲ ਕਉੜਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਸਾਉ ਲਹੰਦਾ।
30.t: kooR sach ak a(n)b fal kauRaa miThaa saau laha(n)dhaa|
30.e: Falsehood and truth are like akk, the wild plant of sandy region and mango tree which bear bitter and sweet fruits respectively.

30.g: ਸਾਹ ਚੋਰ ਸਚ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਵੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭਵੰਦਾ।
30.t: saeh chor sach kooR hai saahu savai chor firai bhava(n)dhaa|
30.e: Truth and falsehood are like the bankar and the thief; the banker sleeps comfortably whereas the thief roams about hither and thither.

30.g: ਸਾਹ ਫੜੈ ਉਠਿ ਚੋਰ ਨੋ ਤਿਸ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
30.t: saeh faRai uTh chor no tis nukasaan dheebaan kara(n)dhaa|
30.e: The banker catches hold of the thief and gets him further punished in the courts.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜੈ ਲੈ ਨਿਹਣਿ ਬਹੰਦਾ ॥੬॥
30.t: sach kooRai lai nihan baha(n)dhaa ||6||
30.e: The truth ultimately puts shackles around the falsehood.

30.g: ੭ : ਸਚ ਅਤੇ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 7 : sach ate kooR
30.e: Truth and falsehood

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਪਗ ਜਿਉ ਕੋਝਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਕਛੋਟਾ।
30.t: sach sohai sir pag jiau kojhaa kooR kuthai kachhoTaa|
30.e: The truth adorns the head like a turban but the falsehood is like a loincloth which remains in an untidy place.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਸਾਰਦੂਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਜਿਵੈ ਹੀਣਾ ਹਰਣੋਟਾ।
30.t: sach sataanaa saaradhool kooR jivai heenaa haranoTaa|
30.e: The truth is a potent lion and the falsehood is like an abased deer.

30.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜੀਐ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਿ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ।
30.t: laahaa sach vana(n)jeeaai kooR k vanajahu aavai toTaa|
30.e: Transactions of truth bring gains whereas the trading in falsehood brings nothing but loss.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਦਮੜਾ ਖੋਟਾ।
30.t: sach kharaa saabaas hai kooR na chalai dhamaRaa khoTaa|
30.e: Truth being pure earns applause but the falsehood like a counter coin does not get circulated.

30.g: ਤਾਰੇ ਲਖ ਅਮਾਵਸੈ ਘੇਰਿ ਅਨੇਰਿ ਚਨਾਇਣੁ ਹੋਟਾ।
30.t: taare lakh amaavasai gher aner chanain hoTaa|
30.e: In the no-moon night, millions of stars remain there (in the sky) but the scarcity of light persists and pitch darkness prevails.

30.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਇਕ ਚੜ੍ਹੰਦਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਪਵੈ ਫਲਫੋਟਾ।
30.t: sooraj ik chaRha(n)dhiaa hoi aTh kha(n)dd pavai falafoTaa|
30.e: With the rise of the sun the darkness dispells in all the eight directions.

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਉਂ ਵਟੁ ਘੜੋਟਾ ॥੭॥
30.t: kooR sach jiau(n) vaT ghaRoTaa ||7||
30.e: The relationship between the false hood and the truth is similar to the relation of the pitcher and the stone.

30.g: ੮ : ਸੱਚ ਅਤੇ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 8 : sa'ch ate kooR
30.e: Truth and falsehood

30.g: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਸਾਮਰਤਖ ਜਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
30.t: suhane saamaratakh jiau kooR sach varatai varataaraa|
30.e: Falsehood to truth is the same as dream to reality.

30.g: ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਨਗਰ ਵਾਂਗੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ।
30.t: har cha(n)dhauree nagar vaa(n)g kooR sach paragaT paahaaraa|
30.e: The falsehood is like imaginary city in the sky whereas the truth is like manifest world.

30.g: ਨਦੀ ਪਛਾਵਾਂ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤਾਰਾ।
30.t: nadhee pachhaavaa(n) maanasaa sir talavaiaa a(n)bar taaraa|
30.e: Falsehood is like the shadow of men in the river, where the image of trees, stars is inverted.

30.g: ਧੂਅਰੁ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਘਣਹਰਿ ਵਰਸਣਹਾਰਾ।
30.t: dhooar dhu(n)dhookaar hoi tul na ghanahar varasanahaaraa|
30.e: Smoke also creates mist but this darkness is not similar to the darkness caused by rain clouds.

30.g: ਸਾਉ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੰਕਰੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ।
30.t: saau na simaran sa(n)karai dheepak baajh na miTai a(n)dhaaraa|
30.e: As remembrance of sugar does not bring forth the sweet taste, the darkness cannot be dispelled without lamp.

30.g: ਲੜੇ ਨ ਕਾਗਲਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੇਰੇ ਸੈ ਹਥੀਆਰਾ।
30.t: laRe na kaagal likhiaa chit chitere sai hatheeaaraa|
30.e: The warrior can never fight adopting the weapons printed on paper.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
30.t: sach kooR karatoot veechaaraa ||8||
30.e: Such are the actions of the truth and the falsehood.

30.g: ੯ : ਸੱਚ ਅਤੇ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 9 : sa'ch ate kooR
30.e: Truth and falsehood

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਦੁਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੂੜ ਵਿਗਾੜੁ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਦੀ ਚੁਖੈ।
30.t: sach samain dhudh vich kooR vigaaR kaa(n)jee dhee chukhai|
30.e: The truth is the rennet in the milk whereas falsehood is like the spoiling vinegar.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਦੁਖੈ।
30.t: sach bhojan muh khaavanaa ik dhaanaa nakai val dhukhai|
30.e: The truth is like eating the food through mouth but the falsehood s painful as if a grain has gone into the nose.

30.g: ਫਲਹੁ ਰੁਖ ਰੁਖਹੁ ਸੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਤਿਕਾਲਿ ਖਉ ਲਾਖਹੁ ਰੁਖੈ।
30.t: falahu rukh rukhahu su fal a(n)tikaal khau laakhahu rukhai|
30.e: From fruit emerges tree and nom tree the fruit; but if shellac attacks the tree, the latter is destroyed (similarly falsehood decimates the individual).

30.g: ਸਉ ਵਰਿਆ ਅਗਿ ਰੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਗਿ ਬਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੁਖੈ।
30.t: sau variaa ag rukh vich bhasam karai ag bi(n)dhak dhukhai|
30.e: For hundreds of years, the fire remains latent in the tree, but enraged by a small spark, it destroys the ree (similarly the falsehood ever remaining in the mind, ultimately destroys the man).

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੈਦ ਵੇਦਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੈ।
30.t: sach dhaaroo kooR rog hai vin gur vaidh vedhan manmukhai|
30.e: The truth is medicine whereas the falsehood is a disease which inflicts the manmukhs who are without physician in the form of Guru.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਥੋਈ ਕੂੜ ਠਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੈ।
30.t: sach sathoiee kooR Thag lagai dhukh na gurmukh sukhai|
30.e: Truth is companion and the falsehood a cheat who cannot make the gurmukh suffer (because they ever abide in the pleasure of truth).

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਪਚੈ ਸਚੈ ਦੀ ਭੁਖੈ ॥੯॥
30.t: kooR pachai sachai dhee bhukhai ||9||
30.e: Falsehood perishes and the truth is ever desired.

30.g: ੧੦ : ਸੱਚ ਅਤੇ ਕੂੜ
30.t: 10 : sa'ch ate kooR
30.e: Truth and falsehood

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਜਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਸਿਲਹ ਸੰਜੋਆ।
30.t: kooR kapaT hathiaar jiau sach rakhavaalaa sileh sa(n)joaa|
30.e: Falsehood is a fake weapon whereas the truth is protector like an iron-armour.

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਮਿਤੁ ਹਿਮਾਇਤਿ ਹੋਆ।
30.t: kooR vairee nit johadhaa sach sumit himait hoaa|
30.e: Like enemy, falsehood always lies in ambush but the truth, like a friend is ever ready to help and support.

30.g: ਸੂਰਵੀਰੁ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁੜਾਵਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਢੋਆ।
30.t: sooraveer vareeaam sach kooR kuRaavaa karadhaa ddoaa|
30.e: The truth is truly a brave warrior who meets the truthful ones whereas the Her meets Hers alone.

30.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ਹੈ ਲਰਜੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਖੜੋਆ।
30.t: nihachal sach suthai hai larajai kooR kuthai khaRoaa|
30.e: At good places, the truth stands firmly but being in the wrong places, falsehood always shakes and trembles.

30.g: ਸਚਿ ਫੜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਛਾੜਿਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਕ ਵੇਖਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਆ।
30.t: sach faR kooR pachhaaRiaa chaar chak vekhan trai loaa|
30.e: The four directions and the three worlds are witness (to the fact) that the truth catching hold of falsehood has thrashed it.

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੀ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਰੋਆ।
30.t: kooR kapaT rogee sadhaa sach sadhaa hee navaa(n) niroaa|
30.e: Deceptive falsehood is ever diseased and the truth is always hale and hearty.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਖੋਆ ॥੧੦॥
30.t: sach sachaa kooR kooR vikhoaa ||10||
30.e: The adopter of truth is ever known as truthful and the follower of falsehood is ever considered a Tier.

30.g: ੧੧ : ਸੱਚ ਕੂੜ ਦਾ ਨਿਰਣੵ
30.t: 11 : sa'ch kooR dhaa niranaye
30.e: Judgement about the truth and falsehood

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਘੁਘੂ ਕੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ।
30.t: sach sooraj paragaas hai kooRahu ghughoo kujh na sujhai|
30.e: The truth is sun-light and falsehood is owl which cannot see anything.

30.g: ਸਚ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਬੋਹੀਐ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਵਾਸ ਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਬੁਝੈ।
30.t: sach vanasapat boheeaai kooRahu vaas na cha(n)dhan bujhai|
30.e: The fragrance of truth diffuses in the whole vegetation but falsehood in the form of bamboo does not identify sandal.

30.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਸਫਲ ਤਰੋਵਰਾ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਫਲੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਲੁਝੈ।
30.t: sachahu safal tarovaraa si(n)mal afal vaddaiee lujhai|
30.e: Truth makes a fruitful tree where as the proud silk cotton tree being fruitless is ever anguished.

30.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾਂ ਰੁਝੈ।
30.t: saavan van hareeaavale sukai ak javaahaa(n) rujhai|
30.e: In the month of silvan all the forests go green but akk, the wild plant of sandy region, and javds, the camel-thorn, remain dry.

30.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਸੰਖ ਨਿਸਖਣ ਹਸਤਨ ਦੁਝੈ।
30.t: maanak motee maanasar sa(n)kh nisakhan hasatan dhujhai|
30.e: Rubies and pearls are there in the Manasarovar but the conch being empty within is pressed by hands.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਗੰਗੋਦਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਰਲੈ ਮਦ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਝੈ।
30.t: sach ga(n)godhak niramalaa kooR ralai madh paragaT gujhai|
30.e: Truth is pure like the water of the Ganges but the wine of falsehood, even if hidden, makes its foul smell manifest.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਖੁਝੈ ॥੧੧॥
30.t: sach sachaa kooR kooRahu khujhai ||11||
30.e: Truth is truthful and falsehood remains false.

30.g: ੧੨ : ਸੱਚ ਕੂੜ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ
30.t: 12 : sa'ch kooR dhaa a(n)t
30.e: End of the truth and falsehood

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜ ਦੁਇ ਝਾਗੜੂ ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਚਉਤੈ ਆਇਆ।
30.t: sach kooR dhui jhaagaRoo jhagaRaa karadhe chautai aaiaa|
30.e: Truth and falsehood had a tiff and quarrelling they came to the dias of justice.

30.g: ਅਗੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਆਇ ਆਪ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਝਗੜਾਇਆ।
30.t: age sachaa sach niaai aap hajoor dhovai jhagaRaiaa|
30.e: Dispenser of the true justice made them to debate their points there.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ।
30.t: sach sachaa kooR kooRiaar pa(n)chaa vichidho kar samajhaiaa|
30.e: The wise mediators concluded that the truth is true and the falsehood Her.

30.g: ਸਚਿ ਜਿਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ।
30.t: sach jitaa kooR haariaa kooR kooRaa kar sahar firaiaa|
30.e: The truth triumphed and the falsehood lost and being labeled untrue, was paraded in the whole city.

30.g: ਸਚਿਆਰੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੈ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
30.t: sachiaarai saabaas hai kooRiaarai fiT fiT karaiaa|
30.e: The truthfull was applauded but the untrue incurred opprobrium.

30.g: ਸਚ ਲਹਣਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਖਤੁ ਸਤਾਗਲੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ।
30.t: sach lahanaa kooR dhevanaa khat sataagal likh dhevaiaa|
30.e: This was written on a piece of paper that the truth is creditory and the falsehood debtor.

30.g: ਆਪ ਠਗਾਇ ਨ ਠਗੀਐ ਠਗਣਹਾਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਠਗਾਇਆ।
30.t: aap Thagai na Thageeaai Thaganahaarai aap Thagaiaa|
30.e: He who allows himself to be cheated is never deceived and he who cheats others gets himself cheated.

30.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
30.t: viralaa sach vihaajhan aaiaa ||12||
30.e: Any rare one is a buyer of truth.

30.g: ੧੩ : ਸੱਚ ਕੂੜ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ
30.t: 13 : sa'ch kooR dhaa a(n)t
30.e: End of the truth and falsehood

30.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਗਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ।
30.t: kooR sutaa sach jaagadhaa sach saahib dhe man bhaiaa|
30.e: Since the falsehood sleeps while the truth remains awake, the truth is loved by that Lord God.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਹਰੂ ਸਚ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਉਤੇ ਬਹਿਲਾਇਆ।
30.t: sach sachai kar paaharoo sach bha(n)ddaar ute bahilaiaa|
30.e: The true Lord has appointed truth as the watchman and has made it to sit at the store of truth.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਆਗੂ ਆਨ੍ਹੇਰ ਕੂੜ ਉਝੜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
30.t: sach aagoo aanher kooR ujhaR dhoojaa bhaau chalaiaa|
30.e: The truth is the guide and the falsehood is the darkness which causes people to wander in the jungle of duality.

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਿ ਫਉਜਦਾਰੁ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਵਣ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ।
30.t: sach sache kar faujadhaar raahu chalaavan jog paThaiaa|
30.e: Appointing truth as the commander, the true Lord has made it competent to take people along path of righteousness.

30.g: ਜਗ ਭਵਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਚਾੜੑਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
30.t: jag bhavajal mil saadhasa(n)g gur bohithai chaaR(h)h taraiaa|
30.e: To get people across the world ocean, the truth as Guru, has taken the people across in the vessel as the holy congregation.

30.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੜਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਰਵਾਇਆ।
30.t: kaam krodh lobh moh faR aha(n)kaar garadhan maravaiaa|
30.e: Lust, anger, greed, infatuation and ego have been killed by holding them from their necks.

30.g: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
30.t: paar pe gur pooraa paiaa ||13||
30.e: Those who have got the perfect Guru, have gone across (the world ocean).

30.g: ੧੪ : ਸੱਚ ਸੱਚਾ ਸਿੱਖ ਸੱਚਾ ਗੁਰੂ
30.t: 14 : sa'ch sa'chaa si'kh sa'chaa guroo
30.e: Truth, the true Sikh, the true Guru,  ,

30.g: ਲੂਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾ ਖਾਇਕੈ ਰਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਪੈ।
30.t: loon saahib dhaa khaikai ran a(n)dhar laR marai su jaapai|
30.e: True is he who is true to the salt of his master and dies fighting for him in the battelfield.

30.g: ਸਿਰ ਵਢੈ ਹਥੀਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰੀਆਮਾ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ।
30.t: sir vaddai hatheeaar kar vareeaamaa vareeaam sin(j)aapai|
30.e: One who beheads the enemy with his weapon is known as brave among the warriors.

30.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਜੋ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਥਪਿ ਥੇਈ ਦੇ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ।
30.t: tis pichhai jo isataree thap theiee dhe varai saraapai|
30.e: His bereaved woman is established as sati capable of granting boons and curses.

30.g: ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁਤ ਵਡੀਰੀਅਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ਪਰਾਪੈ।
30.t: potai put vaddeereean paravaarai saadhaar paraapai|
30.e: Sons and grandsons are praised and the whole family becomes exalted.

30.g: ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ।
30.t: vakhatai upar laR marai a(n)mirat velai sabadh alaapai|
30.e: One who dies fighting in the hour of peril and recites the Word in the ambrosial hour is known as the true warrior.

30.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਇਕੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ।
30.t: saadhasa(n)gat vich jaikai haumai maar marai aap aapai|
30.e: Going to the holy congregation and effacing his desires, he wipes out his ego.

30.g: ਲੜਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਤੈ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ।
30.t: laR maranaa tai satee hon gurmukh pa(n)th pooran parataapai|
30.e: Dying while fighting in battle and maintaining of the controle over the senses is the grand path of the gurmukhs.

30.g: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਦਕ ਸਚ ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਪੈ ॥੧੪॥
30.t: sach sidhak sach peer pachhaapai ||14||
30.e: In whom you repose your full faith is known as the true Guru.

30.g: ੧੫ : ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤ
30.t: 15 : saadh sa(n)gat
30.e: The holy congregation

30.g: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸਚਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਜੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ।
30.t: nihachal sachaa theh hai saadhasa(n)g pa(n)je paradhaanaa|
30.e: The city in the form of holy congregation is true and immovable because in it reside all the five chiefs (virtues).

30.g: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਭੋ ਬੰਧਾਨਾ।
30.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath samarath sabho ba(n)dhaanaa|
30.e: Truth, contentment, compassion, dharma and lucre are capable of all control.

30.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ।
30.t: gur upadhes kamaavanaa gurmukh naam dhaan isanaanaa|
30.e: Here, the gurmukhs practise the teachings of the Guru and observe meditation on ram, charity and ablution.

30.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਗਿਆਨਾ।
30.t: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhen bhagat guragiaanaa|
30.e: People speak sweet here, walk humbly, give away charities and attain knowledge through devotion to the Guru.

30.g: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਸੁਰਖੁਰੂ ਸਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜੈ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ।
30.t: dhuhee saraiee surakhuroo sach sabadh vajai neesaanaa|
30.e: They remain free from any anxiety in this world and the world hereafter, and for them, the drums of true

30.g: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਿੰਨ੍ਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆਂ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਿਹਮਾਨਾ।
30.t: chalan ji(n)nhee jaaniaa(n) jag a(n)dhar virale mihamaanaa|
30.e: Word are struck upon. Rare are the guests who have accepted the going away from this world, as true.

30.g: ਆਪ ਗਵਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
30.t: aap gavaae tis kurabaanaa ||15||
30.e: I am sacrifice unto them who have eschewed their ego.

30.t: 16 : jhooThaa pi(n)dd
30.e: The false village

30.g: ਕੂੜ ਅਹੀਰਾਂ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਪੰਜ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਨਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ।
30.t: kooR aheeraa(n) pi(n)dd hai pa(n)j dhoot vasan buriaaraa|
30.e: Falsehood is-the village of robbers where reside the five evil legates.

30.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ।
30.t: kaam karodh virodh nit lobh moh dhroh aha(n)kaaraa|
30.e: These couriers are lust, anger, disputation, greed, infatuation, treachery and ego.

30.g: ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾਣੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪਾਪੈ ਦਾ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
30.t: khi(n)jotaan asaadh sa(n)g varatai paapai dhaa varataaraa|
30.e: In this village of wicked company pulls, pushes and sinful conduct always operate.

30.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਵਡੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ।
30.t: par dhan par ni(n)dhaa piaar par naaree siau vadde vikaaraa|
30.e: Attachment to the others' wealth, slander and woman always persist here

30.g: ਖਲੁਹਲੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਰਾਜ ਡੰਡੁ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ।
30.t: khaluhal mool na chukiee raaj dda(n)dd jam dda(n)dd karaaraa|
30.e: Confusions and commotions are ever there and people always undergo punishments of state as well as of death.

30.g: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਜਰਦਰੂ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣ ਨਰਕਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ।
30.t: dhuhee saraiee jaradharoo ja(n)man maran narak avataaraa|
30.e: The residents of this village are always shameful in both the worlds and go on transmigrating in the hell.

30.g: ਅਗੀ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰਾ ॥੧੬॥
30.t: agee fal hovan a(n)giaaraa ||16||
30.e: The fruits of fire are the sparks only.

30.g: ੧੭ : ਸੱਚ ਵਿਚ ਕੂੜ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਈ ਨਹੀਂ
30.t: 17 : sa'ch vich kooR dhee samaiee nahee(n)
30.e: Falsehood cannot merge in truth

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਪੂਰਣ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਰਲਦਾ ਰਾਈ।
30.t: sach sapooran niramalaa tis vich kooR na raladhaa raiee|
30.e: The truth being perfectly pure, falsehood cannot mix in it as a piece of straw gone into the eye cannot be held there

30.g: ਅਖੀ ਕਤੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਰੈ ਤਿਣੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਦੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਈ।
30.t: akhee kat na sa(n)jarai tin aaukhaa dhukh rain vihaiee|
30.e: And the whole night is spent in suffering.

30.g: ਭੋਜਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਖਿ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਕੁਧਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਕਢਾਈ।
30.t: bhojan a(n)dhar makh jiau hoi dhukudhaa fer kaddaiee|
30.e: Fly in the meal also is vomited out (by body).

30.g: ਰੂਈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਿਣਗ ਵਾਂਗ ਦਾਹਿ ਭਸਮੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ।
30.t: rooiee a(n)dhar chinag vaa(n)g dhaeh bhasama(n)t kare dhukhadhaiee|
30.e: One spark in a load of cotton creates trouble for it, and burning the whole lot converts it into ashes.

30.g: ਕਾਂਜੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਕੁਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਟੈ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵੰਨਹੁ ਜਾਈ।
30.t: kaa(n)jee dhudh kusudh hoi fiTai saadhahu va(n)nahu jaiee|
30.e: Vineger in milk spoils its taste and makes it discoloured.

30.g: ਮਹੁਰਾ ਚੁਖਕੁ ਚਖਿਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਮਾਰੈ ਸਹਸਾਈ।
30.t: mahuraa chukhak chakhiaa paatisaahaa maarai sahasaiee|
30.e: Even a little bit of poison tasted kills emperors instantly.

30.g: ਸਚਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈ/ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
30.t: sach a(n)dhar kiau kooR kamaiee-samaiee ||17||
30.e: Then how can truth mix up in falsehood?

30.g: ੧੮ : ਸੱਚ ਨੂੰ ਕੂੜ ਆਵਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ
30.t: 18 : sa'ch noo(n) kooR aavar nahee(n) sakadhaa
30.e: Falsehood cannot efface truth

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਭਾਈ।
30.t: gurmukh sach alipat hai kooRahu lep na lagai bhaiee|
30.e: Truth in the form of gurmukh ever remains detached and the falsehood has no impact on it.

30.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਪੀਂ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਚੜ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਘਟਾਈ।
30.t: cha(n)dhan sapee(n) veRiaa chaRhai na vis na vaas ghaTaiee|
30.e: Sandal wood tree is surrounded by snakes but neither the poison affects it nor its fragrance is lessened.

30.g: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਥਰਾਂ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਗੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
30.t: paaras a(n)dhar patharaa(n) asaTadhaat mil vigaR na jaiee|
30.e: Amid the stones resides the philosopher's stone but even meeting the eight metals it does not get spoiled.

30.g: ਗੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
30.t: ga(n)g sa(n)g apavitr jal kar na sakai apavitr milaiee|
30.e: Polluted water mixing into the Ganges cannot pollute it.

30.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮੇਰੁ ਸੁਮੇਰੁ ਨ ਵਾਉ ਡੁਲਾਈ।
30.t: sair ag na lagiee mer sumer na vaau ddulaiee|
30.e: Seas are never burnt by fire and air cannot shake mountains.

30.g: ਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਣਿ ਜਾਇ ਵਾਹੇਂਦੜੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ।
30.t: baan na dhur asamaan jai vaahe(n)dhaR pichhai pachhutaiee|
30.e: The arrow can never touch the sky and the shooter repents afterwards.

30.g: ਓੜਕਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੁਇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
30.t: oRak kooR kooRo hui jaiee ||18||
30.e: The falshood ultimately is false.

30.g: ੧੯ : ਕੂੜ ਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ
30.t: 19 : kooR a(n)t pragaT ho jaa(n)dhaa hai
30.e: The falsehood comes out ultimately

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ ਮਣੀ ਮਨੂਰੀ।
30.t: sach sachaavaa maan hai kooR kooRaavee manee manooree|
30.e: The regards for truth are always genuine and falsehood is always identified as fake.

30.g: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾਵੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ।
30.t: kooRai kooRee pai hai sach sachaavee gurmat pooree|
30.e: Respect of the falsehood is also artificial but the wisdom of Guru given to truth is perfect one.

30.g: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਗਰਬ ਗਰੂਰੀ।
30.t: kooRai kooRaa jor hai sach sataanee garab garooree|
30.e: The power of a Tier is also counterfeit and even the pious ego of truth is deep and full of gravity.

30.g: ਕੂੜ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੀ।
30.t: kooR na dharageh ma(n)neeaai sach suhaavaa sadhaa hajooree|
30.e: Falsehood is not recognised in the court of the Lord whereas truth always adorns His court.

30.g: ਸੁਕਰਾਨਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਘਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਫਰ ਘਰਿ ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੀ।
30.t: sukaraanaa hai sach ghar kooR kufar ghar naa saabooree|
30.e: In the home of truth, there is always a sense of gratefulness but falsehood never feels contented.

30.g: ਹਸਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਹੈ ਸਚ ਦੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਢੰਗੀ ਚਾਲ ਭੇਡੂਰੀ।
30.t: hasat chaal hai sach dhee kooR kudda(n)gee chaal bheddooree|
30.e: The gait of truth is like that of elephant whereas falsehood moves clumsily like sheep.

30.g: ਮੂਲੀ ਪਾਨ ਡਿਕਾਰ ਜਿਉ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਲਸਣੁ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ।
30.t: moolee paan ddikaar jiau mul na tul lasan kasatooree|
30.e: The value of musk and garlic cannot be kept at par and same is the case of the eructation of radish and betel.

30.g: ਬੀਜੈ ਵਿਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ਚੂਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
30.t: beejai vis na khaavai chooree ||19||
30.e: He who sows poison cannot eat delicious meal made with crushed bread mixed with butter and sugar (chart).

30.g: ੨੦ : ਕੂੜ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ
30.t: 20 : kooR dhaa a(n)t buraa hu(n)dhaa hai
30.e: The end of the falsehood is very bad

30.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ ਸਹੈ ਅਵਟਣ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ।
30.t: sach subhaau majeeTh dhaa sahai avaTan ra(n)g chaRhaae|
30.e: The nature of truth is like madder which itself bears the heat of boiling but makes the dye fast.

30.g: ਸਣ ਜਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਖਲ ਕਢਾਇ ਵਟਾਇ ਬਨਾਏ।
30.t: san jiau kooR subhaau hai khal kaddai vaTai banaae|
30.e: The nature of falsehood is like that of jute whose skin is peeled off and then twisting it, its ropes are prepared.

30.g: ਚੰਨਣ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਸਾਏ।
30.t: cha(n)nan paraupakaar kar afal safal vich vaas vasaae|
30.e: Sandal being benevolent makes all the trees, be they with or without fruits, fragrant.

30.g: ਵਡਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਵਾਂਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਗਵਾਂਢੁ ਜਲਾਏ।
30.t: vaddaa vikaaree vaa(n)s hai haumai jalai gavaa(n)dd jalaae|
30.e: Bamboo being full of evil, bums in its own ego and at the out break of fire, bums its other neighbourly trees also.

30.g: ਜਾਣ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਾਏ।
30.t: jaan amio ras kaalakooT khaadhai marai mue jeevaae|
30.e: The nectar makes the dead alive and deadly poison kills the living.

30.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਏ।
30.t: dharageh sach kabool hai kooRahu dharageh milai sajaae|
30.e: Truth is accepted in the court of the Lord, but, the falshood is punished in the same court.

30.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ॥੨੦॥੩੦॥
30.t: jo beejai soiee fal khaae ||20||30||
30.e: One reaps what one sows.
